MsgLabels_station_01_msg_039.en:
This is the story of a mercenary
corps, tossed about by the
schemes of great powers...

mercenaries who left
no name in history.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_040.en:
The year 2089.
Early summer.

OCU Ground Defense Force,
1st Army Mechanized Division,
Border Guard Unit.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_001.en: You must be the new hire.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_002.en:
That's me.
Codename «E801:00».
And you are...?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_003.en:
The name's Rain.
I'll be your adjutant on this base.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_005.en:
Base rules.
It cuts down on deserters...
And complainers. Any complaints?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_006.en:
No complaints here.
But aren't you a merc too?
Deserter watch is usually
a job for the regulars.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_007.en:
As you know, the regular army is
short-handed right now.
That's why they're hiring mercs.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_009.en: By the way, have you settled in?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_010.en:
I've only been here half a day.
The base is bigger than I expected.
I haven't got the layout yet.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_011.en:
I see.
Have you been to headquarters yet?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_013.en:
Commander Falcon was looking for you.
Do you know the way to headquarters?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_014.en:
It's next to this building, right?
I'll head over.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_015.en:
If you have questions about the base,
touch the old man's icon
on the bottom screen.
Our maintenance chief, Yuji Kinoshita,
will be happy to help.
Also, base rules: to confirm a choice,
touch the OK panel to its right
or press the A Button.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_016.en:
Got it.
I'll get used to it soon enough.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_017.en:
To cancel, touch the Back panel.
Pressing the B Button moves you
to the Back panel, and then
the A or B Button cancels.
One more thing: here at the base,
we just call them wanzers.
Please remember that.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_019.en: Heads up -- I'll be on this exercise too.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_020.en:
(So these are the mercenary barracks.
Missions come from headquarters.
Which should be next door...)

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_021.en: (This base is bigger than it looks...)

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_023.en:
You the new guy?«g:24»
«E801:00», huh?
Nice to meet ya. Call me Pete.
I keep the wanzers running around here.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_024.en:
So you're the hotshot everyone's
talking about?«g:24»
I'm Matt, one of the operators.
Good to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_027.en:
Commander.
Heard you were looking for me.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_028.en:
Sorry to rush you on your first day,
but I want to see what you can do.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_029.en:
Roger that.
What's the intel on the enemy?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_030.en:
...Keep your drawers on, kid.
This isn't a real fight.
You'll be running a live-ammo
exercise in the wanzer Killhouse.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_031.en:
The Killhouse... the training ground.
An exercise won't show you
what I can really do.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_032.en:
Don't be like that.
It's dead simple.
There are wanzers set up
in the Killhouse.
Put every last one of them out of action.
There's a wanzer waiting for you
in the hangar. Already set up.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_034.en:
Hold up.
Before you go, let me introduce
you to your adjutant.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_036.en:
Have you, now.
Saves us some time, then.
Anything you're unsure of,
ask her at the Killhouse.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_038.en: Get ready for the live-ammo exercise.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_001.en:
I'll be joining the exercise as well.
I'll cover «E801:00»'s unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_002.en:
Roger.
Still, these wanzers are well kitted out
for a mercenary base.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_003.en:
Border security is a key mission,
so parts are supplied quickly.
They just aren't issued to mercs...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_004.en:
I see.
"We'll sell you the parts,
now go guard the border."

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_005.en:
More or less. Now, beginning
the live-ammo exercise.
Your new parts have anti-piercing
armor. Watch out for other
damage types.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_007.en:
Hm. Looks like
you're in position.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_008.en:
Alright, «E801:00».
Let's see what you've got.
You're up against four wanzers.
Good luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_009.en:
Commander, wait!
Four at once -- isn't that reckless?
This is live ammo.
If he takes a direct hit...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_010.en:
You don't know what he can do, Rain.
If his file's anything to go by,
four won't even be enough.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_012.en:
I can use the equipped items, right?
Then there's no problem.
Go ahead and start.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_013.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_015.en:
Before the mock enemies appear,
move to the point marked GREEN.
Your movement range is
displayed in BLUE.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_016.en:
Yeah, I know.
Point confirmed.
Moving ahead.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_017.en:
Quick, aren't you.
Sending out the mock enemies.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_019.en:
When you select Attack,
your attack range is shown in RED.
Select an enemy you can hit, and...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_020.en:
...then choose a weapon.
Terrain affects accuracy and
movement cost, so watch for it.
Are you seriously reading me
the wanzer manual?

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_021.en:
I... my apologies.
I was treating you like a rookie...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_025.en:
Surgical precision.
Just what I'd expect from
a seasoned merc, I suppose.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_026.en:
That was nothing.
It wasn't much of a challenge.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_027.en:
...He's good.
Those trainers are seasoned pilots...
and he swept them clean
with gear like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_028.en:
Training means nothing if you've
never seen real combat.
Out there, you may have to fight
with badly maintained gear.
Compared to that, this was easy.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_029.en:
You're the real deal, that's for
damn sure.
It's only an exercise, but
you'll be paid for it.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_031.en:
Mercs pay for their own wanzer
setup, as a rule.
It isn't much, but put it toward that.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_004.en:
Go ahead.
If it's something I can answer.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_005.en:
Your file says you were decorated
in "a certain unit" before
you came here. What kind of
battlefields have you seen?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_006.en:
...Some of the operations I was on
could cause bad blood between mercs.
Even with friends, mercs don't talk
about past jobs. Isn't that the rule?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_007.en:
Yes, I understand...
Then let me ask something else.
What does it take to survive
in real combat?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_009.en:
Luck.
I survived on the battlefield
because I was lucky.
Nothing more than that.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_010.en:
Luck...?
No, it takes more than luck to
pilot a wanzer the way you do.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_011.en:
No. It's luck.
The toughest veteran alive still dies
if he catches one stray round.
Nobody can read every bullet
flying across a battlefield.
Technique can lower the odds
of getting hit.
But nothing guarantees
you'll make it out alive.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_012.en:
There's no such thing as
an unbeatable soldier...
So that's why you honed your
piloting and lived through it all.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_013.en:
Rules are rules.
I can't answer that.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_014.en:
Of course.
My apologies...
So it's your loyalty to the mission
and the rules that kept you
alive out there.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_015.en:
Maybe so.
Does that answer your question?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_016.en:
Yes. I think I understand a little
of what makes you so strong...
By the way, there's word of
another exercise.
Ask the Commander for details.
I have another assignment,
so I can't join you this time.
Also, the hangar is now
open to you.
The hangar is where you change
your wanzer's equipment and
buy and sell parts.
Ask Yuji Kinoshita how it works.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_017.en:
Understood.
I'll go see the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_018.en:
Ask the Commander about the exercise.
Also, the hangar is now
open to you.
The hangar is where you change
your wanzer's equipment and
buy and sell parts.
Ask Yuji Kinoshita how it works.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_019.en: I'm heading out on another assignment.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_020.en:
(Didn't expect to get paid
for training...)

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_021.en:
(I should set up my wanzer
while I'm at it.)

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_023.en:
Hey there, «E801:00».
I just finished work on your wanzer...
How do you wear the joints
down like that?«g:24»
Treat her a little gentler, okay?
Nice and gentle.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_024.en:
Looks like the rumors were true!
Whole base is talking about you.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_025.en:
The hangar... might be confusing
at first... Listen to Yuji...
And equipping items... easy to forget...
Even without a backpack...
you can equip up to four...

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_026.en:
Some junior officers from a friendly
unit arrived on Huffman yesterday.
You've seen plenty of real combat,
so I want you to give them
a taste of a real wanzer fight.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_027.en:
An exercise for the new officers.
...Roger that. Sounds fun.
The Killhouse again?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_028.en:
That's right.
We've put in a few obstacles
this time.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_030.en:
A three-unit squad.
Their weapons are loaded with live
ammo, so they get the real feel.
Disable the lieutenant's machine,
reach POINT B, and the win is yours.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_031.en:
"Disable" meaning I wreck
everything but the body?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_032.en:
That's it.
No kills in the Killhouse, if you
can possibly help it.
Remember, it's only an exercise.
Slip past their fire and
make for POINT B.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_034.en:
No kills in the Killhouse, if you
can possibly help it.
Slip past their fire and
make for POINT B.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_001.en:
The lieutenants lose the moment
«E801:00» reaches POINT B or all
three of their units are disabled.
This exercise affects their postings,
so take it seriously.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_002.en:
Lieutenant Rick here.
We've had plenty of time to set up.
Awaiting instructions.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_005.en:
There's no way elite soldiers like us
lose to some hired gun...
But my career rides on this posting,
so we won't be holding back.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies
or reach POINT B.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_011.en:
...Your setup's all wrong.
Assault, if you fight up close,
know what each weapon does.
The shotgun sprays a cloud of pellets
and wears armor down with impact.
The machine gun is weak per shot,
but puts a lot of rounds downrange.
The flamethrower burns through armor
and cooks the internals.
Those are the basic three.
And mind each armor's type.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_013.en:
And know your COM. It boosts
performance to suit your machine's
specs. Pick one that fits.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_015.en:
Long-range weapons hit hard,
but they're heavy and the rounds
are slow, so accuracy suffers.
Pair them with a power-focused body
and high-accuracy arms.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_017.en:
Shoulder launchers have long range
and they're easy to use.
But ammo is limited.
In a fight with no resupply,
pick your moments.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_019.en:
You're not using a Striker's
light-armed mobility, Lieutenant.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_020.en: So it isn't just the pilot's skill...

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_021.en:
Strikers are built for melee.
That puts you right in the enemy's
line of fire.
Prioritize each part's durability.
Mobility without durability just
makes you a faster target.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_023.en:
So this is real combat...
It's nothing like the simulations!

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_024.en:
Hm. Lieutenant Rick?
Report to headquarters later.
I trust you know what about?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_002.en:
Are you and I the only
wanzer pilots in this unit?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_003.en:
Ah, that.
This base used to have eight
wanzer pilots, myself included.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_005.en:
A few days ago...
Only I and one other came back...

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_007.en:
Yes. A merc named Buggy.
He was wounded in that operation,
so he's being treated at the
medical facility now.
Six didn't return,
our captain among them...

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_009.en:
No... we don't know.
We searched, but...
we still haven't found a trace.
They weren't the kind
of mercs to desert...

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_010.en:
I see.
Any plans to bring in
replacement pilots?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_011.en:
There are.
Apparently a few recruits made the
cut in today's exercise, too.
Ask the Commander for details.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_013.en:
Ask the Commander about
the replacement mercs.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_014.en:
It sounds like this exercise will
decide the replacement pilots.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_015.en:
(I'm starting to get used to
this base.)

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_016.en:
(They sure love their exercises
here, though...)

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_019.en:
I'm «E801:00».
My squad has no official name yet,
but we're with the merc corps too.
Pleased to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_020.en:
Sarna, Chariot Squad.
I'm here to look over the new mercs.
I'm after one Assault pilot.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_021.en:
Chariot Squad.
I hear you've seen a lot of combat.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_022.en:
There's some promising talent here.
We may end up fighting your
squad over recruits.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_023.en:
If it's an Assault you want,
no need to worry.
That position is already filled.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_024.en:
I see.
Then I'll scout freely.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_025.en:
Hm.
That rookie shows real promise.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_026.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Heard you knocked that stuck-up
little lieutenant down a peg.
Serves him right.
By the way, you thinking about
attribute defense? Makes a big
difference in damage, so keep
it in mind, ya hear?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_027.en:
That lieutenant you took on?
Word is he's been sent home
for retraining.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_029.en:
This time, I want you to size up
some pilot candidates.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_031.en:
That's right.
We hired them to form a squad
with you as its captain.
You'll pick your own people
from this batch.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_033.en:
Problem?
With your skills, it's the
obvious call.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_034.en:
...I'm not leadership material.
Rain survived the last squad.
I think she'd make a better captain.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_035.en:
Nobody on this base has more
real combat under their belt than you.
Rain will be your second.
She was an excellent vice-captain
in her last squad.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_036.en:
...I'll follow your orders, Commander.
So it's a field interview.
The usual Killhouse?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_037.en:
That's right.
The candidates are already on their way.
This time, the exercise ends when
every target is out of action.
If any of them look useful,
report back to me afterwards.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_039.en:
The exercise ends when every
target is out of action.
If any of them look useful,
report back to me afterwards.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_001.en:
This exercise is to see what you
lot can do.
Whoever puts the target out of action
gets a bonus once they sign on.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_002.en:
...Huh?
One guy against the four of us?
They must think we're a joke.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_003.en:
...Or it means our opponent has
the skill and confidence to back it up.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_004.en:
...Right.
What kind of hell must they have
been through... I can't imagine.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_005.en:
Unit 4, you're an Assault, right?
Want to team up with me?
I'll lay down suppressing fire
from long range.
While he's busy, get in close
and throw him off balance.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_007.en:
All units, come at me like
it's the real thing.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_012.en:
You hesitate on the controls.
This isn't a game.
The moment you face an enemy in
a wanzer, you're one step from death.
You don't have that mindset yet.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_013.en:
He saw my hesitation in
one exchange...
Understood...

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_014.en:
Still, you have the makings of
a good Assault.
Get some real combat behind you,
survive Huffman, and I'd like
a rematch someday.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_015.en:
Thank you, sir...
(...So this is a mercenary...)

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_017.en:
You've got a knack for melee,
but you're not there yet.
Your evasion is amateur-level.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_018.en:
Tch...
Put me in a real fight and I'll
level up before you know it!

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_019.en:
If you want to be a Striker,
train your melee skill, FIGHT.
And build up AGILITY to protect
yourself from enemy attacks.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_021.en:
Your long-range accuracy is
impressive.
But once someone gets inside your
guard, you can't do a thing.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_023.en:
When you set up, mind your weight,
put a weapon in your arms, and
train SHORT or FIGHT as well.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_024.en:
All units confirmed disabled.
Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_025.en:
Four units out of action
in no time at all.
Impressive.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_026.en:
They had no coordination.
I just took them out one at a time.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_028.en:
Yes.
Rough around the edges,
but there's talent there.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_029.en:
Good.
You can report to me later.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_002.en:
I'm the type who'd rather fight
than give orders.
But it's the Commander's call.
For now, I'll go along with it.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_003.en:
I'll support you, Captain «E801:00».
You just keep focusing on combat,
the way you always have.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_005.en:
I'll support you, Captain «E801:00».
You just keep focusing on combat,
the way you always have.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_009.en:
Codename: Champ...
As you can see, he's quite famous
in the fighting world.
Snoring away in a place like this...
I suppose that's a big shot for you.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_010.en:
...Sorry, Rain.
I have no intel on the fighting world.
When he wakes up, tell him
to go to his quarters.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_014.en:
Oh, Captain!
Thank you for picking me!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_016.en:
Codename: Oddeye!
Because, well, I've got odd eyes.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_017.en:
Your eyes?
Huh. Silver and blue.
Is that in fashion these days?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_018.en:
Hmm, is it?
I couldn't tell you if it's in fashion.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_020.en:
It's not a fashion thing.
Oddeye's eyes are real...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_021.en:
Oh, right.
Yep, they're real!
But sometimes I wear a contact
to make them match.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_022.en: I see. Sounds like a lot of work.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_023.en:
Well, I don't think it's
that much work...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_024.en:
What? It's tons of work!
Silver or blue? Silver or blue?
I can never decide!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_025.en:
Is there something wrong
with leaving them as they are?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_026.en:
Oh! You're right!
If I make them match, my codename
won't make sense anymore!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_028.en: That settles it. No more contacts!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_029.en: A mission? I'll go get ready!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_030.en:
(With more people, we can take
a wider range of missions.)

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_033.en:
I think that's all my luggage...
Oh, you're «E801:00», sir... right?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_034.en:
I hear you've been assigned
to Chariot Squad.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_035.en:
Yes, sir.
Thank you for everything.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_036.en:
Oh, it's Unit 4!
Are you leaving already?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_037.en:
Oddeye... ma'am.
My codename is Tornado...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_038.en:
Oops, sorry!
Tornado, right?
If you're staying on Huffman,
maybe we'll meet again!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_039.en:
Maybe so.
Different squads, but let's both
do our best.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_041.en:
«E801:00», sir. Oddeye...
I should get going.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_044.en:
Hey there, «E801:00».
Captain already, and you only
just got here, huh?
Go get 'em!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_045.en:
With your skills, making captain
was a given. Anyway...
Could you do something about the
snoring from that guy over there?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_046.en:
...Oddeye, huh......Oddeye...
New parts... came in at the hangar...
Should I... tell her...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_055.en:
Now then. «E801:00» Squad's
barely formed, but there are
two jobs on the table.
One: ambush an enemy recon unit.
Two: a solo wanzer sniper op.
Your pick, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_056.en:
A recon unit ambush,
or a sniper op.
Let me see...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_057.en:
The recon unit job, then.
Intel just reported an enemy
supply unit gathering on the plains
outside West Peseta.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_058.en:
The plains outside West Peseta.
Wide open, good visibility.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_059.en:
That's right.
«E801:00» Squad is to disrupt
and wipe them out.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_060.en:
Roger that.
Any intel on the enemy unit?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_061.en:
Transport vehicles with an
armed vehicle escort.
If they reach POINT B, we may
not be able to touch them.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_062.en:
So the transports are
top priority?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_063.en:
Correct.
And if you can, wipe out the lot
before they make POINT B.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_064.en:
Meaning I can expect the pay
to match the results?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_065.en:
Naturally.
Set up to suit the job.
I'd rather you didn't botch
your very first mission.
Well? Will you take it?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_066.en:
I'll take it.
Against vehicles, rifles should work.
We'll check our machines in
the hangar and sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_067.en:
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_069.en:
The sniper op, then.
Before dawn, an enemy field survey
team landed at Freedom Airport.
Our agent there says they're
heading to Peseta tonight.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_070.en:
Quite the big fish.
They'll have a decent escort,
I imagine.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_071.en:
Send in a big force and they'll
spot us coming.
So it's one wanzer, kitted out
for long-range attack.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_072.en:
Get to the sniping point fast and
hit the vehicle the target's in.
The command car, right?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_073.en:
Right.
And your machine goes in
unmarked. No affiliation.
If you're captured, we can't
help you. Not one bit.
Keep that in mind.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_075.en:
Of course.
Once the shot's done, get to
POINT A on the double.
We'll send a pickup chopper.
But after 10 turns, the chopper
heads back to base.
Well? Will you take it?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_076.en:
I'll take it.
Looks like there won't be time
to bother with other enemies.
I'll gear up in the hangar
and sortie.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_077.en:
Once the shot's done, get to
POINT A on the double.
We'll send a pickup chopper.
But after 10 turns, the chopper
heads back to base.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_079.en:
«E801:00», were you listening?
You've got two options.
Which one will it be?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_080.en:
Good. The recon unit ambush.
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_081.en:
Good. The sniper op.
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_001.en:
Enemy recon unit acquired.
As expected, they're heading
for POINT B.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_002.en:
Roger.
We take them out before they get there.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_003.en:
Just transports and jeeps?
These guys are sitting ducks.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_004.en:
Vehicles or not, don't get careless.
Those jeeps are fast.
Read how far they can move and
get between them and POINT B.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_007.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_009.en:
All units, watch out for the
missile jeeps.
If they catch you when you're worn
down, even a wanzer will get hurt.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_013.en:
Old-generation weapons like those
are no match for wanzers.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_015.en:
Still, the enemy getting this close...
It could be the prelude to
something big.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_016.en:
Agreed.
We'd better head back and prepare
for the next operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_017.en:
...Enemy has left the combat area.
We're too late!

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_019.en:
I'm sorry.
I guess I'm still not used
to this machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_020.en:
It can't be helped.
Mission failed.
All units, return to base.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_003.en:
Captain, it seems some missions
limit how many of us can sortie.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_004.en:
Makes sense. Covert ops and the
like are often better done by a
small team suited to the job.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_005.en:
So checking the mission details and
choosing which wanzers to bring is part
of the strategy, you mean?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_006.en:
Exactly.
Say it's a sniper op limited
to two units. A melee Striker
would be a poor fit.
Better to bring a Launcher
or a Sniper.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_007.en:
True. Each type has its strengths
and weaknesses.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_008.en:
Some missions limit the number
of units that can take part.
It's best to check the mission
details carefully before deciding
which wanzers to send out.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_012.en:
Habit from my fighting days.
If I'm not moving, I get antsy.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_013.en:
I suppose a Striker, whose reflexes
and fighting sense carry over into
the wanzer, could use strength
training at that.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_014.en:
Huh, that so?
So my workouts ain't a waste!
Hey, while you're here, Captain,
why not do some sit-ups with me?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_015.en:
No, I'll pass.
I train at my own pace,
when I need to.
Don't mind me. Carry on.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_016.en:
Right on!
Training at your own pace,
that's the key!
Figured I'd get chewed out for
doing sit-ups here.
But if the Captain says so,
sit-ups it is!
Alright! Hup! Hup!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_017.en:
Your own pace may be important...
but there's no need to brazenly
do sit-ups in a place like this...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_018.en:
That's Champ's pace, I suppose.
Don't worry about it.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_019.en:
...Sigh. If it's fine with you,
Captain, then I won't object...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_020.en:
Training at your own pace,
that's the key!
Hup! Hup!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_021.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_022.en:
Oh, Captain!
Can I take a look at your
wanzer later?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_023.en:
I don't mind.
You seem to like wanzers, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_024.en:
I love them!
A next-gen, multi-purpose weapon
for regional warfare!
That means they can do anything!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_025.en:
True.
Set up with the right intel and
experience for the terrain and the
operation, then used in real combat,
they can handle all kinds of missions.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_026.en:
Exactly!
And a wanzer merc's job is to rebuild
a robot with your favorite parts
and ride it around!
It's the best!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_028.en:
A robot?
I'd call a wanzer gear that
augments infantry, if anything.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_029.en:
Infantry augmentation gear?
Oh, so it's like a mascot suit?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_031.en:
Yeah!
Like the heroes and monsters
in theme park shows.
Oh, so that makes you and me
the people inside the suits!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_034.en:
Oh no, did I confuse you, Captain?
I'm sorry...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_035.en:
No, I'm sorry.
Don't worry about it, Oddeye.
I'm just short on intel.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_036.en:
"Intel"...?
It's not the kind of intel that's
any use on a battlefield...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_038.en:
Oddeye, come look at my wanzer
later. As much as you like.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_040.en:
I don't think so.
Wanzers have only recently been
used as weapons.
Whether they're the best isn't
for me to judge.
History will decide that.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_041.en:
No, no, that's not it!
I'm not talking about weapons.
I mean wanzers are just the best!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_042.en:
Isn't that talking about
weapons, though?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_043.en:
Um, well, okay, wanzers are weapons,
but, how do I put it...
Walking weapons have a romance that
older weapons don't, don't you think?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_044.en:
Oh dear.
You two aren't quite on the
same page, are you?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_045.en:
Sorry.
A lot of what Oddeye says
is hard for me to follow.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_046.en:
No, I'm the one who's sorry...
I'll work hard on finding things
to talk about that you'll get...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_047.en:
Please show me your wanzer later,
Captain!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_048.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_049.en:
(Doesn't seem to be anyone shy
in this squad.
...In my experience, there's usually
at least one oddball.)

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_050.en:
(Now that I'm in charge, I should
get on better terms with them...)
(...Wait. That makes it sound
like I'm the shy one...)

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_052.en:
Hello, Rain.
It's been a while.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_053.en:
Oh, Ellen! It's been ages.
Captain, this is Ellen Tyler.
She's a mercenary, like us.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_054.en:
I'm «E801:00».
Pleased to meet you.
About that name, though...
Isn't it a codename?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_055.en:
Pleased to meet you, «E801:00».
My base has different rules.
Codenames are for operations
only, you know.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_056.en:
Ellen is usually at another base,
mostly on joint operations
with the regular army.
We're both mercs, but she's
far more senior than I am.
When I first came to Huffman,
she took good care of me...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_057.en:
Took care of you? I just happened
to be your instructor.
You were so good I wanted you in
my squad, but Lancer snapped you up
before I had the chance.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_058.en:
Me, good? Not at all...
What brings you to our base today?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_059.en:
A recon mission near the border...
or so it sounds on paper. Really,
I'm inspecting the bases that
guard the border, like yours.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_060.en:
Checking that we're holding
the border properly, then.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_061.en:
Honestly, it's a job I'd rather
not do. But our report decides
this base's... I mean,
Commander Falcon's evaluation.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_062.en:
Then we'd better do well,
for the Commander's sake.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_063.en:
We just carry out the missions
we're given.
That will show in his record.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_064.en:
Exactly.
Rain.
Don't do it for the Commander.
Focus on getting the mission done.
Push too hard and it'll get you killed.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_065.en:
Understood.
I still have a lot to learn
from you, Ellen.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_066.en:
Hehe.
I'll be on border duty for a while,
so I'll drop by now and then.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_067.en:
I'll be on border duty for a while,
so I'll drop by now and then.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_068.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Tuned the actuators like you asked.
Hopefully that takes some strain
off the joints.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_069.en:
First fight as captain was a
cakewalk, huh? Anyway...
That guy doing sit-ups over there,
his huffing is driving me nuts.
Can you do something about him?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_070.en:
The new Raptor MG...
...I like it...but Oddeye...
prefers the Grave MG...
We don't...click...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_071.en:
An enemy transport unit is moving
through eastern Grayrock.
Hit it in the Roxta Desert and
burn the cargo.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_072.en:
Nothing out there but highway.
Perfect for an ambush.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_073.en:
That's right.
Out there, their vehicles have
nowhere to run.
Just the kind of ground wanzers
excel on, wouldn't you say?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_074.en:
Which makes it hard to believe
their escort is just
armored vehicles.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_075.en:
No other forces confirmed so far.
Take out every enemy, transports
included.
Three turns enough for you?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_076.en:
If it's only vehicles.
Mission understood.
Moving out.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_077.en:
No other forces confirmed.
Take out every enemy,
transports included.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_078.en:
So, what about the leftovers from
that merc squad?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_079.en:
One was wounded and is likely in a
medical facility. The other is
believed to still be on base.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_080.en:
We've got a Numbers guy who's good
at sneaking in, right?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_082.en:
Then you know what to do.
Get him prepped. Chop-chop.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_002.en: Another easy one, by the looks of it.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_004.en:
Why bother?
Once we get in close to those
vehicles, they're ours.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_005.en:
As wanzer missions go, it's simple.
But I don't think that's all there is.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_007.en:
Not a hunch.
An assessment of the situation.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_008.en:
Captain!
Targets approaching.
Composition matches the intel!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_009.en: Good. All units, take your positions.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_010.en:
Roger!
The big game's all mine!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_011.en:
Targets confirmed.
All units, commence attack!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_014.en: The target formation is breaking up.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_015.en: Let's finish this in one round!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_016.en:
Huh? What's this!?
Captain!
There's a wanzer hidden in the container!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_017.en: So that's what the Captain meant...

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_018.en:
Change of plan.
All units, bring down that enemy
wanzer with everything you've got.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_020.en:
Wanzer confirmed in the wreckage
of the transport.
One was hiding in there after all.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_021.en:
Hitting the transport first
was the right call.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_024.en:
Some intel that was.
Thanks for nothing...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_002.en:
I'm the type who'd rather fight
than give orders.
But it's the Commander's call.
For now, I'll go along with it.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_003.en:
I'll support you, Captain «E801:00».
You just keep focusing on combat,
the way you always have.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_005.en:
I'll support you, Captain «E801:00».
You just keep focusing on combat,
the way you always have.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_009.en:
Codename: Champ...
As you can see, he's quite famous
in the fighting world.
Snoring away in a place like this...
I suppose that's a big shot for you.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_010.en:
...Sorry, Rain.
I have no intel on the fighting world.
When he wakes up, tell him
to go to his quarters.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_014.en:
Oh, Captain!
Thank you for picking me!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_016.en:
Codename: Oddeye!
Because, well, I've got odd eyes.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_017.en:
Your eyes?
Huh. Silver and blue.
Is that in fashion these days?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_018.en:
Hmm, is it?
I couldn't tell you if it's in fashion.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_020.en:
It's not a fashion thing.
Oddeye's eyes are real...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_021.en:
Oh, right.
Yep, they're real!
But sometimes I wear a contact
to make them match.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_022.en: I see. Sounds like a lot of work.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_023.en:
Well, I don't think it's
that much work...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_024.en:
What? It's tons of work!
Silver or blue? Silver or blue?
I can never decide!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_025.en:
Is there something wrong
with leaving them as they are?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_026.en:
Oh! You're right!
If I make them match, my codename
won't make sense anymore!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_028.en: That settles it. No more contacts!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_029.en: A mission? I'll go get ready!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_030.en:
(With more people, we can take
a wider range of missions.)

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_033.en:
I think that's all my luggage...
Oh, you're «E801:00», sir... right?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_034.en:
I hear you've been assigned
to Chariot Squad.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_035.en:
Yes, sir.
Thank you for everything.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_036.en:
Oh, it's Unit 4!
Are you leaving already?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_037.en:
Oddeye... ma'am.
My codename is Tornado...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_038.en:
Oops, sorry!
Tornado, right?
If you're staying on Huffman,
maybe we'll meet again!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_039.en:
Maybe so.
Different squads, but let's both
do our best.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_041.en:
«E801:00», sir. Oddeye...
I should get going.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_044.en:
Hey there, «E801:00».
Captain already, and you only
just got here, huh?
Go get 'em!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_045.en:
With your skills, making captain
was a given. Anyway...
Could you do something about the
snoring from that guy over there?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_055.en:
Now then. «E801:00» Squad's
barely formed, but there are
two jobs on the table.
One: ambush an enemy recon unit.
Two: a solo wanzer sniper op.
Your pick, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_056.en:
A recon unit ambush,
or a sniper op.
Let me see...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_057.en:
The recon unit job, then.
Intel just reported an enemy
supply unit gathering on the plains
outside West Peseta.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_058.en:
The plains outside West Peseta.
Wide open, good visibility.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_059.en:
That's right.
«E801:00» Squad is to disrupt
and wipe them out.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_060.en:
Roger that.
Any intel on the enemy unit?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_061.en:
Transport vehicles with an
armed vehicle escort.
If they reach POINT B, we may
not be able to touch them.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_062.en:
So the transports are
top priority?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_063.en:
Correct.
And if you can, wipe out the lot
before they make POINT B.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_064.en:
Meaning I can expect the pay
to match the results?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_065.en:
Naturally.
Set up to suit the job.
I'd rather you didn't botch
your very first mission.
Well? Will you take it?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_066.en:
I'll take it.
Against vehicles, a full-auto rifle
should do the job. We'll check our
machines in the hangar and sortie
at once.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_067.en:
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_069.en:
The sniper op, then.
Before dawn, an enemy field survey
team landed at Freedom Airport.
Our agent there says they're
heading to Peseta tonight.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_070.en:
Quite the big fish.
They'll have a decent escort,
I imagine.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_071.en:
Send in a big force and they'll
spot us coming.
So it's one wanzer, kitted out
for long-range attack.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_072.en:
Get to the sniping point fast and
hit the vehicle the target's in.
The command car, right?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_073.en:
Right.
And your machine goes in
unmarked. No affiliation.
If you're captured, we can't
help you. Not one bit.
Keep that in mind.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_075.en:
Of course.
Once the shot's done, get to
POINT A on the double.
We'll send a pickup chopper.
But after 10 turns, the chopper
heads back to base.
Well? Will you take it?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_076.en:
I'll take it.
Looks like there won't be time
to bother with other enemies.
I'll gear up in the hangar
and sortie.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_077.en:
Once the shot's done, get to
POINT A on the double.
We'll send a pickup chopper.
But after 10 turns, the chopper
heads back to base.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_079.en:
«E801:00», were you listening?
You've got two options.
Which one will it be?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_080.en:
Good. The recon unit ambush.
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_081.en:
Good. The sniper op.
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_001.en:
A hit on a VIP. Not the kind of job
the regulars can do.
Still, hard to believe he'd come into
the buffer zone with no escort...

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_004.en:
Victory: Destroy the target and escape.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed or
the turn limit runs out.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_011.en:
Took the bait, didn't you!
You're not going anywhere!

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_012.en:
I see.
So it was a trap after all.
This is «E801:00».
I've hit an enemy ambush.
Requesting extraction support.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_013.en:
Rain here.
Plotting an escape route now.
Captain, hold on just a little longer.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_014.en: Right. As fast as you can.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_015.en:
Captain, we're on our way to pick
you up! Head for the extraction point.
Enemy reinforcements are closing in.
Please hurry.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_016.en:
Roger.
The extraction point's up on the hill...
Only way there is straight through.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_017.en:
I can't wait any longer.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_018.en:
Hold it!
We haven't picked up the Captain yet!

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_019.en: Negative. My orders are to RTB.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_020.en:
Rain, that's the job.
Leave me. Return to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_022.en:
Preparing for capture.
Purging comm logs.
...Signing off.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_026.en:
Enemy reinforcements will be here
any minute. This time they'll likely
bring wanzers.
We need to get out of here, now.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_003.en:
Captain, pilots have aptitudes...
Some roles suit them, some don't.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_004.en:
True.
A wanzer will always end up reflecting
the traits of the pilot flying it.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_005.en:
Then Champ is a melee fighter first
and foremost... We'll keep him
as a Striker?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_006.en:
Yes.
Give him long-range work and he
probably won't learn the skills for it.
Still, if he wants to try,
I won't stop him.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_007.en:
Oddeye, on the other hand, is good
at long range...
So we shouldn't expect much from
her melee skills.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_008.en:
Seeing through a pilot's traits is
part of a captain's job, too.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_012.en:
Habit from my fighting days.
If I'm not moving, I get antsy.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_013.en:
I suppose a Striker, whose reflexes
and fighting sense carry over into
the wanzer, could use strength
training at that.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_014.en:
Huh, that so?
So my workouts ain't a waste!
Hey, while you're here, Captain,
why not do some sit-ups with me?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_015.en:
No, I'll pass.
I train at my own pace,
when I need to.
Don't mind me. Carry on.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_016.en:
Right on!
Training at your own pace,
that's the key!
Figured I'd get chewed out for
doing sit-ups here.
But if the Captain says so,
sit-ups it is!
Alright! Hup! Hup!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_017.en:
Your own pace may be important...
but there's no need to brazenly
do sit-ups in a place like this...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_018.en:
That's Champ's pace, I suppose.
Don't worry about it.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_019.en:
...Sigh. If it's fine with you,
Captain, then I won't object...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_020.en:
Training at your own pace,
that's the key!
Hup! Hup!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_021.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_022.en:
Oh, Captain!
Can I take a look at your
wanzer later?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_023.en:
I don't mind.
You seem to like wanzers, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_024.en:
I love them!
A next-gen, multi-purpose weapon
for regional warfare!
That means they can do anything!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_025.en:
True.
Set up with the right intel and
experience for the terrain and the
operation, then used in real combat,
they can handle all kinds of missions.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_026.en:
Exactly!
And a wanzer merc's job is to rebuild
a robot with your favorite parts
and ride it around!
It's the best!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_028.en:
A robot?
I'd call a wanzer gear that
augments infantry, if anything.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_029.en:
Infantry augmentation gear?
Oh, so it's like a mascot suit?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_031.en:
Yeah!
Like the heroes and monsters
in theme park shows.
Oh, so that makes you and me
the people inside the suits!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_034.en:
Oh no, did I confuse you, Captain?
I'm sorry...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_035.en:
No, I'm sorry.
Don't worry about it, Oddeye.
I'm just short on intel.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_036.en:
"Intel"...?
It's not the kind of intel that's
any use on a battlefield...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_038.en:
Oddeye, come look at my wanzer
later. As much as you like.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_040.en:
I don't think so.
Wanzers have only recently been
used as weapons.
Whether they're the best isn't
for me to judge.
History will decide that.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_041.en:
No, no, that's not it!
I'm not talking about weapons.
I mean wanzers are just the best!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_042.en:
Isn't that talking about
weapons, though?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_043.en:
Um, well, okay, wanzers are weapons,
but, how do I put it...
Walking weapons have a romance that
older weapons don't, don't you think?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_044.en:
Oh dear.
You two aren't quite on the
same page, are you?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_045.en:
Sorry.
A lot of what Oddeye says
is hard for me to follow.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_046.en:
No, I'm the one who's sorry...
I'll work hard on finding things
to talk about that you'll get...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_047.en:
Please show me your wanzer later,
Captain!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_048.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_049.en:
(Doesn't seem to be anyone shy
in this squad.
...In my experience, there's usually
at least one oddball.)

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_050.en:
(Now that I'm in charge, I should
get on better terms with them...)
(...Wait. That makes it sound
like I'm the shy one...)

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_052.en:
Hello, Rain.
It's been a while.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_053.en:
Oh, Ellen! It's been ages.
Captain, this is Ellen Tyler.
She's a mercenary, like us.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_054.en:
I'm «E801:00».
Pleased to meet you.
About that name, though...
Isn't it a codename?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_055.en:
Pleased to meet you, «E801:00».
My base has different rules.
Codenames are for operations
only, you know.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_056.en:
Ellen is usually at another base,
mostly on joint operations
with the regular army.
We're both mercs, but she's
far more senior than I am.
When I first came to Huffman,
she took good care of me...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_057.en:
Took care of you? I just happened
to be your instructor.
You were so good I wanted you in
my squad, but Lancer snapped you up
before I had the chance.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_058.en:
Me, good? Not at all...
What brings you to our base today?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_059.en:
A recon mission near the border...
or so it sounds on paper. Really,
I'm inspecting the bases that
guard the border, like yours.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_060.en:
Checking that we're holding
the border properly, then.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_061.en:
Honestly, it's a job I'd rather
not do. But our report decides
this base's... I mean,
Commander Falcon's evaluation.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_062.en:
Then we'd better do well,
for the Commander's sake.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_063.en:
We just carry out the missions
we're given.
That will show in his record.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_064.en:
Exactly.
Rain.
Don't do it for the Commander.
Focus on getting the mission done.
Push too hard and it'll get you killed.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_065.en:
Understood.
I still have a lot to learn
from you, Ellen.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_066.en:
Hehe.
I'll be on border duty for a while,
so I'll drop by now and then.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_067.en:
I'll be on border duty for a while,
so I'll drop by now and then.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_068.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Tuned the actuators like you asked.
Hopefully that takes some strain
off the joints.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_069.en:
First fight as captain was a
cakewalk, huh? Anyway...
That guy doing sit-ups over there,
his huffing is driving me nuts.
Can you do something about him?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_070.en:
...Oddeye and I... we just...
don't click...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_071.en:
Word just came in: an enemy supply
unit is on the move near Grayrock.
Going by its size, it's hauling
a lot of materiel.
Hit it in the mountains.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_073.en:
At that size, better assume it has
wanzers along for the ride.
But hit them before they're unloaded
from the transports, and they're
no threat.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_074.en: A race against the clock, then.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_075.en:
Smash this unit and we may finally
break the stalemate on the front.
Take out as many as you can.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_077.en:
Smash this unit and we may finally
break the stalemate on the front.
Take out as many as you can.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_001.en:
By the book: command vehicle first.
Then we hit the transports.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_003.en:
Three wanzer signatures!
But they're packed too close together
to tell apart.
Which transport's container are the
wanzers in...?

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_004.en:
Screw it!
Then we just smash 'em all!

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_007.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_009.en:
We're under attack!
Protect the transports!
Wanzer team, prep for launch! Move it!

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_010.en: Wanzer team here. Ready to launch.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_011.en:
Wanzer team, go!
Buy time till the transports are clear!

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_014.en:
So we missed a container.
All units, wipe out the enemy wanzers.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_016.en:
Wanzer signatures gone!
All transports carrying wanzers
confirmed destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_017.en: Moving on to mop up the rest.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_019.en:
Lucky their wanzers were still boxed up.
But those vehicles moved pretty
damn well.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_021.en:
Vehicles or not, never drop your guard.
But knock out the command, and most
units turn into a rabble.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_022.en:
I see.
Combat's kind of like a puzzle, huh?

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_023.en:
Maybe so.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_024.en:
Captain, multiple contacts on radar.
Enemy reinforcements approaching.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_025.en:
That's a big force...
No way we take that on alone...

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_001.en:
Captain, I'd like to introduce two
squad candidates.
Codename: Buggy.
He was a squadmate in my old unit.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_002.en:
Captain «E801:00». Rain's told me
all about what you've been up to.
Buggy. I fly launcher.
Good to meet ya!

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_003.en:
Likewise.
Are you back in shape?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_004.en:
I'm itching to cut loose in a wanzer.
Rain, that headache of yours
all cleared up?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_005.en:
Yes, I haven't had one since.
And the other one:
codename Alchemist.
He took the top score in the mock
battle the other day.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_008.en:
Oh, not at all. I merely happened
to match your own score, Captain.
I look forward to working with you.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_010.en:
They're only candidates for now, but
I think they'll be front-liners soon.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_011.en:
They're only candidates for now, but
I think they'll be front-liners soon.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_014.en:
What's wrong, Champ?
You look pale.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_016.en:
Oh, Champ.
Is your stomach better?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_018.en:
Apparently he drank some milk that
had been left out of the fridge
and made himself sick.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_019.en:
It wasn't milk!
It was my special protein shake!
Wait... ugh, no good...
Champ is tapping out!!

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_021.en:
...I'd like them to keep an eye
on their health, too.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_025.en:
Oh, Captain.
It's getting kind of lively around
here, isn't it?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_027.en:
Speaking of lively...
Captain, have you ever been to
Akiba, in Japan?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_028.en:
The 'Electronical Town'?
I've been sightseeing there twice.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_029.en:
Electronical...?
Oh, you mean Electric Town!
These days Akiba's the holy land of
videos, toys, all kinds of fun stuff.
But there are also junk shops
selling army surplus.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_030.en:
Sounds like you could get anything
there.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_031.en:
Not really!
I went right before I came to this
island, but people come from all over
the world hunting the same stuff,
so a lot of the time you go home
empty-handed.
Honestly, you've got better odds at
niche shops out in the sticks.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_032.en:
I see.
Everyone thinks alike,
so it pays to do the unexpected.
Same as the battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_033.en:
Right?
Oh, Captain, we finally agree on
something!

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_035.en:
It's getting kind of lively around
here, isn't it?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_036.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_038.en: You're a launcher, aren't you, Buggy?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_039.en: Yep. Leave the long-range stuff to me.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_040.en: Will you be joining us in a wanzer?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_041.en:
Nah. Docs say I need a bit more rehab
before I'm fit to ride a wanzer.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_042.en:
True. Motor problems and fractures
will affect how you handle a wanzer.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_043.en:
Get in a wanzer now and I'd just be
dead weight.
I'll earn my keep in a vehicle
for a while.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_044.en: Leave the long-range stuff to me.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_045.en: Leave the long-range stuff to me.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_049.en:
You have the air of the military
about you... some special unit,
in fact.
I don't mean to pry.
It just caught my attention.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_050.en:
...You're imagining things, Captain.
Though I'm flattered to be taken for
special forces elite.
An 'air', you say? I can't think
what that would be.
I've had no particular training.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_051.en:
Your bearing, I suppose.
The way you carry yourself.
No, I'm sorry.
Forget it.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_057.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
So Buggy's back, huh?
And new parts came into the hangar,
so... guess I'll give the wanzers
a once-over.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_058.en:
Alchemist's exercise score was the
same as yours.
This base sure pulls in some hotshot
mercs.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_060.en:
This time it's factory defense.
I've laid on missile carriers as
reinforcements.
Work with them, and it shouldn't be
too tough a job.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_061.en:
However many we are, we can't
protect the entire factory.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_062.en:
I know.
The enemy's most likely after the
containers inside the factory.
A raid with fast attack choppers
would be the textbook play.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_063.en:
Attack choppers... an anti-air fight.
And at night, recon...
recon choppers will show up too.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_064.en:
Right.
Also, enemy ground units have been
sighted, though they haven't made
a move yet.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_065.en:
I see.
Leave a recon chopper flying and
things get ugly.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_066.en:
There are about 20 containers at
the factory right now.
If you do come under attack,
I'd like losses held to
around 10.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_067.en:
If we can't protect the target,
it's no defense mission.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_068.en:
Fair enough.
The missile carriers have our next
batch of replacement mercs aboard.
Link up with them, then begin
the mission.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_070.en:
The missile carriers have our next
batch of replacement mercs aboard.
Link up with them, then begin
the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_001.en:
Factory defense, huh?
Feels like I'm a security guard.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_002.en:
All units, among the choppers,
take down the recon birds first.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_003.en:
We'll cover you from the missile
carriers.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_005.en:
Hey, Rain.
Still sore all over.
I'll cover you from a vehicle.
Call it rehab.
«E801:00» Squad, you guard
the containers.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_006.en:
Roger.
We'll defend the containers with
the anti-air vehicles.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_011.en:
Assault unit hit!
Heavy damage... ground-attack power
down.
We're short on firepower.
Requesting reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_012.en:
Roger.
ETA a few minutes.
Hold on somehow.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_013.en:
Appreciated.
We'll be spraying every round we've
got till you get here!

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_016.en:
Keep defending the target and
intercept the reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_018.en:
Easy money, for once.
I could go for a toast back at base.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_019.en:
Drinks?
If we're going out, let's make it
dinner!

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_020.en:
If there's drinking, count me in.
You're coming too, right, Rain?
You drank the whole old squad under
the table, after all.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_021.en:
Ooh.
Then I'd love to see how Rain
holds her liquor!

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_022.en:
Buggy, honestly...
You didn't need to share that...

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_024.en:
Their reinforcements came at a
nasty time.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_025.en:
The containers...
All that brand-new stuff, scrapped...

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_026.en:
Tch. Defense missions just ain't
my style...

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_027.en:
Guess a vehicle just doesn't have
the firepower...
Maybe I'll take a wanzer next time...

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_028.en:
The mission's complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_003.en:
Hm?
Captain, are those dark circles
under your eyes?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_004.en:
Yes. A bad headache hit me last night.
I didn't get much sleep.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_005.en:
A headache?
Is it a chronic condition?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_006.en:
...Yes. For about two years now, I've
had sudden attacks of bad headaches.
The painkillers from the infirmary
keep them under control for now.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_007.en:
It might be stress.
Please don't push yourself.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_008.en:
Captain.
Please don't push yourself too hard.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_011.en:
Morning, Champ.
...That's quite a feast for breakfast.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_012.en:
Steak here's great, y'know?
Wanna eat some meat with me, Captain?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_013.en:
I hear meat at breakfast is good for
the digestion, but...
I can't face it this early.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_014.en:
Rare, dripping with juice like this!
Passing it up's a crime!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_015.en:
Supplements and rations are enough
for me.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_016.en:
Rations for breakfast...?
How can you eat that crap...?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_017.en:
I try not to care about taste.
You can't choose your meals on the
battlefield.
I ate them in the mornings to get
used to it, and it became a habit.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_019.en:
Nor me. Meat in the morning is
beyond me.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_021.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_023.en:
Morning, Oddeye.
You still look sleepy.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_024.en:
Yes...
I'm not a morning person...
Oh, you've got dark circles too,
Captain.
I was up fighting online till dawn
myself...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_026.en:
Yes...
My clan had an event.
The team we faced in the final was
really strong...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_027.en: Sounds like some kind of contest.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_028.en:
Yep.
We won the whole thing, though, so
I'm going to lay off logging in
for a while.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_029.en:
I see.
Don't overdo it.
It'll affect your work.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_032.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_035.en:
Wanted to do some wanzer rehab, but
unless you get in first thing, you
can't get near the training rigs.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_036.en:
I see.
Come to think of it, I haven't seen
Alchemist around.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_037.en:
Still asleep, I bet.
Guy's too serious or something.
Not much for hanging out.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_039.en: Well, back in a wanzer at last.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_040.en: Well, back in a wanzer at last.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_041.en:
(No sign of Alchemist...
For some reason, he reminds me of
my old unit...)
(Even now, thinking back to that
brings on the headaches...)

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_042.en:
(That was a bad one. First in
a while...)
(I'd better get extra medicine from
the infirmary.)

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_044.en:
......Um, Ellen.
I'm sorry if this touches on anything
classified, but...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_045.en: What is it? Why so formal?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_046.en:
Has the regular army heard about
the mercenaries who went missing?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_047.en:
Ah, that...
I even know you were one of the
victims.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_049.en:
...They're not.
And they have no intention of doing so.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_051.en:
When the border inspection orders
came down, we were told to stay as
far away from that matter as we
possibly could.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_052.en:
But...
They hire mercenaries to defend the
border, then don't even investigate
when they disappear?
Isn't that a contradiction!?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_053.en:
It is.
But Rain, I'm just a merc too.
I can ask questions about missions
I'm given. I can't carry out missions
nobody gave me.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_054.en:
I'm sorry.
I got carried away...
Oh, Captain! How long have you
been there?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_055.en:
Sorry.
I didn't mean to overhear...
Rain, this isn't like you.
You know the mercenary rules.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_056.en:
It's all right, «E801:00».
Rain was one of the victims.
I understand why she's angry.
...If I get the chance,
I'll ask about it,
but don't expect much.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_058.en:
About the missing mercs...
I'll ask if I get the chance,
but don't expect much.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_059.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Word is another merc's gone and
deserted.
Maybe it ain't desertion at all, though.
Could be another one of those
disappearances.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_060.en:
So Alchemist isn't in your squad,
huh?
Falcon planning to form another unit?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_061.en:
...Oddeye... strong...
...couldn't lay a finger on her...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_062.en:
Regrettably, three men have deserted
from a nearby mercenary unit.
They're fleeing through the forests
of the Wayne Mountains.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_063.en:
Mercenary Contract, Article 58:
acting outside your mission voids the
contract, counts as desertion, and
may carry a bounty.
...Our mission is to arrest them?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_064.en:
You can urge them to surrender,
of course. But if they resist, you're
cleared to destroy them, wanzers and all.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_065.en: To keep the units in line...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_066.en:
Yes. Merc rules.
They've got no proper gear.
You'll catch up quickly enough, but
they're likely in hiding.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_067.en:
So: find them as early as possible,
neutralize them, and bring them back?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_068.en:
If possible.
The call on the ground is yours.
But... the wanzers they ran off in are
valuable assets too.
Word from above is, bring back the
parts at least.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_070.en:
Buggy will join you as backup again.
Link up on site, then begin the
mission.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_072.en:
Buggy will join you as backup again.
Link up on site, then begin the
mission.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_073.en:
Two survivors from that unit
confirmed.
Continuing surveillance.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_074.en:
Surveillance, sure.
Can't you lure one of 'em out already?
The client's riding my back.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_075.en:
Not possible.
Their captain has sharp instincts.
Any more and he'll sense something.
Besides... No. It's nothing.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_076.en:
Sharp instincts? Who're we talking
about? If something's bugging you,
report it properly.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_077.en:
...Their captain has a tattoo shaped
like bat wings.
I've never seen that unit insignia
before.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_078.en:
What!?
Bat wings... What's his name?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_079.en:
He goes by «E801:00».
A merc codename, of course.
Real name unknown.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_080.en:
«E801:00»...
No way... That's impossible.
...X-26, keep an eye on him too.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_082.en:
(Bat wings... «E801:00»...
Bullet «E801:00»...)
(But there's no way he'd ever come
back to the battlefield...)

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_001.en:
This stray-hunting business is one
lousy mission...

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_002.en:
Well, it's rough work.
I get wanting to run, sorta...

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_003.en:
It's like mercs eating their own,
isn't it?
And it feels like we're being tested
too. I don't like it.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_004.en:
I understand, but anyone who doesn't
want to take part should head back
to base now.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_005.en:
Nah, I'm in.
If some other bunch goes,
it'll just be a slaughter.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_006.en:
Of course I'm going too.
Our squad might get through this
without anyone getting hurt.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_012.en:
Men on the run are desperate.
All units, stay sharp.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_015.en:
One left.
Don't force a one-on-one.
Work with your wingmen.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_018.en: All units, stay sharp till it's over.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_020.en:
All fleeing wanzers neutralized.
Receiving a surrender signal.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_021.en:
Mission complete.
Contact the transport chopper on
standby.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_023.en:
Once they're back, they get shipped
home, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_024.en:
Coming back alive beats the
alternative, I guess...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_002.en:
Rain, about that stray hunt.
Does that happen a lot around here?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_003.en:
Not often at this base.
At other bases, I hear mercs often
slip away around their second week.
These days people sign up as
mercenaries far too lightly...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_004.en:
That's what happens when people
unfit for war call themselves mercs.
Come to think of it, where's Buggy?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_005.en:
He went out last night on a fairly
easy solo mission. Partly as wanzer
rehab, I think.
But he's late.
He should be back by now...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_006.en: Knowing him, he'll be back soon.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_007.en:
I suppose so.
He was so eager to get back out
there, I'm worried he'll do
something reckless.
He keeps everyone's spirits up and
gets along with anyone. That's a rare
thing on a battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_009.en:
Buggy hasn't even made his scheduled
check-in. That's not like him...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_010.en:
A mission?
...Buggy...
Understood. Preparing to sortie
at once.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_012.en:
Asleep here again...
Maybe something's wrong with his
quarters...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_014.en:
Buggy...?
Dammit, that woke me right up.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_017.en:
That stray hunt...
It left a bad taste, didn't it?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_018.en:
It seems to be common in merc units
these days.
Mercs or not, we handle military
secrets.
I suppose it can't be helped.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_019.en:
I know it was in the contract when I
signed up...
But getting shot by your own side,
before you even fall on a mission...
If I have to go, I'd rather go down
fighting...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_020.en:
Oddeye, a mercenary doesn't get to
choose how they die.
Anyone who worries about how they'll
die won't last on the battlefield.
Better to think of it that way.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_021.en:
You're right...
Oh, and besides, I can't die yet...
The movies I want to see haven't
even come out!

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_022.en:
That kind of motivation to live
might be what keeps you alive.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_023.en:
Motivation to live...
Yeah, yeah, that's it!
Talking it out really cleared my
head. Thank you!

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_024.en:
There's that one to see...
and that one I still haven't
bought...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_025.en:
Huh? Buggy...?
I'll get ready right away.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_029.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Huh?«g:24»
Buggy's not back yet?
He said it was a quick one, and to
fit him with the rifle that came in
today once he got back.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_030.en:
Buggy sortied and hasn't made his
scheduled check-in.
You don't think he...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_032.en:
One of our wanzers has failed to
return.
So far there's no sign it was shot
down. If we can't find out where he
went, he'll officially be suspected
of desertion and espionage.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_033.en:
One unit.
Do we know where contact was lost?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_034.en:
We've pinpointed it.
I want him brought back before this
goes public...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_035.en:
The way you say that...
The target's someone we know?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_037.en:
...Didn't he go out on a simple solo
mission, as wanzer rehab?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_038.en:
It was a simple solo mission, yes.
But since he completed it, there's
been no contact at all.
And since then, what look like enemy
units have been sighted nearby.
If he's working with the enemy,
we may have to shoot him down.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_039.en:
He never showed any sign of that.
...Mission understood.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_040.en:
Watch out for chance run-ins with
the enemy. We know enemy forces will
reach that area in 7 turns.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_041.en:
So if we take too long, enemy
reinforcements show up.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_042.en:
They'll probably send a chopper unit
ahead as a vanguard.
If so, shoot down the recon chopper
and you'll buy yourselves some time.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_043.en:
Understood.
A search will take manpower...
I'd like Alchemist's help as well.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_044.en:
Unfortunately he's already out on
another solo mission.
Not the sociable type, it seems.
He's asked to be given solo missions
whenever possible.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_045.en:
Mercs don't get paid to socialize.
That's just the kind of man he is.
We'll move out, then.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_046.en:
Shoot down the recon chopper out in
front, and you'll buy some time.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_002.en:
Damn you, Buggy...
You could've at least called in...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_003.en:
Maybe his wanzer broke down and he's
stuck out there?

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_005.en:
Either way, it's on us to find him
and bring him back.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_007.en:
Hang in there, buddy.
We're coming to get you!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_010.en:
Friendly wanzer... Buggy's unit
located.
The pilot is... not inside.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_013.en:
That's them.
Huh? Captain...
There are wanzer tracks here I've never
seen before!
Looks like they're following Buggy.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_014.en:
...Looks like Buggy ditched his wanzer
and ran.
Captain, let's go after him now!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_015.en:
Wait.
Rotor noise, closing in.
This aircraft...
The ID code doesn't match...
An unknown...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_016.en:
Captain Gryphon,
target unit located.
Four wanzer signatures confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_017.en:
Gryphon Eye,
watch out for the target's wanzers.
This time we take him unharmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_018.en:
Gryphon Eye, roger.
Relaying to deployed units now.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_019.en:
All units, anti-air intercept
formation.
Once we have a lead on Buggy,
we pull out.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_021.en:
Mayday, mayday!
This is Gryphon Eye.
Took a direct hit.
N-no good, I'm going dow--

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_022.en:
That should hold off their
reinforcements for a while.
All units, take out what's left.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_023.en:
Captain!
It's Buggy!
I've found him. He's badly hurt.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_025.en:
We can't pull out of here carrying
wounded.
We clear out the remaining enemy.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_028.en:
The enemy recon chopper got away.
Watch for reinforcements.
Resuscitation waits until after the
fight...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_030.en:
R-Rain, is that you...
Captain «E801:00» too...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_031.en:
Champ, you've got a first aid kit?
Patch him up.
Buggy, keep it simple.
Can you tell us what happened?

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_032.en:
Sensors went haywire...
Wandered into this... forest...
A pitch-black... wanzer...
Ngh... ghhh...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_034.en:
The bleeding won't stop...
Dammit!
His pulse keeps getting weaker...
Dammit all!
Not enough morphine either!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_035.en:
I called for a medevac chopper ages
ago...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_036.en:
This is enemy territory.
They can't get in that easily...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_038.en:
Buggy, don't talk.
Just breathe easy.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_039.en:
Rain...
S-send my money... to my mom...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_042.en:
Open your eyes!
Don't you go to sleep!!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_044.en:
...Recover Buggy and his unit.
We're heading back.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_046.en:
Looks like they beat him bad.
His face is... you can't even tell
it's him...
And a gunshot wound to the head,
point-blank...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_049.en:
...Recover Buggy and his unit.
We're heading back.
Rain, arrange for his belongings to
be sent to his family.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_002.en: I don't see Rain or Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_003.en: Those two? They went to the bar.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_005.en: Those two? They went to the bar.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_006.en:
Moving out?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_008.en:
Rain, Oddeye.
So this is where you were.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_009.en:
Yesh...
Cap'n, you wanna drink shomething?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_010.en:
All right.
I'll have what she's having.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_011.en:
Ehhh...
You really shouldn't, y'know?
I tried to keep up with Rain an'...
now everything'sh shpinning!

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_013.en:
Hngh!! ...Khaff!...
What is this?
Is this a drink?
Isn't this some kind of
disinfectant?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_014.en:
Ahaha, Rain'sh drinksh, no way!
Nobody can keep up with that!

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_015.en:
It's Spirytus... a vodka.
It's a little on the strong side,
Captain, so please don't push
yourself.
I just felt like getting drunk,
for once...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_016.en:
"A little" strong...
But Rain, you seem exactly the same
as always...
Whereas Oddeye, on the other hand...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_017.en:
Wha'? Ish it a party?
Cap'n, let'sh go do KARAOKE!
Oh, but I'm shleepy.
Gonna... nap now...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_018.en:
Oh dear, Oddeye...
Let's get you back to your room, hm?
Ah, she's fallen asleep...
I'm sorry, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_019.en:
Don't worry about it.
Let her sleep.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_020.en:
In her own way, she was trying to
cheer me up.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_021.en:
Sounds like a good comrade.
...I'm sorry about Buggy.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_022.en:
Now I'm the only survivor left from
my old squad.
...I knew it might come to this when
I became a merc, but...
it's lonely, isn't it?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_023.en:
It is...
For the fallen, all we can do is
remember them.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_024.en:
You've been through this too,
haven't you, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_025.en:
...Comrades dying.
It's burned into my memory.
But we can't grieve forever.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_026.en:
Huh?
Cap'n and Rain?
Why're you talkin' in my room?
...Huh? This isn't my room.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_027.en:
Oh, you're awake.
I'm sorry, Captain.
I'll take Oddeye back to her room.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_029.en:
Thanks to you, I feel a little
calmer now. Thank you.
Please join me again some time.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_030.en:
I don't mind drinking, but
spare me the Spirytus...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_032.en: Let's have a drink together again.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_035.en:
A shortie...?
I'll do my besht!

Ow, ow...
But first I'm gonna go get some
hangover meds from the infirmary...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_036.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
I heard about Buggy.
It's a damn shame, but...
maybe it'll give us a lead on the
disappearances.
By the way, some new parts came in.
Gear up and pay 'em back for Buggy,
ya hear?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_037.en:
Back when I was a rookie, I used to
wonder why a base needs a bar...
But out here, sometimes you just
wanna drown it all in a drink.
Oh, there's a bar in New Millgan
called "Jiira" that's been open
since the first settlers.
Great atmosphere. Check it out if
you ever get the chance.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_038.en:
...The money I owe Buggy...
...should I give it... to Rain...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_039.en:
This mission is a joint operation
with the regulars.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_041.en:
A special forces team will seize a
VIP hiding out in the Pacific
Huffman Hotel in Freedom City.
Your job is to secure the area and
clear away anything in their path,
so they don't get taken out.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_042.en:
Isn't that area supposed to be a
demilitarized zone?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_043.en:
On paper, yes.
And taking advantage of that, armed
guerrillas have made it their den.
Needless to say, attacking civilians
is strictly forbidden.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_044.en:
How do we tell guerrillas from
civilians?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_045.en:
Anyone who attacks you is a hostile
target. Engage on that basis.
The call on the ground is yours.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_046.en:
We can't attack until we're shot at.
And if we kill a civilian by
mistake, the regulars aren't
responsible.
Truly a job made for mercs.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_047.en:
Don't be like that.
