Starting with this op, replacement
merc Gray is assigned to
«E801:00» Squad.
He's ex-special forces.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_049.en:
His file says he has combat
experience as a special forces
sniper.
No word on his wanzer skills, but he
should have plenty of aptitude.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_050.en:
Roger. Sounds like he can shoot.
...And if enemy reinforcements show?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_051.en:
If they're too much to handle, head
for POINT B.
An evac chopper will be waiting.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_053.en:
If they're too much to handle, head
for POINT B.
An evac chopper will be waiting.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_054.en:
My apologies...
The target got away from us.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_055.en:
Hell, what are you even doing...
Now there's only one survivor left
from that unit.
Whatever.
Dead's dead. Can't be helped.
Gryphon, come on back.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_057.en:
Bullet «E801:00»...
Looks like it's really him.
Well, well. This is gonna get
interesting.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_001.en:
This is Delta.
In position.
We'll hit the target when your
diversion kicks off.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_002.en:
«E801:00» Squad, roger.
Beginning sweep around the target
facility now.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_003.en:
If we're the diversion, let's make
it loud!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_005.en:
We draw the enemy out before they
can organize.
But nobody fires first.
Not until we know whether they're
civilians or guerrillas.
Oddeye, are you listening?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_006.en:
Oh, yes, sorry...
Um, so we can't tell who the enemy
is until they shoot at us?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_007.en:
Whoever takes hostile action is an
armed guerrilla. That's the rule.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_009.en:
So we make ourselves the targets...
The regular army would never run an
op like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_010.en:
No need to worry.
Guerrillas around here don't get
much chance to train.
You can think of it as warning shots,
mostly.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_011.en:
Even so, warning shots are still
live rounds flying around.
If your luck's bad, that's it.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_012.en:
Yep.
Gray, was it?
Don't go eating some lucky shot in
your first bout and dropping dead
on us, got it?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_014.en:
Still... Delta 1's voice...
Is it just a coincidence...?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_015.en:
Oddeye?
You're drifting out of formation.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_017.en:
All units look ready.
This is the merc unit.
Beginning the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_019.en:
Victory: Delta completes its op.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed
or Delta is wiped out.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_021.en: The guerrillas have taken the bait.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_022.en:
So it seems.
All units, keep drawing them in.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_023.en:
This is Delta 1.
Looks like you've lured them out
nicely. Thanks for the diversion.
Main team is commencing the op.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_024.en:
I didn't think being bait would be
this much work...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_025.en:
Captain, if this drags on it'll get
dangerous!
New contacts are starting to show
up on radar!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_026.en:
This is Delta 1.
Target secured.
Heading for extraction POINT A.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_027.en:
Roger.
Enemy reinforcements are closing in.
Hurry.
We'll keep covering Delta's
withdrawal.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_029.en:
This is Delta 1.
Arrived at extraction POINT A.
«E801:00» Squad, we're picking up
the enemy reinforcements too.
It's a big force.
Do you need support?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_030.en:
Delta 1, don't worry about us.
Get out of there.
We're heading for our own
extraction point.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_031.en:
Sorry. We'll take you up on that.
You dogs of war know your business.
Smooth work.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_032.en:
Delta's not bad either.
You'd earn more as mercs.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_033.en:
Not a bad offer.
I hope we get a unit like yours
covering us on the next op, too.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_034.en:
Until the next battlefield.
All units, head for POINT B.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_036.en:
We're under attack!
Dammit, where's «E801:00» Squad!?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_037.en:
Captain, enemies near POINT B.
We won't make it in time from here!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_038.en:
I'm hit!
No good, I can't take off...
Aaaagh!!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_039.en:
The evac chopper's gone silent...
Pilot status unknown.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_040.en:
And pursuers are closing in!
Captain, what do we do!?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_041.en:
I'm afraid the pilot's beyond help.
...Change of plan.
The north point, where their cordon
is thinnest, is now POINT C.
We break out from there.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_042.en:
Roger. Looks like there's no other
way out...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_043.en:
So the finish line's got a few more
guys in the way. Big deal.
We've come this far. Same as always:
we go home alive!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_044.en:
When we get back, it's a welcome
party for the new guy!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_046.en:
Yeah, you.
If we get back alive, we go big!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_047.en:
Oddeye, what about your hangover?
...Honestly, all of you, at a time
like this...
Captain, say something!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_048.en:
Picturing the trip home in a spot
like this isn't a bad thing.
All units, hurry to POINT C.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_053.en:
It should be safe from here.
The mission's complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_005.en:
Rain, what do you make of our
squad's wanzer lineup?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_006.en:
Two Assaults, yours and mine.
One Striker, Champ's.
One Launcher, Oddeye's.
And with Gray joining as a Sniper,
the squad has no blind spots now.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_007.en:
Hold on a sec!
Add more Strikers!
No way one of me is enough!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_008.en:
I'll grant you Strikers hit hard.
But I think the current lineup is
the best one.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_009.en:
Get a whole pile of Strikers and
pound 'em as a gang! Nothing'd be
stronger than that!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_011.en:
...A lineup that lopsided, a pack
of Strikers, can't adapt when the
situation changes.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_012.en:
Rain, if you go head-to-head with a
muscle-head, you'll just wear
yourself out, you know?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_014.en:
Rain's right. One Striker is plenty.
What I'm counting on more is Gray's
long-range fire.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_018.en:
Oh, Captain.
Some new wanzer parts came in, did you
know?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_019.en:
I see.
I'll check the hangar later.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_020.en:
Oh, by the way, Captain,
are you a shotgun person?
Or a machine gun person?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_021.en:
Weapons have factions now...
Well, if I had to pick...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_022.en:
Ooh, I knew it, machine guns!
I love machine guns too.
The way the shell casings fly out in
rhythm... so cool!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_023.en:
Cool or not, in real combat they're
reliable.
Once you're used to them, you can
even snipe with short bursts.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_024.en:
Machine guns are the best, aren't
they?
Even if your aim's bad, spray enough
and you'll hit something!
Oh, a new machine gun came in too.
I'm gonna buy one!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_025.en:
Machine guns are the best, aren't
they?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_026.en:
Ooh, shotguns...
Old school. Classy.
Hmm.
They're really satisfying, though.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_027.en:
Buckshot cuts down your aiming time
when you run into an enemy head-on.
And up close, stopping power matters
more than anything.
It's ideal for shredding wanzer parts.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_028.en:
Ooh, so that's how you use them.
Oh, a shotgun came in, too.
I'll try buying one!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_029.en:
Shotguns, huh.
I'll try buying one!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_032.en:
Rather, I try to be able to handle
whatever tool I'm given, in any
situation.
It's best to train until you're
used to every kind of firearm.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_035.en:
Tools, huh...
Haven't messed with any of mine
lately...
Oh, right, my PC's been acting up.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_037.en:
Oh, no.
Nothing.
Oh, more importantly! A "flame...
thrower"? A flamethrower?
Something pretty scary came in.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_038.en:
A flamethrower, huh.
Maybe I'll buy one...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_039.en:
Oh, Captain.
Did you buy any of the
new wanzer parts?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_040.en:
Oh, a sortie!
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_041.en:
You oughta do some strength training
once in a while too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_042.en: True, I haven't trained much lately.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_043.en:
Perfect timing, then.
Why not join me for once?
Let your body go soft and nothing
good comes of it.
Even retired, if I skip a workout,
I'm sluggish all the next morning.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_044.en:
Champ, I hear you did some kind of
martial art.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_045.en:
Huh? C-Captain...
You seriously don't know who I am...
Not even what my codename "Champ"
means?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_046.en:
I had a vague idea you were a
champion of something.
Sorry. I'm not up on worldly
matters...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_047.en:
Oh, nah, don't worry about it!
Hahaha!
A merc's past doesn't matter anyway!
...Welp, I'm goin' for a run!!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_048.en:
Captain. Did you say something to
Champ? He looked kinda gloomy.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_049.en:
No, nothing in particular...
Oddeye, do you know what Champ was a
champion of?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_050.en:
Oh, that.
I didn't know either, but I looked
him up online, and it seems he was
famous in pro wrestling or
something?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_051.en:
Oh, are we talking about Champ?
Oddeye... that's not pro wrestling.
Champ won the stand-up MMA title
three years running. He was a very
popular fighter.
Even I knew who he was.
When the base saw his profile,
everyone went wild.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_052.en:
I see...
For the past few years, I haven't
been in the habit of watching TV,
reading magazines, or going online.
If he's that famous, I may have hurt
his pride.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_053.en:
Don't worry about it.
He'll forget all about it in three
days anyway.
Oh, and guess what? I'm a champ too!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_055.en:
I may not look it, but I'm a
world-ranked player in a super
famous FPS!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_056.en:
Seems this squad has a lot of
celebrities.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_057.en:
...No, Captain.
I'd never heard of this one.
I expect it's about an online game.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_058.en:
Whaaat? I'm at the TOP out of
three million players...?
You don't know!?
In the gaming world, three million
people know who I am!
Oh... so this is it...
Maybe I get how Champ feels now...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_059.en:
...In short, every field has its own
idea of what matters.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_060.en: That seems to be the gist of it.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_062.en:
You oughta do some strength training
once in a while too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_063.en:
Moving out?
Alright, today we go all out wild!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_064.en:
So this is the merc barracks.
This is where everyone's been.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_065.en:
Yes.
Between missions, everyone comes here
to unwind.
Feel free to use it too, Gray.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_066.en:
I will, thanks.
By the way, Champ... he's that
fighting legend, right?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_068.en:
Of course.
Wow, meeting him in a place like
this...
There sure are all kinds of mercs,
huh.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_069.en:
It may be a military facility, but
most of them have no military
training.
They're allowed a freedom you'd never
see in the regular army, but they've
survived real combat. They're good.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_070.en:
That's what's amazing about mercs.
They calmly pull off missions the
army can't... That's not ordinary.
I'd better fit in soon, too.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_071.en:
You're one of them now, Gray.
Better get used to the atmosphere
quickly.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_073.en: I'd better fit in soon, too.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_075.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
You guys really went to town on that
last mission.
Well, however much you wreck, the
whole crew'll fix it up, so relax.
Oh, and a new rifle came in.
Buy it and I'll fit it for ya.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_076.en:
I hear you did a mission with Delta?
Most mercs never even get to work
with the regulars, and you go and
team up with special forces...
You guys are something else.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_086.en:
Two ops on offer.
Requests from HQ.
Defend a bridge under repair, or
eliminate a tank unit.
Decide which one you'll take.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_088.en:
Hm.
The bridge defense, then.
Repairs on the Riversgate Bridge,
down on the lower Mail River, are
way behind schedule.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_089.en:
The bridge that keeps getting hit by
enemy raids.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_090.en:
That's the one. You'd be defending
it.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_091.en:
Structurally, that bridge is
vulnerable to attack from the river.
We'd also need to watch the skies.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_093.en:
Mobility will be key, including on
the water.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_094.en:
A friendly transport unit carrying
repair materials is already on its
way there.
I want you to escort it.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_096.en:
We'll take the bridge defense.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_097.en:
Hm.
The tank unit, then.
An enemy tank unit is massing north
of Menasa.
I want you to hit it on the plains
outside town before it's in place.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_098.en:
I see. Good ground to make full use
of wanzer mobility.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_099.en:
It's an old-fashioned unit, mostly
armored vehicles.
But several tanks with anti-wanzer guns
have been spotted.
Don't get careless.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_100.en: The mission is to wipe them out?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_101.en:
That's right.
I'm sure you'll be fine, but if any
of them get away, they say your pay
gets docked.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_103.en:
We'll take the tank unit.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_104.en:
Can't decide?
Defend a bridge under repair, or
eliminate a tank unit.
Decide which one you'll take.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_105.en:
We'll take the bridge defense.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_106.en:
We'll take the tank unit.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_107.en:
A friendly transport unit carrying
repair materials is already on its
way there.
I want you to escort it.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_108.en:
I'm sure you'll be fine, but if any
of them get away, they say your pay
gets docked.
Good luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_002.en: The calm before the storm, huh.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_003.en:
Do we still get paid if no enemies
show up?

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_004.en:
I'm afraid you needn't worry about
that. Multiple rotors, dead ahead!

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_005.en:
Stealth models...?
I could barely pick them up.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_006.en:
Contacts confirmed.
All units, prepare for combat.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_008.en:
I doubt it's just attack choppers.
There'll be wanzers hiding out there
too. All units, stay alert.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_013.en:
The river!
At this speed... they've got hover
gear!

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_015.en:
They're after the transports.
All units, don't let them get a
single one.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_018.en:
Probably a veteran merc outfit
themselves.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_019.en:
Looks like that's all they've got.
Our mission is complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_024.en: HQ is ordering us to return.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_025.en:
Still, that seems to be all they
had. Mission over. Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_001.en:
Captain.
May I ask you something about
choosing missions?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_003.en:
The mission we choose goes ahead as
planned, but what happens to the
ones we don't pick?
My old squad never had a choice...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_004.en:
Anything urgent should get picked up
by merc units from other bases.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_005.en:
I see.
I thought a merc unit just followed
orders, but sometimes we get to
choose our ops.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_006.en:
We're paid to put our lives on the
line.
Nobody wants an op that throws their
life away for nothing.
But if we pull off hard missions and
the squad's rating goes up, we'll get
tougher, better-paying ops.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_007.en: Then it's time to work hard.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_008.en:
But unlike the regulars, we get no
benefits and no issued weapons.
If mercs don't invest in their own
gear, the mission itself is at risk.
Another thing unique to mercs.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_009.en:
An investment in our freedom, then.
Speaking of freedom, our squad
members are certainly free-spirited...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_010.en:
They're skilled, but they've had no
proper military training.
Forcing them into military discipline
and keeping them on edge would only
hurt the mission. That's my view.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_011.en:
If that's how you want it, Captain,
I'll go along with it.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_012.en:
Still, aren't they a little too
free-spirited...?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_015.en:
Video footage.
What is this, a concert of some kind?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_016.en:
A concert...?
No, no, no...
This is the fight where I took the
triple crown, back in my prime.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_018.en:
Oho.
You know this fight, Gray?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_019.en:
When I'd just joined the army, I went
to the Arena to watch a few times.
His opponent was... Iron Arm Ox!
He was really popular too.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_020.en:
Yeah, me and him go way back.
My biggest rival.
Man, Ox's knee-and-elbow combo hurt
like hell every single time...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_021.en:
Two summers ago.
The special waterfront arena back
home, wasn't it?
Champ was a true hero that night.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_022.en:
Right, Rain?
Why, thank you.
It's fans like you that make the
Champ. Hahaha!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_023.en:
Ah, he's down!
Go! Hit him with an STF!
Aww, come on, attack him while he's
down! Now climb the turnbuckle and
do a moonsault press!!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_024.en:
Oddeye...
I keep telling you, it's not pro
wrestling...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_025.en:
And what the hell's a moonsault!?
That's all illegal!
Huh?«g:24» Oddeye, you into pro
wrestling or something...?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_026.en:
Nope?
I just picked it up from fighting
games.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_027.en:
F-fighting games...!?
Don't lump my fights in with some
video game...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_030.en:
...Captain.
Are you getting a little fired up?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_031.en:
No, I'm calm.
Watching sports is nice once in a
while.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_032.en:
Oh? Um, yes...
That's a side of you I didn't expect,
Captain.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_034.en:
Watching that brought back my
glory days.
Alright, training, training!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_035.en:
Moving out?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_036.en:
Oh, Captain!
Can I take a look at the PC in your
room later?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_037.en:
I don't mind, but where's this
coming from?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_038.en:
Um, Rain's PC broke, apparently, and
it's the same model as yours, so I'm
investigating the cause.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_039.en:
Hm.
Wouldn't you normally call in a
professional for that?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_040.en:
That company's no good!
When they come out for maintenance,
they just follow the manual.
And their parts quotes are vague,
too.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_041.en:
Is that so.
You know your stuff, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_042.en:
Oh, but the wanzer hangar staff here are
great. They keep everything in shape,
right down to the newest parts.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_043.en:
Everything's going digital.
But automate all you like, in the end
it comes down to the experience of
the person at the controls.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_044.en:
Exactly.
I don't think going fully unmanned
could ever work.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_045.en:
I'll stop by your room later,
Captain!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_046.en:
Oh, a sortie!
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_047.en: Captain, have you got a minute?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_049.en:
Captain, you're ex-special forces,
aren't you?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_051.en:
You've still got a unit insignia on
your right arm.
A dagger and bat wings. That's a
typical special forces design.
I'm ex-special forces too, but I've
never seen that emblem before...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_053.en:
It must have been a highly classified
unit.
So classified that even special
forces people like us never heard of
it... Oh, I'm sorry.
I won't pry any further.
That'd be against the rules.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_054.en:
No, it's fine.
If you've been in special forces, you
can tell from a person's air, and
there's a certain kinship.
No wonder you don't know the insignia.
The unit wasn't active long, and it
no longer exists.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_055.en:
No longer exists?
...But with skills like yours,
Captain, why a merc unit?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_056.en:
I didn't want to go back to the army.
But I realized the only skill I had
was surviving on a battlefield.
So... to live, I stay next to death.
Why did you join a merc unit, Gray?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_057.en: ...I have my reasons. I need money.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_058.en:
I see. Same special forces
background, different reasons for
signing up.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_059.en:
...I guess so.
Still, merc missions are a lot rougher
than the regulars'.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_060.en:
Still, merc missions are a lot rougher
than the regulars'.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_062.en:
(Freedom, and responsibility for
yourself.
Every merc has his own story...)

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_063.en:
(Freedom, and responsibility for
yourself.
Every merc has his own story...)

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_065.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Heard this from Shresh on the crew.
Rumor is there's some wanzer nobody's
ever seen prowling around near the
border.
If you spot it, snap me a photo, ya?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_066.en:
Did Pete tell you about that wanzer?
People online are saying maybe some
manufacturer's running secret field
tests.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_067.en:
We've had a request for support from
friendly forces on the front line, in
the western canyons of the Parunta
Desert.
A good chance to have them owe us
one.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_068.en:
The western canyons of the Parunta
Desert. Better known as the
"Valley of Scrap Iron."

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_069.en:
You know your stuff.
The Valley of Scrap Iron has been in
a stalemate for weeks now.
It's a buffer zone between the two
sides, so the fighting never stops.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_070.en:
...I'd hoped never to go near the
place.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_071.en:
After our last op, the enemy seems
to be short on supplies.
Now's the chance to hit them, is the
idea.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_072.en:
But a squad our size won't be much of
a reinforcement, I'd think.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_073.en:
No. With «E801:00» Squad's record,
an op in the Valley of Scrap Iron
should be easy enough.
And we're ready to send a supply
vehicle along for support.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_074.en:
A supply vehicle...
In the Valley of Scrap Iron, attrition
is the biggest enemy.
Good planning.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_075.en:
I'm counting on you.
Now, the details.
Take out the enemy vehicle unit as
fast as you can.
Dawdle and their reinforcements
show up. Attrition is what'll kill
you out there.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_076.en:
Roger.
We'll get ready to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_077.en:
Take out the enemy vehicle unit as
fast as you can.
Dawdle and their reinforcements
show up. Attrition is what'll kill
you out there.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_001.en:
Arrived in the western canyons of the
Parunta Desert.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_002.en:
I'd heard about it, but there really
are mountains of wrecked weapons.
Looks like there'd be loads of
usable parts, but...

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_003.en:
That's why they call it the Valley
of Scrap Iron.
Stand still and you might catch a
stray round.
All units, commence the op at once.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_005.en:
Captain!
Rotor noise detected.
Attack choppers.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_006.en:
They reacted fast.
What's the call, Captain?

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_007.en:
Choppers first.
All units, don't forget to work
together.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_009.en:
If you're running low, pull up next
to the supply vehicle.
We'll resupply ammo and do repairs.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_017.en:
All units, protect the supply
vehicle. If we lose our supplies,
we'll end up scrap iron too.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_018.en:
More enemy wanzer signatures...
Four of them.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_020.en:
So this is the Valley of Scrap
Iron...

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_022.en:
Doesn't look like any more of 'em
are coming.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_023.en: We managed to clear them out.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_024.en:
Gray, guess that special forces
thing ain't just for show.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_025.en: This much I can handle... barely.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_026.en:
Captain.
HQ is ordering us to return.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_028.en: No enemy signatures in the area.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_029.en:
Haven't seen a fight like that in a
while. All units, report status.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_030.en:
My armor's full of holes, but I'm
okay.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_032.en:
Gray, guess that special forces
thing ain't just for show.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_033.en:
Good work, everyone.
HQ just sent the order to return.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_034.en:
Looks like luck hasn't abandoned us
yet. Good. Mission complete.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_005.en:
Rain, what do you make of our
squad's wanzer lineup?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_006.en:
Two Assaults, yours and mine.
One Striker, Champ's.
One Launcher, Oddeye's.
And with Gray joining as our gunner,
the squad has no blind spots now.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_007.en:
Hold on a sec!
Add more Strikers!
No way one of me is enough!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_008.en:
I'll grant you Strikers hit hard.
But I think the current lineup is
the best one.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_009.en:
Get a whole pile of Strikers and
pound 'em as a gang! Nothing'd be
stronger than that!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_011.en:
...A lineup that lopsided, a pack
of Strikers, can't adapt when the
situation changes.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_012.en:
Rain, if you go head-to-head with a
muscle-head, you'll just wear
yourself out, you know?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_014.en:
Rain's right. One Striker is plenty.
What I'm counting on more is Gray's
long-range fire.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_018.en:
Oh, Captain.
Some new wanzer parts came in, did you
know?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_019.en:
I see.
I'll check the hangar later.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_020.en:
Oh, by the way, Captain,
are you a shotgun person?
Or a machine gun person?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_021.en:
Weapons have factions now...
Well, if I had to pick...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_022.en:
Ooh, I knew it, machine guns!
I love machine guns too.
The way the shell casings fly out in
rhythm... so cool!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_023.en:
Cool or not, in real combat they're
reliable.
Once you're used to them, you can
even snipe with short bursts.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_024.en:
Machine guns are the best, aren't
they?
Even if your aim's bad, spray enough
and you'll hit something!
Oh, a new machine gun came in too.
I'm gonna buy one!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_025.en:
Machine guns are the best, aren't
they?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_026.en:
Ooh, shotguns...
Old school. Classy.
Hmm.
They're really satisfying, though.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_027.en:
Buckshot cuts down your aiming time
when you run into an enemy head-on.
And up close, stopping power matters
more than anything.
It's ideal for shredding wanzer parts.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_028.en:
Ooh, so that's how you use them.
Oh, a shotgun came in, too.
I'll try buying one!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_029.en:
Shotguns, huh.
I'll try buying one!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_032.en:
Rather, I try to be able to handle
whatever tool I'm given, in any
situation.
It's best to train until you're
used to every kind of firearm.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_035.en:
Tools, huh...
Haven't messed with any of mine
lately...
Oh, right, my PC's been acting up.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_037.en:
Oh, no.
Nothing.
Oh, more importantly! A "flame...
thrower"? A flamethrower?
Something pretty scary came in.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_038.en:
A flamethrower, huh.
Maybe I'll buy one...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_039.en:
Oh, Captain.
Did you buy any of the
new wanzer parts?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_040.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_041.en:
You oughta do some strength training
once in a while too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_042.en: True, I haven't trained much lately.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_043.en:
Perfect timing, then.
Why not join me for once?
Let your body go soft and nothing
good comes of it.
Even retired, if I skip a workout,
I'm sluggish all the next morning.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_044.en:
Champ, looks like you used to
play some kind of sport.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_045.en:
Huh? C-Captain...
You seriously don't know who I am...
Not even what my codename "Champ"
means?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_046.en:
I had a vague idea you were a
champion of something.
Sorry. I'm not up on worldly
matters...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_047.en:
Oh, nah, don't worry about it!
Hahaha!
A merc's past doesn't matter anyway!
...Welp, I'm goin' for a run!!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_048.en:
Captain. Did you say something to
Champ? He looked kinda gloomy.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_049.en:
No, nothing in particular...
Oddeye, do you know what Champ was a
champion of?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_050.en:
Oh, that.
I didn't know either, but I looked
him up online, and it seems he was
famous in pro wrestling or
something?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_051.en:
Oh, are we talking about Champ?
Oddeye... that's not pro wrestling.
Champ won the stand-up MMA title
three years running. He was a very
popular fighter.
Even I knew who he was.
When the base saw his profile,
everyone went wild.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_052.en:
I see...
For the past few years, I haven't
been in the habit of watching TV,
reading magazines, or going online.
If he's that famous, I may have hurt
his pride.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_053.en:
Don't worry about it.
He'll forget all about it in three
days anyway.
Oh, and guess what? I'm a champ too!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_055.en:
I may not look it, but I'm a
world-ranked player in a super
famous FPS!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_056.en:
Seems this squad has a lot of
celebrities.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_057.en:
...No, Captain.
I'd never heard of this one.
I expect it's about an online game.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_058.en:
Whaaat? I'm at the TOP out of
three million players...?
You don't know!?
In the gaming world, three million
people know who I am!
Oh... so this is it...
Maybe I get how Champ feels now...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_059.en:
...In short, every field has its own
idea of what matters.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_060.en: That seems to be the gist of it.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_062.en:
You oughta do some strength training
once in a while too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_063.en:
Moving out?
Alright, today we go all out wild!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_064.en:
So this is the merc barracks.
This is where everyone's been.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_065.en:
Yes.
Between missions, everyone comes here
to unwind.
Feel free to use it too, Gray.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_066.en:
I will, thanks.
By the way, Champ... he's that
fighting legend, right?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_068.en:
Of course.
Wow, meeting him in a place like
this...
There sure are all kinds of mercs,
huh.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_069.en:
It may be a military facility, but
most of them have no military
training.
They're allowed a freedom you'd never
see in the regular army, but they've
survived real combat. They're good.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_070.en:
That's what's amazing about mercs.
They calmly pull off missions the
army can't... That's not ordinary.
I'd better fit in soon, too.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_071.en:
You're one of them now, Gray.
Better get used to the atmosphere
quickly.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_073.en: I'd better fit in soon, too.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_075.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
You guys really went to town on that
last mission.
Well, however much you wreck, the
whole crew'll fix it up, so relax.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_076.en:
I hear you did a mission with Delta?
Most mercs never even get to work
with the regulars, and you go and
team up with special forces...
You guys are something else.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_086.en:
Two ops on offer.
Requests from HQ.
Defend a bridge under repair, or
eliminate a tank unit.
Decide which one you'll take.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_088.en:
Hm.
The bridge defense, then.
Repairs on the Riversgate Bridge are
way behind schedule. It's a key
strategic link between New Millgan
Port and friendly territory.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_089.en:
The bridge that keeps getting hit by
enemy raids.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_090.en:
That's the one. You'd be defending
it.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_091.en:
Structurally, that bridge is
vulnerable to attack from the river.
We'd also need to watch the skies.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_093.en:
Mobility will be key, including on
the water.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_094.en:
A friendly transport unit carrying
repair materials is already on its
way there.
I want you to escort it.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_096.en:
We'll take the bridge defense.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_097.en:
Hm.
The tank unit, then.
Enemy tanks are massing in the
East Peseta area.
I want you to hit them on the plains
outside town before they're in place.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_098.en:
I see. Good ground to make full use
of wanzer mobility.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_099.en:
It's an old-fashioned unit, mostly
armored vehicles.
But several tanks with anti-wanzer guns
have been spotted.
Don't get careless.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_100.en: The mission is to wipe them out?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_101.en:
That's right.
But they've got reserves waiting
behind the target. If you want to get
out clean, you'll need to finish
the job in about 12 turns.
At the very least, take out the
command vehicle and those nasty tanks.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_103.en:
We'll take the tank unit.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_104.en:
Can't decide?
Defend a bridge under repair, or
eliminate a tank unit.
Decide which one you'll take.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_105.en:
We'll take the bridge defense.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_106.en:
We'll take the tank unit.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_107.en:
A friendly transport unit carrying
repair materials is already on its
way there.
I want you to escort it.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_108.en:
They've got reserves waiting behind
the target. If you want to get out
clean, you'll need to finish the job
in about 12 turns.
At the very least, take out the
command vehicle and those nasty tanks.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_001.en:
A tank fight, huh?
Easy money.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_002.en:
Just watch out for the anti-wanzer
guns, and they're sitting ducks.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_003.en:
Yeah, wanzers have the edge on a job
like this.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_005.en:
Never let your guard down, even
against an easy enemy.
There should be a command vehicle.
Find it and hit it first.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_010.en:
The command vehicle's down!
Dammit!
Which way do we run!?

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_011.en:
They lost their command vehicle,
and now their chain of command's
a mess.
Captain, so that's what you meant!

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_012.en:
Right.
We hit them while they're confused.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_015.en:
Well, decent haul.
Gray, let's head back and have
ourselves a toast!

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_016.en:
Drinking again...
Yeah, yeah, I'll keep you company...

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_017.en:
Oh, Rain, I'll come by your room
when we get back.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_018.en:
Oh, right, to fix my PC.
Thanks, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_019.en:
Oh, the PC they issued me's been
acting up too.
Could you take a look later?

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_020.en:
Gray?
Hey, what about our drink?
Fine, tonight we drink in Rain's
room!

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_022.en:
Mission complete.
Stay alert. Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_023.en:
That took longer than it
should've...

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_024.en:
Makeshift or not, you can't take
those anti-wanzer guns lightly.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_025.en: I'm almost out of ammo, too.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_026.en:
Those vehicles performed better
than we expected.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_027.en:
Don't judge an enemy by its looks.
All units, check your damage.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_001.en:
Captain.
May I ask you something about
choosing missions?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_003.en:
The mission we choose goes ahead as
planned, but what happens to the
ones we don't pick?
My old squad never had a choice...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_004.en:
Anything urgent should get picked up
by merc units from other bases.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_005.en:
I see.
I thought a merc unit just followed
orders, but sometimes we get to
choose our ops.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_006.en:
We're paid to put our lives on the
line.
Nobody wants an op that throws their
life away for nothing.
But if we pull off hard missions and
the squad's rating goes up, we'll get
tougher, better-paying ops.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_007.en: Then it's time to work hard.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_008.en:
But unlike the regulars, we get no
benefits and no issued weapons.
If mercs don't invest in their own
gear, the mission itself is at risk.
Another thing unique to mercs.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_009.en:
An investment in our freedom, then.
Speaking of freedom, our squad
members are certainly free-spirited...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_010.en:
They're skilled, but they've had no
proper military training.
Forcing them into military discipline
and keeping them on edge would only
hurt the mission. That's my view.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_011.en:
If that's how you want it, Captain,
I'll go along with it.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_012.en:
Still, aren't they a little too
free-spirited...?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_015.en:
Video footage.
What is this, a concert of some kind?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_016.en:
A concert...?
No, no, no...
This is the fight where I took the
triple crown, back in my prime.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_018.en:
Oho.
You know this fight, Gray?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_019.en:
When I'd just joined the army, I went
to the Arena to watch a few times.
His opponent was... Iron Arm Ox!
He was really popular too.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_020.en:
Yeah, me and him go way back.
My biggest rival.
Man, Ox's knee-and-elbow combo hurt
like hell every single time...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_021.en:
Two summers ago.
The special waterfront arena back
home, wasn't it?
Champ was a true hero that night.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_022.en:
Right, Rain?
Why, thank you.
It's fans like you that make the
Champ. Hahaha!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_023.en:
Ah, he's down!
Go! Hit him with an STF!
Aww, come on, attack him while he's
down! Now climb the turnbuckle and
do a moonsault press!!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_024.en:
Oddeye...
I keep telling you, it's not pro
wrestling...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_025.en:
And what the hell's a moonsault!?
That's all illegal!
Huh?«g:24» Oddeye, you into pro
wrestling or something...?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_026.en:
Nope?
I just picked it up from fighting
games.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_027.en:
F-fighting games...!?
Don't lump my fights in with some
video game...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_030.en:
...Captain.
Are you getting a little fired up?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_031.en:
No, I'm calm.
Watching sports is nice once in a
while.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_032.en:
Oh? Um, yes...
That's a side of you I didn't expect,
Captain.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_034.en:
Watching that brought back my
glory days.
Alright, training, training!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_035.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_036.en:
Oh, Captain!
Can I take a look at the PC in your
room later?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_037.en:
I don't mind, but where's this
coming from?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_038.en:
Um, Rain's PC broke, apparently, and
it's the same model as yours, so I'm
investigating the cause.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_039.en:
Hm.
Wouldn't you normally call in a
professional for that?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_040.en:
That company's no good!
When they come out for maintenance,
they just follow the manual.
And their parts quotes are vague,
too.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_041.en:
Is that so.
You know your stuff, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_042.en:
Oh, but the wanzer hangar staff here are
great. They keep everything in shape,
right down to the newest parts.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_043.en:
Everything's going digital.
But automate all you like, in the end
it comes down to the experience of
the person at the controls.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_044.en:
Exactly.
I don't think going fully unmanned
could ever work.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_045.en:
I'll stop by your room later,
Captain!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_046.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_047.en: Captain, have you got a minute?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_049.en:
Captain, you're ex-special forces,
aren't you?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_051.en:
You've still got a unit insignia on
your right arm.
A blade and ornamentation. That's a
typical special forces design.
I'm ex-special forces too, but I've
never seen that emblem before...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_053.en:
It must have been a highly classified
unit.
So classified that even special
forces people like us never heard of
it... Oh, I'm sorry.
I won't pry any further.
That'd be against the rules.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_054.en:
No, it's fine.
If you've been in special forces, you
can tell from a person's air, and
there's a certain kinship.
No wonder you don't know the insignia.
The unit wasn't active long, and it
no longer exists.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_055.en:
No longer exists?
...But with skills like yours,
Captain, why a merc unit?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_056.en:
I didn't want to go back to the army.
But I realized the only skill I had
was surviving on a battlefield.
So... to live, I stay next to death.
Why did you join a merc unit, Gray?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_057.en: ...I have my reasons. I need money.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_058.en:
I see. Same special forces
background, different reasons for
signing up.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_059.en:
...I guess so.
Still, merc missions are a lot rougher
than the regulars'.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_060.en:
Still, merc missions are a lot rougher
than the regulars'.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_062.en:
(Freedom, and responsibility for
yourself.
Every merc has his own story...)

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_063.en:
(Freedom, and responsibility for
yourself.
Every merc has his own story...)

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_065.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Heard this from Shresh on the crew.
Rumor is there's some wanzer nobody's
ever seen prowling around near the
border.
If you spot it, snap me a photo, ya?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_066.en:
Did Pete tell you about that wanzer?
People online are saying maybe some
manufacturer's running secret field
tests.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_067.en:
We've got intel that enemy supplies
are being stored at a corporate
factory, disguised as something else.
Quite a lot of them, by the sound of
it. Go in quiet and destroy them.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_068.en:
A covert op.
Do we need to refit and pass as
unmarked machines?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_069.en:
Normally, yes.
But there's no need to get fancy on
this one. Speed's what they want.
The north side looks fairly lightly
defended.
Go in from there.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_071.en:
On paper it's a civilian factory.
Armored vehicles at most, I'd say.
That said, it's safe to assume
enemy reinforcements will show up.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_072.en:
I see.
Is there a time limit?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_075.en:
Your call.
In 5 turns, I want as many of those
containers destroyed as you can.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_077.en:
Your call.
In 5 turns, I want as many of those
containers destroyed as you can.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_001.en:
Sneaking around in the dead of
night...
Not exactly a classy op...

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_002.en: That's what covert ops are like.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_003.en:
I just wanna go in head-on and
smash 'em good...

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_005.en:
Champ?
This is a covert op.
Don't do anything flashy and drag
the squad down.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_006.en:
I'm just kidding!
I've done plenty of ops as a merc by
now, y'know!

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_007.en:
The scary part is it doesn't
sound like a joke, coming from
Champ...
Let's finish the job fast and get
back to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_008.en:
Besides, if we take too long,
enemy reinforcements might arrive.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_009.en:
And the muscle-head might start
running wild.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_012.en:
All units, the containers take
priority over the guards.
Commencing mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_014.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_016.en:
Unmarked machines breaking in!?
Call for backup!
Whose corporate lapdogs are these...
Now of all times...

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_017.en:
Backup's going to take a while to
get here, sir.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_018.en:
No choice, then. Throw everything
the facility has at them and buy
us time!

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_020.en: Then we drop 'em all at once!

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_021.en:
All units, watch your ammo.
Engage at will.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_024.en:
It's a civilian factory. Guards
with little combat experience, and
that equipment...

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_025.en:
Mission complete.
Returning to base before their
reinforcements arrive.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_026.en:
All enemy units in the area are
silent.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_027.en:
Those guards put up more of a
fight than I figured.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_028.en:
Mission complete.
It's dangerous to stay any longer.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_001.en:
Captain.
There you are.
Alchemist was looking for you.
Did he find you?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_002.en:
No.
I haven't seen him in a while.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_003.en:
He asked me about my old squad
just now.
That's not like him...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_004.en:
I wonder what Alchemist wanted to
talk to you about...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_005.en:
A mission?
I'll let Oddeye know.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_006.en:
Oh, Captain.
About Alchemist...
Do you think he's ex-special forces,
too? It's his air, or... I don't
know how to put it...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_007.en:
I sensed the same.
But I don't plan to pry.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_008.en:
Still, he seems to go out of his way
to avoid the other mercs.
And he's not exactly friendly...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_009.en:
That's just who he is.
He gets his missions done.
No need to worry about it.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_010.en:
Still, Alchemist sure is a cold
fish...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_011.en:
Mission understood.
I'll go get Champ.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_012.en:
Captain «E801:00».
I've been looking for you.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_014.en:
You brought up special forces once.
The truth is, I was special forces
myself. With the merc rules, I wasn't
sure how to answer, so I dodged it
rather clumsily.
My apologies.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_015.en:
Rules are rules.
I didn't take it personally.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_016.en:
Since I'm already bending the rules,
may I ask... that insignia of yours,
Captain. What unit was it?
...Someone I knew may have served
in it, you see.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_017.en:
Making conversation all of a sudden.
That's unusual.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_018.en:
...My personality tends to leave me
rather isolated.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_019.en:
That's just who you are.
Give it time and you'll fit in.
The unit I was in was...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_020.en:
Captain, the Commander wants to
see you.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_024.en:
Not at all.
It's quite all right.
I have another solo mission to
prepare for myself.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_026.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Alchemist just asked me something
weird out of nowhere.
Wanted to know if I knew what unit
you used to be in.
I don't, so that's what I told him.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_027.en:
That Alchemist guy saw the new parts
come in today and asked how often
new stuff gets shipped to the merc
base. Like, why would you even
want to know that?
And he's been asking around about
you a lot...
Something happen between you two?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_028.en:
New wanzer parts for our side are
being unloaded at Dock 16, in our
territory.
But we've had word armed guerrillas
are after them.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_029.en:
So our job is guarding the
unloading?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_030.en:
That's right.
Escort the transports carrying the
parts until they're out of the area.
Losing all of them isn't an option.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_031.en:
How big a guerrilla force are we
expecting?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_032.en:
Most likely built around wanzers with
long-range weapons.
Watch their range.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_033.en:
We should also be ready for a
diversion.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_034.en:
Mm.
...And there've been sightings of
an unidentified large wanzer.
The intel's shaky, but I'd keep an
eye out.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_035.en:
Sounds like we'll need to be ready
for anything.
Understood.
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_036.en:
Escort the transports until they're
out of the area.
Losing all of them isn't an option.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_002.en:
Roger.
Get moving at once.
We'll keep escorting you.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_004.en:
I'm afraid not.
Wanzers, likely the armed guerrillas,
confirmed. Coming from the west.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_006.en:
More contacts closing in.
4... 5... 6... That's a lot of them.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_007.en:
All units, prepare for combat.
Keep them away from the transports.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_008.en:
I'll protect that cargo no matter
what!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_009.en:
Transport unit.
We'll draw the enemy off.
Move out when you see an opening.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_010.en:
Roger...
Still a long way to the extraction
point.
We're counting on you!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_011.en:
Victory: Transports leave the area.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed, or
all transports are destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_014.en:
We'll never make the extraction
point like this!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_015.en:
Understood.
All units, take out the
reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_017.en:
Training target... armed guerrillas
confirmed.
...This wanzer unit appears to be
engaged with that merc squad.
Nevertheless... proceeding to gather
combat data as planned.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_018.en:
More reinforcements.
...Huh? I don't recognize that
silhouette.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_019.en:
A large wanzer!?
Even an outfit like this has one?

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_020.en:
Large unit, ID code doesn't match.
...A different faction?

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_021.en:
Don't worry about it, Rain.
Anything that acts hostile gets
taken out.
Our mission is to protect the
transports at all costs.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_023.en:
...Pulling back for now.
...Against that squad, this machine
alone isn't enough, it seems.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_025.en:
Looks like we got ourselves a
top-notch escort.
Thanks for the cover.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_026.en:
Haha.
Nice day for a drive.
Just get that cargo home in one
piece.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_027.en:
...Still, I wonder what that large
machine was.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_028.en:
Even the regulars only have a
handful of those...

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_029.en:
If we're going to be up against
things like that, we'll need to
beef up too.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_032.en:
Give me the footage later.
I'll report it to the Commander.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_033.en:
Roger!
I'll edit it so it's nice and easy
to watch!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_035.en:
We barely made it out!
Escort, get out of there too!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_037.en:
...Sufficient combat data acquired.
Withdrawing from the area.
...That merc squad is good, though.
Next time, I take the target.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_038.en:
Enemy remnants are withdrawing.
...Looks like they've given up.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_039.en:
Phew...
If we're going to fight things like
that, we really need stronger wanzers.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_040.en:
...Large machines are a real
problem, I'll give you that.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_041.en:
That firepower...
I wouldn't want to take it on
alone.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_042.en:
Escort mission complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_043.en:
Transports wiped out!
The mission's failed...

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_008.en:
You never show any emotion, and
now you're rattled.
...Who were you talking to?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_009.en:
No, it's nothing.
...
...You see right through me, don't
you. Looks like the bad acting
ends here.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_010.en:
Naturally I have an idea.
USN?
What could anyone gain by spying on
a merc base like this?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_011.en:
That's about as far as your guesses
can take you, I imagine.
Heh.
I don't have to answer that.
But now that you know...!

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_013.en:
Ghh...
A fast draw!?
You're no ordinary wanzer pilot...

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_014.en:
I don't have to answer that...
but I've picked up most of what it
takes to survive on a battlefield.
I'm taking you to HQ.
Don't resist.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_015.en:
Taking me in, with no restraints?
Don't make me laugh...

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_016.en:
So he had a bomb planted.
Looks like he got away...
I missed his vitals on purpose, but
he can't get far like that...
Still, it looks like the hangar was
hit... Is HQ all right?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_017.en:
Captain «E801:00».
Sorry, but I need you out there in
a wanzer, now.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_018.en:
Sounds like there was an explosion
near the hangar.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_019.en:
Looks like sabotage by a spy who'd
been hiding among us.
The spy stole a wanzer from «E801:00»
Squad and is loose on the base.
I want him caught, whatever it
takes.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_021.en:
What?
What the hell is he after...?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_022.en:
No idea.
Is the base sealed off?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_023.en:
Part of the east gate's already
been blown.
If he gets outside, we'll have a hard
time tracking him.
Deal with him on base if you can.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_024.en:
Roger.
Doesn't sound good.
And if we can't take him alive?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_025.en:
Worst case, it can't be helped if he
dies.
If the spy's Alchemist, he's very
good.
Don't let your guard down.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_026.en:
I won't.
Heading to the hangar now.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_027.en:
Worst case, it can't be helped if he
dies.
If the spy's Alchemist, he's very
good.
Don't let your guard down.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_001.en:
Captain...!
Almost none of the squad's wanzers
can move...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_002.en:
That bastard tried to grab Rain...
...Dammit, my machine's controls are
wrecked.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_003.en:
Champ, guess punching him was the
right call.
I bet he meant to take Rain hostage.
Damn, mine too...
It won't even start like this.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_004.en:
Mine's no good either... it's a mess.
But the Captain's machine looks OK!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_005.en:
Only this one, then...
But with the hangar door crushed,
it'll take time to get out.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_006.en:
Captain, give us 5 turns, that's all.
...We'll bust it open.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_007.en:
We don't have that kind of time,
not like this...
Let's get it done in 3 turns.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_008.en:
Roger.
We'll give it a shot.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_009.en:
The vehicle units outside are
engaging him.
Captain, please command them from
your cockpit.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy Alchemist.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed, or
Alchemist escapes.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_013.en:
Gryphon Eye... Do you read?
This is Alchemist. Target capture
failed.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_015.en:
We have a problem...
Heading to the rendezvous point.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_018.en:
Finally broke, damn thing...
Way tougher than it needed to be...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_019.en:
A wanzer should fit through this hole!
Captain, go!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_020.en:
The enemy's still on base grounds.
Be careful!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_021.en:
Good work, all of you.
«E801:00», launching.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_024.en:
Almost there now.
I thought this would take a lot
more work!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_025.en:
Enemy machine has reached the gate.
At this rate he'll get away!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_030.en:
Gryphon Eye, I can't surrender and
be made to talk.
...Ready an anti-fortress missile.
Target my machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_031.en:
...Locked on.
Alchemist, are you sure about this?

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_032.en:
I'm sure. Fire.
...If it comes to this, I'm taking
him with me.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_034.en:
«E801:00»!«g:24» I surrender!
The cockpit hatch won't open.
Pry it open from outside with your
wanzer.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_036.en:
Captain, heat source incoming!
A high-yield missile!
Take evasive action!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_037.en:
Tch, Rain again...
In my way to the very end...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_039.en:
Rain, thanks. You saved me.
After a blast like that, there'll be
nothing left of him...
Mission complete...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_040.en:
Gryphon Eye.
This is Alchemist.
Reached the extraction point.
Gryphon Eye, launch a ground-attack
missile. Target «E801:00»'s machine.
Destroy the whole base.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_041.en:
To let him slip right through our
fingers...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_002.en:
If Champ hadn't stepped in,
I might have ended up a hostage.
But I wonder how much information
he managed to send out...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_003.en:
Hmm, why sneak into a merc base,
of all places?
I can't think of anything strategic
worth stealing here.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_004.en:
True...
Then again, passing yourself off as
a merc is probably pretty easy.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_007.en:
I barely knew him, but even so...
I have mixed feelings about it.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_008.en:
Same here.
I wish I'd caught on a little sooner.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_009.en:
Captain, why do you think Alchemist
infiltrated this base?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_010.en:
...Unknown.
But he was very good.
We may be up against whatever unit
a man like that belongs to.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_011.en:
A spy in a merc base...
Could it have something to do with
the mercs who've been disappearing...?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_012.en:
...Now that I think of it, in the
hangar, Alchemist said my old
captain... is alive.
...That threw me, and he almost
got hold of me.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_013.en:
He knew about your old captain...?
That's suspicious...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_014.en:
Anyway, Champ, how did you know
Alchemist was a spy?
You decked him the second you
ran into him...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_015.en:
The bastard was trying to grab Rain.
I saw that and swung on reflex,
that's all...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_016.en:
Not exactly thought through, but it
worked out, so...
Hm...?
If he brought up your old captain,
maybe this spy was digging into
something about your old squad?«g:24»
...Rain, when you made it back from
your old squad, what happened?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_017.en:
It was... an ordinary mission,
as jobs go.
But when we got near the objective,
Buggy and I were both hit by
splitting headaches at the same
time. It was strange...
Lancer, our captain then, ordered
us to pull out, and we got off the
battlefield, but they never came back...
No mission report since. Nobody
knows what became of them.
Buggy was hit on the way out and
badly wounded.
Lancer and the others just weren't
the kind to desert...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_018.en:
A spy at a merc base, mercs who
never came back, an unidentified
large machine...
If it's all connected, what on
earth is happening on Huffman?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_019.en:
...Whatever it is, for now we go
back to merc work.
This isn't being officially treated
as an incident.
Let's get our machines repaired
and be ready for the next job.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_020.en:
You're right...
Everyone, let's put Alchemist
behind us.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_021.en:
Still, what Alchemist said...
I can't stop thinking about it.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_022.en:
A mission?
If we've been issued wanzers,
we're fine.
I'll get ready right away.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_024.en:
Whoa!
My wanzer's fixed already!
I'm ready to roll anytime!

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_025.en:
Rain...
First she loses her old squad, and
now someone comes after her too...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_026.en:
The staff rebuilt our wanzers for us!
The parts are all brand new.
Ready to sortie anytime!

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_027.en:
With this much pointing to foul play,
they still won't treat it officially...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_028.en:
The wrecked wanzers have been fully
restored.
Mission acknowledged.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_030.en:
Come to think of it, Captain, you
mentioned headaches too.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_031.en:
Mine come on in sudden attacks...
Most likely an aftereffect of
old combat.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_032.en:
An aftereffect of combat...
It must have been one brutal fight...
What happened?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_033.en:
A bad call on my part got my unit
wiped out.
When I try to remember that time,
the headaches can hit hard.
Anyway, it has nothing to do with
Rain's case.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_035.en:
(My machine seems untouched...
Time to get ready to sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_036.en:
I heard a spy got onto the base.
I've been asked to come and hear
what happened from you.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_038.en:
His paperwork was complete and all
in the proper format,
and with skills on a par with the
Captain's, I don't think there was
any reason for a merc outfit to
turn him down...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_040.en:
Right before he was exposed,
he'd been going around asking
everyone about my past.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_041.en:
Oh, that's right!
He asked me too!

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_043.en:
He may have been digging into the
special forces unit I used to
belong to.
It shouldn't be public knowledge,
even inside the army.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_044.en:
I see...
I'll put that in my report.
If special forces intel is involved,
I expect Army Special Intelligence
will get involved.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_045.en:
Um, Ellen...
If you could, about the missing
mercs as well...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_046.en:
About that... I did ask already,
but they still wouldn't tell me
anything.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_049.en:
There may be spies in other merc
bases too.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_050.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
We patched up the wrecked wanzers
and swapped in new parts, so
they're ready to sortie.
Meant pulling an all-nighter, ya
know... *yaaawn*

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_051.en:
Alchemist, a spy... who'd have
thought?
What was he even after?«g:24»
...Maybe there was a reason he kept
asking about you, «E801:00».

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_052.en:
Emergency mission.
A transport chopper belonging to a
company rumored to be backing the
enemy has gone down in the
Wayne Mountains.
Get out there now and recover the
cargo.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_053.en:
Roger.
How long since the crash?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_054.en:
From the look of it, about three
hours already.
The enemy's probably sent its own
recovery team by now.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_055.en:
So it's a race against them.
But the squad's wanzers took serious
damage in the last incident.
Getting ready to sortie will take
time.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_056.en:
That's not a problem.
The trouble happened on this base.
I've told the hangar crew to put
together new wanzers for you.
If they grab any containers,
take them back by force.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_057.en:
Roger.
Heading to the site now.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_058.en:
Expect to run into their recovery
team.
If they grab any containers,
take them back by force.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_001.en:
Approaching the transport
chopper's crash site.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_005.en:
Looks like we got here first.
Alright, let's grab the loot!

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_006.en: Let's scoop it all up while we can!

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_007.en:
Right. We move before their
recovery team arrives.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies and
recover all containers.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_014.en:
All units, prepare to intercept,
and speed up the recovery.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_018.en:
Huh? ...This cargo...
I'm sure I've seen this emblem...?

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_019.en:
That's some medical company's
emblem... I've seen it around.
Doesn't exactly scream treasure.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_020.en:
This cargo...
Is this... an animal's spinal cord?
What is it for?
It doesn't look like a weapon.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_021.en:
And here I thought it'd be some
new weapon...
This is kind of gross...

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_022.en:
Sakata... products...
It's classified.
You'd better not look any closer.
All of you, forget what you saw.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_024.en:
All containers recovered,
including the ones the enemy took.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_025.en:
Though we did blow a few of 'em
sky-high along with the enemy...

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_026.en:
Some of that couldn't be helped.
Better than letting the enemy
have them.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_027.en:
This cargo...
Is this... an animal's spinal cord?
What is it for?
It doesn't look like a weapon.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_028.en:
And here I thought it'd be some
new weapon...
This is kind of gross.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_029.en:
Sakata... products...
It's classified.
You'd better not look any closer.
All of you, forget what you saw.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_001.en:
Medical companies do work with the
military on technology, but still...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_002.en:
That was the Sakata Industries
emblem, wasn't it.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_003.en:
Either way, that stuff was shady
as hell...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_004.en:
Maybe they're building androids...
Hmmm...
Or maybe it's alien technology!?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_005.en:
Things like that don't happen in
real life...
Oh, Captain. Good work today.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_006.en:
Sounds like you're talking about
what we saw on the last mission.
That job came in as an emergency.
It must have been highly classified.
The sooner you forget it, the better.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_008.en:
I hear it's not just mercs. Even
special forces operators have been
made to disappear for touching
military secrets.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_009.en:
So even idle curiosity can get you
killed.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_010.en:
Even special forces...
Then, now that we know, are we
going to disappear too?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_011.en:
We don't even know what it was,
so I doubt it'll come to that...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_012.en:
Awww, if it's going there anyway,
I want a mysterious plot twist...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_013.en:
No. The fact is, we can't rule it
out either.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_015.en:
C-Captain...
Don't scare me like that...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_016.en:
Better to assume that's the kind
of work we do.
Call it a matter of mindset.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_017.en:
Right.
We just stick to the mission.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_018.en:
Huh! So then there really IS alien
technology!?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_019.en:
That ain't what we're talkin'
about...
Oddeye, you weren't listening to
the Captain at all...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_020.en:
Her train of thought jumps the
tracks sometimes, this one...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_021.en:
Ah, Rain just said something mean
about me...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_022.en:
We may run into classified material
again.
I'll be careful from now on.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_023.en:
A mission, then.
I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_024.en:
Well, can't unsee what we saw.
Alright, I'll work out till I
forget it...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_025.en:
Sortie time?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_026.en: We just stick to the mission.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_028.en:
Hmm, but a little mystery now and
then is nice, isn't it?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_029.en:
Oh, a sortie!
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_030.en:
(That cargo... Gray, Rain and I are
one thing, but Oddeye and Champ
seeing it may have been a mistake.)
(They still think like civilians.
I'll have to drill confidentiality
into them.)

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_032.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Gabriel hasn't been coming by the
barracks lately.
He's a bit gloomy, but he's not a
bad guy, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_033.en:
Word is Gabriel's been holed up in
his room whenever he's off shift.
Said something about his clan...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_034.en:
We've had reports that enemy
remnants, routed by another merc
unit, are regrouping in the
Kydin Jungle.
«E801:00» Squad, go mop them up.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_035.en:
Roger.
...Remnants.
They shouldn't be much of a threat,
but they could link up with a
relief force.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_036.en:
Right. Five or six machines still
able to fight, at most.
Wipe them out before they link up
with any relief force.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_037.en:
Roger.
But I've heard rumors that other
units have gone missing in that
area lately. Any intel?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_038.en:
Hm.
You keep your ear to the ground,
I'll give you that.
It's true reports of losses to a
third party in that sector have
gone up since the last recovery op.
Probably armed guerrillas stealing
weapons, but it could affect the
mission.
You'd do well to be very careful
out there.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_039.en:
Roger.
We'll need repair gear.
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_040.en:
Losses in that sector are up.
Probably armed guerrillas stealing
weapons.
You'd do well to be very careful
out there.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_001.en:
We've reached the area where the
enemy remnants are hiding.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_002.en:
Lots of trees here.
Oh, is that them?
Enemy unit spotted ahead.
Doesn't look like a big force.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_003.en:
A platoon with some vehicles mixed
in. Should be an easy one.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_004.en:
Yeah, but it's always the easy ones
where things go sideways.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_006.en:
I heard there's bandits roaming
around here!

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_007.en:
Bandits...?
What are bandits going to do
against a wanzer?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_008.en:
They're not bandits, but...
The rumors about losses to a third
party are true.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_009.en:
Either way, we sweep the area fast.
All units, stay sharp.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_015.en:
Gray, first round's the second we
get back.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_016.en:
And it's on you, of course, right,
Champ?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_017.en:
Huh? What's that!?
...Are those the bandits?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_018.en:
There were still wanzers left?
All units, ammo holding out?
We hit what's left, right now.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_019.en:
Wait.
It's that large machine we fought
before... and two machines that
aren't in our data!

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_020.en:
His buddies, huh...
Tch. Gray, drinks'll have to wait!

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_021.en:
Roger that, Champ...
But what unit are they from...?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_022.en:
These may be our "bandits."
They've already shown hostile
intent.
All units, stay alert and intercept
the unknowns.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_024.en:
...Target confirmed.
...All units. They're in standard
wanzers, but their pilots are
high-level.
Don't hold back.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_026.en:
Good old Lich.
Lured them right out for us.
All units, watch the leader's
machine.
This doubles as a field test of our
units. Avoid wear where you can.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_028.en:
...So that's why Lich has his eye
on them.
We'll take the target another time.
Fall back.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_029.en: I still have plenty left, you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_030.en: This time, the data's all we need.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_035.en:
...So that's why Lich has his eye
on them.
We'll take the target another time.
Fall back.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_037.en:
No problem.
I've got all the data I need.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_039.en:
...Output dropping.
This machine's still not worth

Relax.

Try pulling the trigger.

breathing and pull in one go.
Otherwise you'll jerk the trigger,
and you won't hit anything.

Shooting takes technique and
practice.

Practice until you can do the whole
sequence in under three seconds.

with wanzer gunnery too.

Why not each put in a request?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_024.en:
A request, hm...
Maybe ordering wanzer parts should
come first after all.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_025.en:
Another attack!?
Understood, I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_026.en: Wish they'd give us mercs a raise...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_027.en:
Enemy mercs cashing in on our bad
luck, huh...
Alright, gearing up!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_028.en:
Permission to take a wanzer, or new
parts... Can't I ask for both?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_029.en:
Huh? A different unit this time?
Our base sure has made a lot of
enemies...
I'll get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_030.en:
If we all ask together, maybe
they'll approve something...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_031.en:
When it rains, it pours...
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_032.en:
My, they really did a number on
this place...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_034.en:
I heard the base was attacked, so
I came to see. It's terrible.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_035.en:
I've already reported what we know
about the enemy to the Commander.
They clearly came after this base,
so we should suspect a link to
Alchemist.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_036.en:
Yes, I reported that too.
But our border inspection mission
has been wound up.
So I came by to say goodbye to
Commander Falcon.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_037.en:
What? Why?
Even a Border Guard merc base has
been attacked...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_038.en:
They said it's the regular army's
job from here on...
But... going by how things have
gone so far, I wouldn't expect
much.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_039.en:
Something about this feels really
off.
I think I'm starting to hate the
military.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_040.en:
Anyone in a department that handles
secrets ends up like that.
I wouldn't let it get to you.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_041.en:
Gray's right, Rain.
Don't let it get to you.
We'll meet again.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_042.en:
Oh, yes.
I'm fine.
Thank you.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_043.en:
You heard about Peter?
When the missiles came down, he
just happened to be checking the
radar...
A direct hit, they say.
Nothing left of him... Dammit!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_044.en:
...Yuji... has gone on leave...
The maintenance crew... new gear
arrived at a time like this...
they're swamped...
No wonder... they're grumbling...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_045.en:
The base is currently repairing the
facilities destroyed in the recent
battle and redeploying personnel
and equipment.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_046.en:
With pilots and mechanics roped in
to help.
You can hear the staff grumbling
from here.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_047.en:
With all that going on, we still
put your wanzers first in line for
maintenance. I'd like a little
gratitude for that.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_048.en: I assume you had your reasons.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_049.en:
Well, naturally.
We've had word that an enemy unit,
small but real, is deploying near
this base.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_050.en:
Making a move now...
Is it that unit?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_051.en:
Apparently not.
It's an enemy merc unit looking to
hit us while we're rebuilding.
The base's weapons and facilities
are down for repairs.
Your squad is pretty much our only
fighting force.
So I want you to guard the base
while repairs are under way.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_052.en: So what are we likely facing?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_053.en:
Attacking in this situation, at
this timing... most likely a force
built around the large wanzers for
taking strongpoints that are being
sent to the front.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_055.en:
This time I'll be directing the op
as well.
Large wanzers haven't been in service
long.
Estimating their operating time
from your combat data, the large
wanzers should break off and withdraw
at around 10 turns.
Hold until then, whatever it takes.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_056.en:
So we build the large wanzers running
out of stamina into the plan.
Roger.
Starting sortie prep.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_057.en:
This time I'll be directing the op
as well.
Large wanzers haven't been in service
long.
Estimating their operating time
from your combat data, the large
wanzers should break off and withdraw
at around 10 turns.
Hold until then, whatever it takes.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_058.en:
...So Berserker's team failed too.
They were supposed to be the best
the Numbers had...
Can't be helped.
Best to keep clear of that squad
for a while.
Tch. Bullet «E801:00»...
Still getting in my way, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_001.en:
Enemy mobile force approaching.
Right now, this base is as good as
naked.
If they get inside, we're done for.
«E801:00» Squad, I'm counting on you.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_002.en:
Roger.
As planned, we hold for 10 turns.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_003.en:
Hey, Commander, Gray says if we hold
the line, you'd better make the
bonus a fat one!

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_004.en:
You're the one who said you wanted
better food in the barracks, Champ!

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_005.en: Oh, I'd like some time off~

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_006.en:
And please put in the order for new
