parts while you're at it.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_007.en:
...Understood.
I'll give it... positive
consideration, as far as possible...

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_009.en:
Victory: Defend the base for
10 turns.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_011.en:
Enemy unit silenced.
No remaining enemy signatures.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_013.en:
Alright!
Good grub, here we come!
Gray, start thinking how you'll
spend that bonus!

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_014.en: My first time off in ages~

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_015.en:
Falcon.
The rest is up to you.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_016.en:
Y-yes, well...
I suppose there's no way around it.
I'll put in requests with each
department...

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_018.en:
Mission complete.
Falcon.
I'll be expecting good news about
the success bonus.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_019.en:
Y-yes, well...
I'll do my best...

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_001.en: Captain, do you have any leave plans?

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_002.en:
Nowhere to go, nowhere to go back to.
I'll stand by at the base.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_003.en:
Oh, I see...
The other three seem to have left
Huffman already.
I can't decide whether to go home
myself... Shall I stay, if you need me?

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_004.en:
The base is half shut down for repairs.
We have no work, and if the enemy
does attack, some other unit will
have to deal with them.
Go home, Rain. Get some rest.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_005.en:
I see...
Going home is such a bother, though...
Everyone asking what I plan to do
with my future, and so on...

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_007.en:
I know that, but...
Mine's a military family, and they
don't approve of me being a merc.
Sigh...
And now they've even started
talking about arranged marriages...

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_008.en:
Some people live only for
their parents' sake.
Others follow the path they
believe in.
Which one is up to you, Rain.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_010.en: Well then, I'll be off home.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_011.en:
(I must have got used to the noise.
The quiet feels wrong.)
(Before I came here, it was
the other way around...)

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_012.en:
(Leave, huh.
Not that I have any plans...)

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_013.en:
(A new weapons test.
Should help pass the time.)

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_014.en:
You «E801:00»?
Shresh, maintenance crew.
I'm takin' over your machine today.
Heard you're rough on 'em, but
I'll keep it runnin' as sweet as
Peter did. Don't you worry.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_015.en:
Huh? Shresh reminds you of Peter?
Well, same crew, same overalls,
I guess.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_016.en:
...Going on leave... with Matt...
for a while...
See you...

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_017.en:
A company that backs our merc corps
wants to borrow a pilot to trial
some prototype parts.
Sorry to cut into your leave, but
you're the man for the job.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_018.en:
I was running out of ways to kill
time anyway.
So, what's the new weapon?

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_019.en:
Melee gear, I'm told.
Get the details on site.
Their technician, Lycov, is waiting
at the weapons-test Killhouse.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_021.en:
That's right.
And all the cover's been cleared out.
Go knock that technician's socks off.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_023.en:
All the cover's been cleared out.
Go knock that technician's socks off.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_001.en:
Thank you so much for taking part.
Today we'll be testing a new weapon.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_002.en:
Understood.
I was told I can use live ammo?

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_003.en:
Yes, by all means.
And the targets carrying the new
weapon are unmanned.
Our staff will fly them by radio,
so please don't hold back.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_005.en:
Well then, I look forward to some
lovely data.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_007.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_009.en:
Data recording nominal.
No problems at all.
(Though this pilot's reactions are
almost too good...)
I'll send out the next target.
Is that all right?

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_011.en:
All targets cleared!
...M-marvellous...
Um... that's a remarkable score.
So, er, what did you think?
How does the new weapon feel?

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_012.en:
The recoil into the arm looks heavy.
Joint damage will probably build up
fast.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_013.en:
(This is no ordinary pilot...)
Ah -- I see, very helpful.
I'll have it adjusted by next time.
That concludes the test menu.
Thank you for your hard work.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_004.en: Oddeye. What happened to your leave?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_005.en:
Mmm~.
Well... there weren't any events on
in Tokyo this time of year, so
I came straight back.
Oh, Captain, here's a souvenir!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_007.en:
Canned oden!
I've got canned ramen too, if you'd
rather have that?
I bought them for myself, but you
can pick whichever you like.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_010.en:
You know your classics, Captain!
If you say Akiba, you say
canned oden.
I just knew you'd love it!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_011.en:
Is that so.
...I'll share it with the Commander
later.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_013.en:
Go ahead, go ahead! I've ordered
a whole box for myself, so it's fine.
That one's a sample, though.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_014.en:
It's close to its use-by date.
I'll share it with the Commander
later.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_015.en:
By the way, Captain, were you at
the base this whole time?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_016.en:
I was.
I helped out with a new weapons test.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_017.en:
!!
You got a juicy job like that!?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_018.en:
Juicy...?
Well, the pay was decent enough.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_019.en:
No fair~.
I want to test new weapons too!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_020.en:
The technician should still be here.
They may call on us again.
If they do, I'll put your name
forward.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_021.en:
Wow, thank you!
I'm so glad I came back early!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_022.en: I'm so glad I came back early!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_023.en: Is it time for the weapons test yet~?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_024.en:
Captain «E801:00», isn't it?
Thank you so much for the other day.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_025.en: It helped me pass the time, too.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_026.en:
My, but you're skilled, Captain
«E801:00».
I'd always thought Captain Sarna of
Chariot Squad was the very best,
but you seem to be a cut above.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_027.en:
Chariot Squad.
I hear they're a very capable unit.
I've met their captain a few times.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_028.en:
Oho, you're acquainted?
Captain Sarna is strong, beautiful...
an altogether marvellous person.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_029.en:
Though I sense she's hiding
something.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_030.en:
Ah, but that air of mystery is
marvellous too.
...Wait, don't tell me, Captain
«E801:00» -- is that your type?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_031.en:
No. That's not what I meant.
Comrades on the same battlefield
are neither men nor women.
On the front line, you can't afford
feelings like that.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_032.en:
Well, well. What admirable
egalitarianism, I suppose...
Oh, that reminds me. I've just put
a request in with HQ: I'd love you
to join another test.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_033.en:
Roger.
I'll go and talk to the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_034.en: I'd love you to join another test.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_035.en:
Peter and me... we were best mates...
The old so-and-so was upgradin'
a weapon for you.
Take it. Think of it as somethin'
to remember him by.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_036.en:
Captain «E801:00», sorry to interrupt
your leave, but I've got work for you.
Hm? What's this?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_037.en:
A souvenir from Oddeye, apparently.
Want to try some?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_038.en:
Hmm.
...Not bad at all.
Cute design on the can, too.
...Might be better heated up, though.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_040.en:
Right.
Another request to test new parts.
They asked for you by name, no less.
Quite the popular fella, aren't you?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_041.en:
I ran into Lycov in the barracks,
but didn't ask for details.
What's it this time?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_042.en:
All I've been told is it's a backpack
test under combat conditions.
They want two pilots: you and
a Launcher.
For this weapon, Oddeye's the
obvious pick.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_043.en:
Good. I was going to recommend her.
Can we make a request of our own?
I'd like them to leave the cover in.
Otherwise it'll be over too fast.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_044.en:
They've already taken that into
account, I'm told.
They'll probably change the targets,
too.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_046.en:
It's a backpack test under combat
conditions.
Take Oddeye along with you.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_001.en:
Thank you so much for joining us
again.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_002.en: I heard this was a backpack test?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_003.en:
You'll be fighting an improved model
with a tuned engine.
Please go all out, just like last time.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_004.en:
Roger.
Oddeye, you heard him.
Treat it as real combat.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_005.en:
Roger!
But are you sure?
We might break it, you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_006.en:
No need to hold back.
Collecting data is the whole point.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_007.en:
I see~.
Seems kind of a waste, though.
Oh! If we get a good score, could
I have some spare parts to play with?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_008.en:
Certainly.
Given a good enough score, they're
yours.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_009.en:
Yay!
Then I'm not holding back!

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_014.en:
Target Alpha, all units inactive.
Activating Target Beta.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_016.en:
All targets cleared.
Data collection nominal.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_018.en:
Outstanding.
This much combat data is an enormous
help!

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_019.en:
Looks like heat dissipation is a bit
better than the old type.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_020.en:
Oh? You noticed?
That's exactly what we improved!
That concludes the trial.
As promised, I'll add some parts to
your reward.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_022.en:
Yes.
It took a little while, didn't it?
But thanks to you, we got our data.
Thank you for your hard work.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_024.en:
...Ah, I'm terribly sorry.
The spare parts appear to be
broken...

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_025.en:
Aww...
Oh, I don't mind junk parts!

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_026.en:
No, we'll be using these to make
improvements...
I'll bring you working ones next time.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_001.en:
Captain, was there any trouble
while I was on leave?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_003.en:
I see.
Oh, here's a souvenir from home.
It's tea. I'll brew some later.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_005.en:
Come to think of it, I wonder if the
teapot I ordered has arrived...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_006.en:
A mission, then.
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_007.en:
So the base got a makeover.
More like they put it back the way
it was than built anything new, huh.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_008.en:
It's a stopgap, but it looks almost
back to normal.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_009.en:
I got three lazy days on a beach in
Malaysia.
Now I'm so sunburnt it hurts all
over...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_011.en:
Look, Captain, see?
It's peelin' a little, right here...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_013.en:
Well, I'm in top condition all year,
so it don't show much.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_016.en:
We're movin' out?
All right -- let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_017.en:
Captain, I've been wondering for
a while... what's that tattoo on your
arm? A dagger motif seems kind of
special forces-y.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_019.en:
Ooh.
It looks like a bat! It's cute!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_020.en:
BATS...
I've never heard of that unit, though.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_021.en:
Even you've never heard of it, Gray?
And you were special forces!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_022.en:
It was special forces, of a sort, but
"special experimental agency" is
closer to the truth.
We had almost no contact with other
special forces or regular troops.
It's been disbanded, and the records
are surely classified.
Best not to spread this around.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_024.en:
A special experimental agency...
That sounds so cool...
And you hardly ever talk, Captain,
so it's even more mysterious!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_025.en:
Hey, hey, Oddeye...
Let's leave it there.
You're putting the Captain on the spot.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_026.en:
Oh, sorry...
Whenever I hear "special forces",
I just get so curious...
Oh, um... While we're at it, shall
I tell you about my background too!?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_028.en: Rain's not here, so now's our chance.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_029.en:
Why Rain?«g:24»
Oh, the rule about past jobs.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_030.en:
...The truth is, I used to be an
operator in the Japan Defense Force!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_031.en:
Oh?
No wonder your battlefield
observation is so accurate.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_032.en:
Yes, I did radar watch on a certain
island.
I actually joined the Japanese
police first, but...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_033.en:
Huh.
The police, huh.
That seems a long way from wanzers.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_034.en:
As a detective I'd get to fire a gun,
and nab the bad guy, and shout
"Suspect secured!"...
But they posted me to the traffic
division instead of criminal
investigations.
I wanted to work closer to mechs and
weapons anyway, so I switched to
the JDF.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_035.en:
...That's watching too many cop
shows, or impure motives, or...
But neither of those is exactly easy
to get into, is it?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_036.en:
No.
I've heard JDF operator standards are
stricter than other countries'.
At least eight languages for
communication... or so I heard...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_037.en:
Oh, the exam was like that, but on
the job it's mostly English. If you
can use some Korean, Russian, French
and Spanish now and then, you're fine.
I understand around sixteen
languages, so they found me handy!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_038.en:
(...Is she actually some kind of
genius...?)
I see.
And then you went merc to get even
closer to mechs and weapons...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_039.en:
Mm-hm.
That's about the size of it.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_040.en:
Since we're sharing, I'll tell you
what I can...
I think I've mentioned it before:
back then, I got my unit wiped out.
But whenever I try to remember that
time, I get a splitting headache...
In that unit, I was mostly a wanzer
test pilot.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_041.en:
...What is it with those headaches,
I wonder.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_042.en:
A test pilot...
That's why you're so good at piloting
wanzers...
I'm sorry, Captain. I hope the
aftereffects clear up soon...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_043.en:
No.
Don't worry about it.
If anything, I'm sorry I had nothing
more interesting to tell.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_044.en:
The Captain's headaches... It must be
some really awful trauma...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_045.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_046.en:
Everyone's got a history,
I guess.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_048.en:
(When I'm alone, I remember that unit.)
(It gives me headaches, yet I had its
insignia inked on my shoulder so I'd
never forget. My head and my body
can't agree.)

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_049.en:
(Thinking about the past again...)
(But with everyone around, it's
easier to put out of mind.)

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_051.en:
Hey, pops. Whaddaya think you're
doin'?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_052.en:
Hm?«g:24»
Oh, you one of the mercs from this
base? As you can see, I'm helping
myself to some food.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_053.en:
Huhh? Pops, I ain't never seen your
mug around here. Who the hell are you?
What're you doin' raidin' the food
stores? And what's with that star?
You even brought a basket...
And how'd you unlock this place!?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_054.en:
Now, now, settle down.
I'm Thomas Norland, Lieutenant,
1st Army.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_055.en:
......
......
L-Lieutenant!?
S-s-s-sorry, sir!
Um, may I ask why the Lieutenant,
sir, requires the food, sir, if I may,
sir?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_056.en:
Ga-ha-ha!
Don't be so stiff.
Lieutenant or not, I'm not the boss
of you mercs.
Right now my unit's tracking a USN
recon unit that slipped into
OCU territory.
They're holed up near this base and
my boys are keeping watch, but
we've run out of food.
Yours was the nearest base, so we're
stocking up here.
Your commander unlocked it for me.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_057.en:
I see, sir...
Uh, should I get everyone to help
carry it, then?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_058.en:
Good attitude, but no need.
A basket of rations like this'll
do us fine.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_059.en:
Oh, right, sir...
Uh, I was on my way to the john, so...
I'll be goin' now...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_060.en:
Ga-ha-ha!
Holding it in's bad for your health,
merc.
If we get the chance, we'll meet again.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_061.en:
You know about the anti-air units
that've been knocking down friendly
supply transports lately?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_062.en:
Yes.
Not a day of my leave went by
without it on the news.
They're making quite a show of it.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_063.en:
The brass have located their main
force.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_064.en:
Losing all that cargo has HQ
desperate, then.
Where are they?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_065.en:
The site of an abandoned mining plant
in the Parunta Desert.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_066.en:
An anti-air unit.
Mostly anti-aircraft weapons, then.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_067.en:
Right.
Hit them by surprise under cover of
a sandstorm, and they're not much
of a threat.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_068.en:
And if we find stolen cargo or
containers?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_069.en:
The mission is to wipe out the enemy,
but if you can manage it, recover
the stolen cargo.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_070.en:
If it pays.
Roger.
We'll sortie once we're equipped.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_071.en:
The mission is to wipe out the enemy,
but if you can manage it, recover
the stolen cargo.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_001.en: That looks like the old plant.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_003.en:
As expected, the unit is built around
surface-to-air weapons.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_004.en: Not many of them, for a main force.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_005.en:
Probably got chewed up in their last
fight.
Either way, this one's a cakewalk.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_006.en:
Anti-air gear won't do much against
wanzers.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_012.en:
A black wanzer?
...Identifying...
No doubt about it.
It's the same type as the unit that
attacked our base!
Huh?
That machine's carrying a katana!!

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_013.en: It seems to be operating alone.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_015.en:
Two enemies at once is trouble.
Avoid engaging that machine as far
as possible.
Focus on the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_017.en:
...I see. An obedient unit.
Let us see what you are capable of.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_018.en:
That machine...
It seems to be after the same
targets we are.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_019.en:
Huh. Then maybe we'll save some
ammo.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_020.en:
No.
It won't hurt the operation, but
it'll cut into our pay.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_022.en: That bastard... He's poachin' our kills!

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_027.en: So he ducked out of a real slugfest...

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_031.en: The black wanzer is withdrawing too.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_032.en:
Still, that firepower...
And a katana... What a machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_033.en:
It's tuned differently from the ones
that attacked the base...
And that katana...
Or is it more of a sword...?
So cool...

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_034.en:
It was after the same targets as us.
What's going on...?
Mission complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_036.en:
Roger.
Any sign of the black wanzer?

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_038.en:
Still, that firepower...
And a katana...
What a machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_039.en:
It's tuned differently from the ones
that attacked the base...
And that katana...
Or is it more of a sword...?
So cool...

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_040.en:
It was after the same targets as us.
What's going on...?
Mission complete. Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_001.en:
Captain, would you like to have lunch
together?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_002.en: Sorry. I already had a ration.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_003.en:
Rations again...
By the way, what came of that enemy
from the last mission?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_004.en:
The Commander reported it up to the
brass.
I hear the regular army's
investigations department is on it.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_005.en:
So it didn't end with the unit that
attacked the base after all...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_007.en:
Then please join me for a meal
another time.
I could cook, if you like.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_008.en:
A mission, then.
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_009.en:
Hey, Captain, wanna eat some meat
with me?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_011.en:
Aw, too bad.
Got some prime cuts sent from home
yesterday. I'm havin' the kitchen
grill 'em up right now.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_012.en:
Sounds good.
Let me join you tomorrow, then.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_013.en:
Thing is, I'm treatin' the hangar
guys who hauled the meat in, too.
If there's any left by tomorrow...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_014.en:
I see.
Don't worry about it.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_017.en:
We're movin' out?
All right -- let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_022.en:
Oh, that one!
The cocoa's secretly really good,
isn't it!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_024.en:
I like the Type A beans and the
Type E noodles!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_025.en:
The noodles aren't bad, I'll admit.
Oddeye, don't you eat regular meals?
Nobody here makes you live on
issue rations.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_026.en:
I do eat them.
But there aren't many dishes I like
on this base's menu...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_027.en:
Hm.
A ration habit isn't a bad thing for
a mercenary.
You have a lot of interests, it seems.
Rations included?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_028.en:
Hehe.
You got me!
The Type E noodles especially taste
just like the ramen I had in Tokyo.
I could eat those every day.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_029.en:
I see.
Even I'd struggle with the same
ration every day.
You must really like them.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_030.en:
I had ramen every single day on
my leave, too!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_031.en:
Sigh.
I want to go back and eat more...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_032.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_033.en:
Captain, if you haven't eaten yet,
want to join me?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_035.en:
Oh, I see.
That was quick.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_036.en: Why not ask Rain or Champ?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_037.en:
...Eh, Rain's scary, and Champ keeps
nagging me to eat meat...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_041.en:
I will not be called scary!
If everyone just did their cleaning
and tidying properly, I wouldn't have
to say a word...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_042.en:
Gray.
People are difficult, aren't they.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_043.en: I didn't think they'd hear me...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_045.en:
(That wanzer last time was after the
same targets, yet it never really
fought us.
What was it actually after...?
And the brass say they'll look into it,
but they still won't treat it as
a case...)

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_046.en:
(Everyone relaxes more than
necessary at mealtimes.)

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_048.en:
Heard the OCU Navy's got a big
exercise comin' up.
...You don't suppose they're startin'
another war on this island, do ya?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_049.en:
Shresh has been brooding a lot since
Peter died.
Maybe it finally hit him that even
the maintenance crew's on a
battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_050.en:
...Eating this much......
making a big fuss...
I'm going to shit fury.....

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_051.en:
The Arena...
Put simply, it's wanzer battles you
bet on...
We've had a request from its
organizing committee.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_052.en:
That thing the whole island's been
talking about?
We take jobs from people like that?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_053.en:
Hm.
Wanzer parts makers, army scouts and
Huffman's local government all have
a stake in the Arena business.
On paper it's a committee request,
but really it's the same as an army
order.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_055.en:
Lately someone's been attacking
wanzers entered in the Arena.
They want you lot to track down
these thugs and take them out.
Witnesses say the culprits are a wanzer
team of four or five machines.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_056.en:
Hm.
If they're going after Arena wanzers,
they must be very good, or very
heavily armed... I'd guess.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_057.en:
Right. Going by the scraps of intel,
there's a good chance it's the same
lot that attacked the base.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_058.en:
Roger.
We'll sortie once we're equipped.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_059.en:
Someone's attacking Arena-entered
wanzers.
I want you to track down these thugs
and take them out.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_001.en:
This is the materials yard for the
arena under construction.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_002.en:
Hm?
Are those Arena wanzers?
There are a few of them.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_003.en:
Ooh!
Now those are Arena wanzers.
So flashy!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_004.en:
Heh, they look like fighters before
a bout.
Maybe I'll enter myself sometime.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_005.en:
They've even got corporate emblems
painted on.
Like race cars with legs.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_007.en:
Hmm~.
Nothing just now... wait, huh?
I've got a signal!
It's a black wanzer!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_008.en:
What?...
The Arena wanzers are under attack!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_009.en:
That's two down.
Huh?
They've still got guard wanzers?

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_011.en:
Arena wanzers are supposed to be tuned
up...
And they took them down that easily...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_012.en:
Damn.
Five of 'em, huh...
Now I'm gettin' pissed off!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_013.en:
All right. We take them down before
any more Arena wanzers get hurt.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_015.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_017.en:
Tch, these moves ain't no security
guards!
It's a merc unit... Merc-hunting
ain't even my job, dammit!
Ogre team here...
Requesting Numbers backup...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_018.en:
Ogre, what is the matter?
My machine appears to be the closest
to your position.
I am on my way.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_020.en:
Enemy reinforcements confirmed.
Another black wanzer.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_021.en:
That katana...
I've seen that machine before.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_022.en:
(...So this time it is chance.)
Ogre. What have you been doing?

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_023.en:
Hey...
Nobody said nothin' about mercs
guardin' 'em!
My team can't take any more of this!!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_025.en:
...B-but we ain't bagged an Arena
pilot yet today!
You handle the mercs, Dark Knight!
My team'll grab the Arena machines!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_028.en:
(Ogre, you fool...
You do not intend to return.
...Very well.
As a wanzer pilot, I shall test my own
skill as well.)

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_030.en:
Are they... fighting each other,
or something...?

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_031.en:
Either way, we've still got one more
tough enemy on our hands.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_032.en:
Hold him off while we hit the unit
that attacked the Arena.
All units, don't let them escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_035.en:
Ogre...
So this is what comes of ignoring
the order to return...
Though going back empty-handed would
have ended the same.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_037.en:
(...A worthy opponent.
It seems I have been granted a fine
battle.)

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_038.en:
Ah, the katana guy's pulling out,
you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_040.en: That machine fights like a samurai...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_041.en:
Hmph.
Anytime you want a rematch, pal!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_043.en:
Roger.
The culprits have been eliminated.
Looks like the mission's complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_044.en:
(He slipped past my attacks and
wiped out Ogre's team...
Such power... Heh heh heh.)

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_001.en: Captain, do you use the base ARENA?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_002.en:
Now and then.
It's good training, and a change
of pace.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_003.en:
That's true.
We saw one on our last mission:
the major cities on Huffman are
all building big Arena stadiums.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_004.en:
Apparently the rules are almost the
same as the base ARENA.
Still, an entertainment venue built
around wanzers...

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_005.en:
If private companies run places like
the Arena, it might shake off the
wanzer's image as a weapon of war.
That could be a happier fate for
them, don't you think?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_006.en:
I see.
That's one way to look at it.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_007.en:
If private companies run places like
the Arena, it might shake off the
wanzer's image as a weapon of war.
That could be a happier fate for
them, don't you think?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_008.en:
A mission, then.
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_009.en:
Captain, I'm headin' over to the
ARENA for a bit.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_011.en:
Trainin' for the civilian Arena.
The fight money's pretty sweet.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_013.en:
Word is a lot of the entry wanzers
have real good pilots.
Why don't you sign up too, Captain?
For me, it's the crowd, the buzz in
there... nothin' else like it.
Aight, I'm off!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_014.en:
Don't let it get in the way of
your duties.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_015.en: Aight, I'm off to the base ARENA!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_016.en:
What, we're movin' out?
Fine -- I'll go wild out there instead!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_017.en:
Oh, Captain, I've got a question about
wanzer one-on-ones...

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_019.en:
Yes, exactly.
My machine is set up mainly for
long range, but I can't decide!
Should I keep a sharp, pure
long-range build, or cover my blind
spots up close and go all-rounder?
I've been agonizing over it...
Which do you think is better?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_020.en:
...In real combat, you work with
the rest of us.
A bit of specialization pays off there.
But fighting alone may be a different
story.
If you can use your skills reliably,
though, you can expect a one-sided
fight.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_021.en:
I see~.
It really is deep!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_022.en:
Should I keep a sharp, pure
long-range build, or cover my blind
spots up close and go all-rounder?
I've been agonizing over it...

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_023.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_024.en: Captain, do you use the ARENA?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_025.en:
Now and then.
It's good training, and a change
of pace.
It seems to be catching on in
our squad.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_026.en:
It's a pretty good system, the ARENA.
Maybe it's from seeing that flashy
civilian Arena the other day, but
everyone's really fired up.
If that catches on, it could change
the whole wanzer industry.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_027.en:
True.
With private companies behind it,
wanzer parts technology and piloting
skills should both improve.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_028.en:
The Arena's entry pilots, the really
good ones anyway, might get scouted
by the army.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_029.en:
It's possible.
Even a merc who runs out of work on
the battlefield might keep fed by
entering the Arena.
Looked at that way, it works in our
favor too.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_030.en:
It's nothing like real combat, but
it's the same wanzers at heart.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_031.en:
It's a pretty good system, the ARENA.
With these flashy civilian Arenas,
the wanzer industry's bound to change.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_033.en:
Think about it.
Why're they shippin' mountains of
weapons and food here from home?
This base could never eat all that.
And the weapons... there's enough to
wipe out a USN base or two on this
island, every last man.
I'm tellin' ya, somethin's up.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_034.en:
The Arena's great, isn't it?
The sound of machine slamming into
machine... can't get enough of it.
By the way, I hear the prize money
for the base ARENA comes from the
Arena committee.
Rumor is, they want us to train on
that system and then enter the Arena.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_035.en:
...Come to think of it...
I never got... a souvenir from
Oddeye...

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_046.en:
Two urgent missions just came in.
One: stop a bombing at the Arena.
Two: rescue a team of journalists.
Whichever you pass on goes to
another unit.
So pick whichever you like, no need
to worry about the other.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_047.en:
Stopping the Arena bombing, then.
You know Arena construction is wrapping
up all over the island?
The anti-Arena groups aren't taking it
quietly.
Things were always tense, but now
they've finally turned to force.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_048.en:
Anti-Arena groups turning to force...
Those groups opposing the damage the
stadiums do to the environment?
I thought they were a peaceful lot.
What are they threatening to do?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_049.en:
Mm.
The Arena organizing committee just
received a bomb threat.
Get to the site fast and stop it from
going off.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_051.en:
Their gear's outdated, but the
anti-Arena groups have wanzers too,
apparently.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_052.en: Not much of a fighting force, then.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_053.en:
Seems not.
A bomb disposal team is going with
you. Disarm the planted bombs with
their disposal vehicle while you
wipe out the enemy wanzers.
But they're desperate. Enemy
reinforcements are possible.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_054.en:
A bomb threat means we don't have
much time.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_055.en:
Going by the deadline they gave, if
you head out now you'll have about
15 turns to work with.
Will you take this mission?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_056.en:
We'll take it.
There's no time before it goes off.
This one's urgent.
We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_058.en:
Rescuing the journalists, then.
Three days ago, a team of journalists
went silent in territory we control.
But this morning we picked up a
distress signal from their vehicle.
I want you to bring them out.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_059.en:
This needs wanzers?
Sending a vehicle or a chopper to
pick them up seems smarter.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_060.en:
It's our territory, but there are
reports of armed guerrillas sighted
in the area the signal's coming from.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_061.en: That sort are still roaming around?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_062.en:
It never hurts to have journalists
and the press on our side.
Get out there and help them, fast.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_063.en:
Say we secure the journalists. Do they
have a way out?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_064.en:
Their vehicle seems to be drivable.
The signal's on the move.
Just get that vehicle to the extraction
point.
Will you take this mission?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_065.en:
We'll take it.
The press may well be the greatest
weapon of all...
This one's urgent. We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_067.en:
Both are urgent, but whichever you
pass on goes to another unit.
One: stop a bombing at the Arena.
Two: rescue a team of journalists.
Pick whichever you like, no need to
worry about the other.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_068.en:
We'll take it.
There's no time before it goes off.
This one's urgent.
We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_069.en:
I see.
The press may well be the greatest
weapon of all...
This one's urgent. We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_001.en:
Anti-Arena forces sighted.
Five wanzers, old models.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_002.en:
Where's the bomb?
Can we even search for it from a
wanzer...? Wait, don't tell me that
container's...?

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_003.en:
Yes.
That container is most likely the
time bomb.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_004.en:
Oh, you're right.
I'm picking up a timer signal.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_006.en:
To the bomb disposal team.
The container is a time bomb.
Request you disarm it.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_007.en:
Roger.
We'll close on the container and take
out the timer.
Cover us.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_008.en:
Roger.
We'll escort the bomb disposal team
and wipe out the enemy machines.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_010.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies, or
disarm all the bombs.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_014.en: Old junk, but a whole lotta it.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_016.en:
Damn. Without the disposal vehicle,
we can't disarm the time bombs...

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_017.en:
Worst case, we smash the container
with a wanzer?

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_018.en:
That's enough explosive to level a
building, you know?
Do that and every last one of us gets
blown to pieces.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_019.en:
Rain, can you get another disposal
vehicle sent?

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_020.en:
They say they can send one.
But losing a vehicle apparently means
a penalty on our expenses...

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_021.en:
Ugh.
I ain't workin' at a loss...

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_022.en:
If you want to get paid, protect
the disposal vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_024.en:
Remaining enemy forces are disarming.
Looks like they're surrendering.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_027.en:
Roger.
The rest is up to the disposal team.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_030.en:
We took too long.
All units, withdraw from the area now.
Don't get caught in the blast.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_001.en:
Oh?
So Champ got into the Arena.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_002.en:
Champ's used to big fights.
He might go further than anyone
expects, don't you think?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_003.en:
It was the Striker division,
wasn't it? So he got leave!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_004.en:
With that match schedule he needed
a decent block of time, so he put in
for leave with the Captain and the
Commander. Figured it was a long shot.
...Oh, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_006.en:
Yes! It'd be so great if one of our
own became a champion!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_007.en:
Uh, Oddeye...
Champ already IS a champ.
Of fighting.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_008.en:
But that's at human level, right?
A wanzer champion is way cooler.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_009.en:
"Human level"...
What about all of Champ's hard work
and glory...?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_010.en:
If fighting in the Arena sharpens
his wanzer combat skills, the squad
benefits too. I gave Champ the OK.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_011.en:
Go, Champ!
Win it all and become the one true
Champ!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_013.en:
What? Champ...?
Understood.
I'll prepare to sortie...

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_014.en:
Go, Champ!
Win it all and become the one true
Champ!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_015.en:
What!? Champ is...!?
I'll get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_016.en:
Knowing Champ, he could go pretty
far.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_017.en:
What could've happened to Champ...
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_018.en:
Captain, hear me out.
This OCU Navy exercise is a cover.
They're usin' it to ship even more
supplies onto the island.
A buddy of mine in Barinden says
the port's in an uproar, so there's
no doubt about it.
I'm tellin' ya, a war's coming.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_019.en:
Shresh, calm down...
And quit spraying spit everywhere.
Oh, no Champ today?
Huh?
He's fighting in the Arena?
I had no idea.
Man, I'd have loved to see that.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_020.en:
......Even I can't... keep up with
...Shresh......
...Maybe I'll go look at...
the Keen Saber... in the hangar...

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_023.en:
You've heard Champ entered the
Arena while on leave?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_025.en:
After his Arena bout, he went
missing, wanzer and all.
He's a fine merc these days...
I want to know if he got caught up
in these missing-machine cases, or
if he deserted.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_026.en:
Champ...
Do we have any leads?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_027.en:
We do.
Because of the missing machines,
I've had every wanzer in this unit
fitted with a transmitter that gives
off a special ID signal. You knew that.
Go to the area where we last picked
up his signal.
There may be some clue there.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_028.en:
Hm?
The speed of this signal...
No sign of panic.
If anything, it's moving in step
with something...
Right. Either way, we'll check that
area.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_030.en:
Go to the area where we last picked
up his signal.
There may be some clue there.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_002.en:
Nothin'.
You stay on standby.
Cuttin' the line.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_004.en:
Now then... Hey, you! That wanzer!
You were in a match at the Arena
just now, weren't ya?
That's His Highness the Champion
in there, ain't it?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_005.en:
Figured you'd made me...
Thought I saw you at the Arena...
And you're in a black machine,
of all things!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_006.en:
Some champion up and retired on his
own, see... then the shows went
downhill and I got the axe.
And right when I was about to beat
you and pack the house!
Ain't that right, Stan!?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_007.en:
Hmph. A guy like you never stood a
chance against me in the ring!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_008.en:
That's ancient history!
Now we meet again, as enemies.
Let's settle this in our wanzers!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_009.en:
...You can't beat me there either.
I'll wrap this fight up quick, then
you're answering some questions!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_010.en:
Still runnin' your mouth like it's
mic time, huh!
That joke won't get any laughs.
And get this: this prototype knuckle,
the Destroyer, ain't no ordinary
piece of kit!«g:24»

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_013.en:
Champ's wanzer located.
...It appears to be engaging a black
machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_014.en: Hey, Champ, what are you doing!?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_015.en:
Tch, company...
(Hm? Looks like the squad that's got
the higher-ups all worked up...
So Stan's one of theirs...)
Hey, Stan. Don't let 'em spoil our
one-on-one, got it?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_016.en:
So the whole squad was out lookin'
for me...
Well, yeah, 'course you were...
Sorry, Captain!
I ran into somebody I know...
And he was ridin' a black machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_017.en:
Roger.
You can explain later.
Do you need help?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_018.en:
Nah, I got this.
This guy needs a lesson, and it's
gotta come from my own fists!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_019.en:
Hmph, gonna give me a show, huh?
Then in return, I'll set your pals
up with the Arena wanzers I hired.«g:24»

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_020.en:
I see.
I understand the situation.
The rest of us will clear out
anything that resists.
Champ, focus on your fight.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_022.en:
That's the Captain... I owe ya.
Champ, goin' in!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_023.en:
Can't beat you even in a wanzer...
I...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_024.en:
...I kept off your cockpit.
You can move, right, Ox?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_025.en:
Yeah, I'm alright.
But now they know who I am.
If I go back to the organization,
I'm a dead man...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_026.en:
Hmph.
Don't worry. We'll do right by you.
Come with us.
You're a merc too, ain't ya?
I'll introduce you to a new boss.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_027.en:
Now that's nice to hear.
But my contract fee ain't cheap,
ya know?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_028.en:
Hey, Ox, don't push your luck!
Jeez... same as ever.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_029.en:
...Well, since it's you, Champ,
I'll give 'em the bargain rate.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_030.en:
Ox...!?
The Ox Warrior...?
Now that's one heck of a matchup.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_031.en:
Oh, is he the one from Champ's fight
footage before?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_033.en:
Alright, Ox.
Back to base, and we drink. Yeah?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_034.en: Jeez, still a booze hound, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_035.en:
Hah... hah...
I finally beat you...
But this machine's had it too...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_036.en:
...Not bad at all.
Guess this side always suited
you better.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_037.en:
Hey, Stan?
You can bail out, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_038.en:
Yeah, no problem.
Got my squad here, too.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_039.en:
But now they know who I am.
If I go back to the organization,
I'm a dead man...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_040.en:
We'll do right by you.
Come with us.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_041.en:
I'm fond of breathin' too.
I'll do like you say.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_043.en:
But now they know who I am.
If I go back to the organization,
I'm a dead man...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_044.en:
Hmph. Don't worry.
We'll do right by you.
Come with us.
You're a merc too, ain't ya?
I'll introduce you to a new boss.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_045.en:
Now that's nice to hear.
But my contract fee ain't cheap,
ya know?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_046.en:
Hey, Ox, don't push your luck!
Jeez... same as ever.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_047.en:
...Well, since it's you, Champ,
I'll give 'em the bargain rate.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_048.en:
Ox...!?
The Ox Warrior...?
Now that's one heck of a matchup.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_049.en:
Oh, is he the one from Champ's fight
footage before?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_051.en:
Alright, Ox.
Back to base, and we drink. Yeah?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_052.en: Jeez, still a booze hound, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_056.en:
Captain!
Champ's opponent was attacked by
his own side...
A direct hit on the cockpit!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_058.en:
This is X-17 Manticore.
X-12 displayed suspicious behavior.
Judged as betrayal. Eliminated.
Recovering X-12's wreckage and
returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_059.en:
...Wh-what the...
...I've fought all kinds of guys...
but you bastards...
you'd shoot your own!?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_060.en:
...So this is the unit in question?
It can't even control its emotions.
...Hardly the material it was made
out to be.
Material of this grade is not needed.
You will be erased.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_061.en:
Captain, this large machine looks
like the same type we fought before.
Watch out for its firepower!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_062.en:
Roger.
All units, switch targets to the
large machine.
Champ, don't do anything rash.
We'll regroup and engage.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_064.en:
Output falling...
This unit is withdrawing from
the front...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_068.en:
Yeah, I can manage.
But Captain...
Before we go back, can I pick up his
machine?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_069.en:
Life signs in the wreckage!
The pilot is still alive!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_070.en:
Rescue the survivor and recover the
wreck. Quickly.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_071.en: Champ, I'll give you a hand.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_077.en:
What's with... that face... like
you're about to cry...
Sure is... cold today...
...Huh?
...Have you seen... my lower half?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_078.en:
Hang on.
I'll find it.
Don't try to talk.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_079.en:
Heh heh heh... *cough*
For you...
instead of... a title belt...
this machine's... Destroy...er...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_080.en:
...Yeah. I'll take it, and thanks.
...You're one tough son of a gun.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_084.en:
A guy I know turns up an enemy...
and the enemy's a merc too...
This merc job's a rough one...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_087.en:
...People you know... they just die,
like it's nothing...
Buggy, too...
So this is what a battlefield is...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_088.en:
...Even so, we chose this road.
On Huffman, all we can do is
survive.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_089.en: Recovered the parts and the body...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_001.en:
Captain...
Champ was drinking alone at the bar.
I didn't know what to say to him...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_002.en:
A mission.
I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_003.en:
Champ...
Do you think he's okay?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_004.en:
Oh, we're heading out?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_005.en:
Without the usual loudmouth around,
it's pretty quiet here...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_009.en:
Yeah. Though his personality was
rotten right to the end.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_010.en:
All we can do for the fallen is
remember them.
Nothing's more pitiful than being
forgotten.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_011.en:
That guy...
We trained at the same dojo, ever
since I was a nobody.
Even after we went pro, we fought
each other more times than I can
count.
By then we knew each other's every
move.
Honestly... he was the last guy I
ever wanted to fight.
That footage I showed you here was a
fight with him.
Man, that crowd went nuts...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_012.en: A friend and a rival, then.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_013.en:
That's what we were.
...But I threw away the glory, threw
away my friends, and picked this
road...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_014.en: You had your reasons, didn't you?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_015.en:
...Yeah.
Fighting just got less popular as
time went on.
We still had plenty of die-hard fans,
but as a business it was one flop
after another.
I didn't want the flame to go out.
Fighting was the road we believed in.
...To keep the shows afloat, I
borrowed big from the underworld.
And when it's the reigning champ
asking, hell, they'll lend you as
much as you want...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_017.en:
Nah. I couldn't tell anybody...
It wasn't anyone's fault fighting
went out of style.
The longer we kept the shows going,
the deeper the debt got...
In the end I had no way to pay, and
the deal I'd made with the underworld
had me fixing fights...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_018.en:
Fixed fights.
But with your personality, I can't
see you taking a dive.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_019.en:
Ha ha ha! That's the Captain.
You see right through me...
You got it.
I couldn't throw the fight. Ended up
sending the other guy to the hospital.
And that guy? Turns out he was the
idiot son of an underworld boss...
After that, I had those goons on my
tail every single day.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_020.en: And then you came to Huffman.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_021.en:
That's about it.
If I'd stuck around the fighting
world, I'd have dragged everybody
around me into it...
And there's a guy who took on my
debt for me.
I'm paying him back with my merc
money. Bit by bit, but still.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_022.en:
Underneath it all, you've had it
hard.
Still, you should report all this to
the base.
Though vanishing without a word and
keeping the truth hidden... they may
not let that slide.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_023.en:
Heh heh, that's the plan.
But now, for his sake and for the
guy who bailed me out, I can't go
dyin' easy...
Captain, thanks for hearin' me out.
That took a load off.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_024.en: Glad to have you with us.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_025.en:
But now, for his sake and for the
guy who bailed me out, I can't go
dyin' easy.
Captain, thanks for hearin' me out.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_026.en:
We're movin' out?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_027.en:
The war's comin', I tell ya.
And then I'll be gone without a
trace, just like Peter.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_028.en:
Shresh...
Don't get so worked up.
You don't want to jinx it, right?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_030.en:
Word from the brass.
We've located the large machine that
showed up during the Champ incident.
I want it shot down.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_032.en: It's lying low in the desert.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_033.en:
The desert...
That's their usual pattern.
Is it trying to link up with its main
force?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_034.en:
Yes.
That read looks right.
We're picking up a large number of
big machines in the area nearby.
Unidentified as well.
You'd better stay sharp.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_035.en:
A large number of big machines...
The squad's at the limit of their
endurance, but...
Looks like there's no time for rest.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_036.en:
Of all the nearby bases, yours is
the only squad to fight the black
unit and bring everyone home alive.
They want that runaway destroyed
before it reaches its main force,
whatever it takes.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_037.en:
That's the plan.
We'll sortie as soon as we're ready.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_038.en:
Even the brass admits nobody at the
nearby bases can stand up to the
black unit but you.
Take out that runaway before it
reaches its main force, whatever it
takes.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_002.en:
The one who shot Ox...
Guess this makes it a grudge match...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_004.en:
Don't worry.
I'm a merc too.
I'll do the job right!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_007.en:
Let's wrap this up fast. How about
we all hit the beach for once?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_009.en:
Agreed.
We're on a tropical island, after all.
I'll put in for squad leave later.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_010.en:
Ooh, maybe I'll go buy a new
swimsuit.
Rain, come shopping with me!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_012.en:
The two of 'em in swimsuits...
Whoa, whoa. Now I REALLY can't die.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_015.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_018.en: Go apologize to Ox on the other side.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_019.en:
To soldiers this green...
Does this mean I misjudged superior
material...?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_020.en:
Large machine silenced.
More enemy reinforcements...
Six large machines.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_021.en:
Large reinforcements confirmed.
We'll intercept the remaining enemy
reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_023.en:
Good... I held out.
Large mobile unit, shoot them down.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_025.en:
Large reinforcements confirmed.
We'll pursue the special machine and
intercept the reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_028.en:
That was a hard fight.
Good work, everyone.
Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_029.en:
Captain, about that leave...
It's still on, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_030.en:
We've been fighting day after day.
The Commander can hardly say no.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_031.en:
So, Champ, how about a drink at the
beach?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_032.en:
Gray, YOU invitin' ME?
That's a first.
You're buyin', right?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_034.en:
Rain, about the swimsuits... we're
going, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_035.en:
Yes, yes. I'll get ready once we're
back...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_036.en:
Then, Captain, you come shopping
with us too.
Just this once is okay, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_037.en:
Sure, I don't mind...
I didn't see that coming, though...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_038.en:
Hmm~
Sexy or cute...
Which do you prefer, Captain?
Oh, I bet the sexy look would suit
Rain!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_039.en:
R-Rain, lookin' sexy...!!
C-C-Captain... I'm comin' too!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_040.en:
Nope, no Champs allowed.
You go have a nice drink with Gray.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_041.en:
Hold on, Oddeye...
Hear me out!
Gray, forget what I said before!
Got it?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_042.en:
I don't mind, but I don't think
they're letting you in anyway.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_044.en:
N-no way...
Gray... That's it, we're drinkin'
till we drop!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_001.en: Captain, do you use the base ARENA?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_002.en:
Now and then.
It's good training, and a change
of pace.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_003.en:
That's true.
We saw one on our last mission:
the major cities on Huffman are
all building big Arena stadiums.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_004.en:
Apparently the rules are almost the
same as the base ARENA.
Still, an entertainment venue built
around wanzers...

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_005.en:
If private companies run places like
the Arena, it might shake off the
wanzer's image as a weapon of war.
That could be a happier fate for
them, don't you think?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_006.en:
I see.
That's one way to look at it.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_007.en:
If private companies run places like
the Arena, it might shake off the
wanzer's image as a weapon of war.
That could be a happier fate for
them, don't you think?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_008.en:
A mission, then.
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_009.en:
Captain, I'm headin' over to the
ARENA for a bit.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_011.en:
Trainin' for the civilian Arena.
The fight money's pretty sweet.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_013.en:
Word is a lot of the entry wanzers
have real good pilots.
Why don't you sign up too, Captain?
For me, it's the crowd, the buzz in
there... nothin' else like it.
Aight, I'm off!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_014.en:
Don't let it get in the way of
your duties.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_015.en: Aight, I'm off to the base ARENA!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_016.en:
What, we're movin' out?
Fine -- I'll go wild out there instead!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_017.en:
Oh, Captain, I've got a question about
wanzer one-on-ones...

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_019.en:
Yes, exactly.
My machine is set up mainly for
long range, but I can't decide!
Should I keep a sharp, pure
long-range build, or cover my blind
spots up close and go all-rounder?
I've been agonizing over it...
Which do you think is better?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_020.en:
...In real combat, you work with
the rest of us.
A bit of specialization pays off there.
But fighting alone may be a different
story.
If you can use your skills reliably,
though, you can expect a one-sided
fight.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_021.en:
I see~.
It really is deep!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_022.en:
Should I keep a sharp, pure
long-range build, or cover my blind
spots up close and go all-rounder?
I've been agonizing over it...

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_023.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_024.en: Captain, do you use the ARENA?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_025.en:
Now and then.
It's good training, and a change
of pace.
But it seems to be catching on in
our squad.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_026.en:
It's a pretty good system, the ARENA.
Maybe it's from seeing that flashy
civilian Arena the other day, but
everyone's really fired up.
If that catches on, it could change
the whole wanzer industry.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_027.en:
True.
With private companies behind it,
wanzer parts technology and piloting
skills should both improve.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_028.en:
The Arena's entry pilots, the really
good ones anyway, might get scouted
by the army.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_029.en:
It's possible.
Even a merc who runs out of work on
the battlefield might keep fed by
entering the Arena.
Looked at that way, it works in our
favor too.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_030.en:
It's nothing like real combat, but
it's the same wanzers at heart.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_031.en:
It's a pretty good system, the ARENA.
With these flashy civilian Arenas,
the wanzer industry's bound to change.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_033.en:
Think about it.
Why're they shippin' mountains of
weapons and food here from home?
«g:24»This base could never eat all that.
And the weapons... there's enough to
wipe out a USN base or two on this
island, every last man.
I'm tellin' ya, somethin's up.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_034.en:
The Arena's great, isn't it?
The sound of machine slamming into
machine... can't get enough of it.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_035.en:
...Come to think of it...
I never got... a souvenir from
Oddeye...

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_046.en:
Two urgent missions just came in.
One: stop a bombing at the Arena.
Two: rescue a team of journalists.
Whichever you pass on goes to
another unit.
So pick whichever you like, no need
to worry about the other.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_047.en:
Stopping the Arena bombing, then.
You know Arena construction is wrapping
up all over the island?
The anti-Arena groups aren't taking it
quietly.
Things were always tense, but now
they've finally turned to force.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_048.en:
Anti-Arena groups turning to force...
Those groups opposing the damage the
stadiums do to the environment?
I thought they were a peaceful lot.
What are they threatening to do?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_049.en:
Mm.
The Arena organizing committee just
received a bomb threat.
Get to the site fast and stop it from
going off.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_051.en:
Their gear's outdated, but the
anti-Arena groups have wanzers too,
apparently.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_052.en: Not much of a fighting force, then.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_053.en:
Seems not.
A bomb disposal team is going with
you. Disarm the planted bombs with
their disposal vehicle while you
wipe out the enemy wanzers.
But they're desperate. Enemy
reinforcements are possible.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_054.en:
A bomb threat means we don't have
much time.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_055.en:
Going by the deadline they gave, if
you head out now you'll have about
15 turns to work with.
Will you take this mission?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_056.en:
We'll take it.
There's no time before it goes off.
This one's urgent.
We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_058.en:
Rescuing the journalists, then.
Three days ago, a team of journalists
went silent in territory we control.
But this morning we picked up a
distress signal from their vehicle.
I want you to bring them out.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_059.en:
This needs wanzers?
Sending a vehicle or a chopper to
pick them up seems smarter.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_060.en:
It's our territory, but there are
reports of armed guerrillas sighted
in the area the signal's coming from.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_061.en: That sort are still roaming around?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_062.en:
It never hurts to have journalists
and the press on our side.
Get out there and help them, fast.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_063.en:
Say we secure the journalists. Do they
have a way out?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_064.en:
Their vehicle seems to be drivable.
The signal's on the move.
Just get that vehicle to the extraction
point.
Will you take this mission?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_065.en:
We'll take it.
Information may well be the greatest
weapon of all...
This one's urgent. We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_067.en:
Both are urgent, but whichever you
pass on goes to another unit.
One: stop a bombing at the Arena.
Two: rescue a team of journalists.
Pick whichever you like, no need to
worry about the other.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_068.en:
We'll take it.
There's no time before it goes off.
This one's urgent.
We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_069.en:
I see.
Information may well be the greatest
weapon of all...
This one's urgent. We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_002.en:
Those armored cars from before,
right behind us!
Three of 'em!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_003.en:
They don't give up, do they...
Whose soldiers ARE they...?«g:24»
Can't they see the PRESS markings on
the car?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_004.en:
What!?
Now there's a wanzer up ahead...!?
Dammit, we're boxed in!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_005.en:
Civilian vehicle, do you read me?
At the army's request, we're here
to protect you.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_006.en:
...Friendlies?
Understood. We'll follow your lead.
Looks like we made it after all...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_009.en:
...Oh, no, it's nothing.
That girl... she looks like someone
I know.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_010.en:
Rachel Perkins...
She's a well-known journalist.
Maybe you've seen her on TV?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_011.en:
We'll cover you.
Get out when you see an opening.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_014.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_017.en:
All units, keep eyes on that
vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_018.en: One direct hit and they're finished...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_019.en:
What? A direct hit!?«g:24»
Oddeye, any life signs?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_020.en:
There's no tracker on the civilian
vehicle!
Status unknown!
Resistant armor, anti-wanzer guns...
Are these really guerrillas?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_021.en:
They only look the part.
That teamwork...
That's no civilian outfit.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_023.en:
Nothing we can do.
We'll search the wrecked vehicle and
bring back any evidence...
The fight's over.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_024.en:
Those bastards...
I won't forgive them!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_026.en:
What? Gray, what's wrong?
The fight's over.
Captain, Gray's wanzer is heading for
the enemy vehicles!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_027.en:
...We'll stay on and take out the
armed vehicles.
Don't worry about the rest.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_028.en:
Roger!
Hey, hold up, Gray! What're you so
mad about!?
We're comin' too. Don't do anything
stupid!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_029.en:
Enemy vehicles silenced.
No reinforcements.
...Captain, there are survivors in
the wreck!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_033.en:
Johnston?
Hey, are you okay?
You're bleeding...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_034.en:
Took one in the lung...
I'm fine... I've got a spare...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_036.en:
Two wounded, one unconscious and in
critical condition.
They got our driver...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_037.en:
Still, a direct hit from an anti-wanzer
gun, and you're okay?
I was sure you were done for...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_040.en:
Well, we were told it was a combat
zone.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_041.en:
Medical team's sling chopper
arriving in 5 minutes.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_042.en:
Roger.
We'll keep escorting until the
chopper arrives.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_002.en:
I heard everyone was in here.
Um, it's Rain, isn't it?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_003.en:
That's right.
This is where the base unwinds.
Everyone's taking it easy right now.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_004.en:
Huh? Rachel... ma'am?
What brings you here?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_005.en:
Just Rachel is fine.
I wanted to thank you all for the
other day.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_006.en: Don't see many civilians in here.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_007.en: Now that you mention it, true.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_009.en:
Ha ha ha!
That's what they used to call me,
back in the day.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_011.en:
Wow...
Meeting a legendary fighter in a
place like this...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_012.en:
Huh.
So Champ really IS famous.
I thought he was just some weird,
drunk muscle-head.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_014.en:
I'm sorry, Rachel.
Please don't mind anything she says...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_016.en:
Pretty sure you're the mean one
here...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_017.en:
You must be the Captain.
Thank you for the other day.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_018.en:
I was just carrying out the mission.
Save your thanks for the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_020.en:
I'm sorry, Rachel.
Please don't mind anything the
Captain says either...
He can be curt, but he doesn't mean
anything by it...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_022.en:
By the way, is the rest of your
crew alright?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_023.en:
The ones with minor injuries left
Huffman a little while ago.
Johnston got the worst of it; he's
in intensive care at the hospital.
He should fly home tomorrow or so.
(Hm? The design on the Captain's
tattoo... I've seen it somewhere...)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_024.en:
I see.
That's good to hear.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_025.en:
Will you be staying here a while,
Rachel?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_026.en:
Oh, yes.
I can't go home until the job's
done.
Even if I have to do it alone.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_028.en:
Well, I chose this line of work,
so there's no helping it.
Anyway, the mercs here are all such
nice people.
Maybe I'll ask the Commander about
doing some one-on-one interviews.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_029.en:
I'm free right now, if you want.
How about over a drink?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_030.en:
Ooh, that's Champ for you.
I bet you're used to interviews.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_031.en:
...It's best not to write stories
about individual mercs.
I doubt the Commander would approve
it anyway.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_033.en:
...Because, like yours, it's that
kind of job, I guess.
Some of us have pasts we'd rather
not have dug up, and some people
would be in trouble if it got out
they were here.
Ah, sorry if that came off rude.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_034.en:
I see.
No, I'm the one who should apologize.
Occupational hazard, I guess...
My curiosity runs off ahead of me...
(Hey, Rain?)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_036.en:
(Covering for your cool Captain
must be hard work, huh?)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_037.en:
(Oh, no... He doesn't look it, but
he's a kind man.)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_038.en:
(Really? He doesn't seem it...
I guess love really is blind?)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_039.en:
(Wh-what are you talking about!?
I-i-it's nothing like that!!)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_040.en:
(Hee hee, your face is all red.)
Well then, I'll head back to my
quarters. Good night!

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_043.en:
N-no, n-nothing at all.
Excuse me.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_044.en:
Looks like Rachel said something
to you.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_045.en:
N-no, n-nothing at all.
Excuse me.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_046.en:
A mission.
I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_047.en:
Captain, an interview's no big deal,
is it?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_048.en:
We're movin' out?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_049.en: I wonder what Rachel said to Rain?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_050.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_051.en:
There's always a wall between
civilians and mercs.
Nothing to be done about it, but...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_053.en:
Captain «E801:00», I'm sorry about
earlier.
I thought I'd done my homework on
mercs, but seeing the legendary
Champ, I guess I got carried away...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_054.en:
Please take care of that request
for me.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_055.en:
Word is the USN's beefing up its
forces on this island.
That's a sure sign a war's coming.
You guys better juice up your wanzers
with the new stuff in the hangar!

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_056.en:
Shresh, don't buy into that kinda
flimsy info.
Huh?«g:24» There's a face I don't know.
Maybe I'll say hi.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_058.en:
This time your mission is to help a
journalist with her reporting.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_059.en:
Help with reporting?
So mercs are tour guides now?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_060.en:
Don't be like that.
The request came through the brass.
The client is Rachel Perkins, the
woman we rescued the other day.
She's asked for a guide through the
territory we control.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_061.en:
...A guide.
But it's a job for mercs.
I take it this isn't a sightseeing
trip?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_062.en:
Sharp as ever.
Our territory or not, the area she
wants to cover never sees an end to
armed guerrilla activity.
Stay alert at all times and keep her
safe.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_063.en:
Roger.
We'll head out as soon as her crew
is ready.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_064.en:
Our territory or not, the area she
wants to cover never sees an end to
armed guerrilla activity.
Stay alert at all times and keep her
safe.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_001.en:
So this is the place...
(...These ruins match the files
exactly.)

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_002.en:
The remains of a facility from the
first days of settling Huffman...
What's there to report on in a place
like this?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_003.en: Somethin' to gawk at, I guess.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_004.en:
Hee hee.
It is rather unusual, isn't it.
(There it is. I knew it was here.)

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_005.en:
(Of all places, she comes here...)
This is no ordinary story, is it.
I won't pry, but be quick about it.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_006.en:
...Oh my, the Captain's onto me.
Don't worry, it shouldn't take ten
minutes.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_007.en:
Huh? It's not for a story?
If you're looking for something, I
can help!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_008.en:
It's fine, I found it!
(Now the truth can come out...)

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_009.en:
If you're done here, we're heading
back.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_010.en:
Yes, all done.
Let's go back.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_012.en:
It's that unit again...
That black machine...
It's got a backpack I've never seen
before!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_013.en:
Them again...
I'm in the car.
We can go any time.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_014.en:
Target acquired...
The mercenary unit in question
appears to be escorting.
Eliminating the target takes
priority.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_015.en:
Looks like Rachel's got some kind
of story...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_016.en:
All units, combat stance.
Protect Rachel's vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_018.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Gray is
destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_020.en:
To think I would use this on a
mission like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_023.en:
N-no way...
You mean they made one big enough
for a wanzer!?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_025.en:
I think it's a kind of optical
camouflage, developed for urban
sniping under the army's 2nd Round
Warrior program.
I never thought it could be fitted to
a wanzer...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_026.en:
I see. So he's still out there.
All units, stay alert.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_029.en:
Target vehicle destroyed.
Death not yet confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_032.en:
Gray, clearing the enemy comes first.
Stay in your wanzer.
You'll get taken out too.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_035.en:
To think I would use this on a
mission like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_038.en:
N-no way...
You mean they made one big enough
for a wanzer!?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_040.en:
I think it's a kind of optical
camouflage, developed for urban
sniping under the army's 2nd Round
Warrior program.
I never thought it could be fitted to
a wanzer...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_041.en:
I see. So he's still out there.
All units, stay alert.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_043.en:
Enemy forces silenced.
The machine that vanished...
is still unaccounted for.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_046.en:
No, Rachel, stay down!
Keep hidden!!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_047.en:
So you survived after all.
...This mission will be completed.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_048.en:
The enemy's showing itself!
It's aiming at Rachel!
No, it's in firing position!!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_051.en:
...Target confirmed alive.
Mission failed.
Death unit, backpack malfunction...
Withdrawing for now.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_053.en:
Hey, Gray! You alive in there!?
Hang on!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_055.en:
Gray, if you're conscious, get out
of that machine.
...All units, we're getting Gray out.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_056.en:
Hang on, Gray!
I'll pry it open from out here...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_057.en:
I'm sorry...
This is all my fault...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_061.en:
Gray...
I'm so sorry...
I got in the way of the fight...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_062.en:
Don't worry about it...
Protecting you is our job...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_063.en:
But... to put your life on the line
like that...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_064.en:
Besides... you remind me of someone...
Your voice, the way you move...
How you get so set on one thing you
can't see anything else...
...Ugh...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_066.en:
He's alright.
Gray's just passed out.
Rain, have the base medical staff
stand by.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_001.en:
Captain, thanks to Gray blocking the
attack, Rachel came out of it almost
unhurt.
Though she's still in the hospital.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_003.en:
Gray came to last night and is
resting.
They say he could be discharged in
two or three days at the earliest.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_004.en:
I see.
That's good.
I'll go see him later.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_005.en:
Still, that guy sure went nuts out
there.
He's usually so cool-headed.
Wonder what got into him.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_006.en:
He said Rachel reminded him of
someone, didn't he?

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_008.en:
A sweetheart, huh...
I'm kind of jealous.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_009.en:
For all we know, he just used the
chaos to make a move on Rachel.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_011.en:
Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
I'd never pull that.
Back home I get mobbed by girls
who're fans of mine anyway!

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_012.en:
Yes, yes. Heroes are just different,
aren't they.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_014.en:
Gray came to last night and is
resting.
They say he could be discharged in
two or three days at the earliest.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_016.en:
Still, that guy sure went nuts out
there.
He's usually so cool-headed.
Wonder what got into him.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_017.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_018.en:
A sweetheart, huh...
I'm kind of jealous.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_019.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_021.en:
Gray, stay as you are. At ease.
I just came to see how you're doing.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_022.en:
Sorry.
I can move now, so if there's a
mission, just say the word.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_023.en:
I was told you should rest a little
longer, though.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_024.en:
This wound's nothing serious.
The shrapnel's been cleanly removed,
the bleeding's under control, and
there's no infection.
I was lucky I was in a wanzer cockpit.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_025.en:
Hm.
Spoken like an ex-special forces man.
You probably know more than the
doctors here.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_026.en:
Ha ha, they drilled a lot into us.
I can tell just by looking at the
wound.
By the way, do you know how Rachel's
doing?

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_027.en:
She's still in the hospital, but
thanks to you her injuries were
minor.
I'll let you know when I hear more.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_028.en:
No, that's enough for me.
But letting a civilian get hurt...
I've still got a lot to learn.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_029.en:
But you saved her life.
That's enough for now.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_030.en:
Hearing that from you helps,
Captain.
Thanks for coming to see me.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_031.en:
Hearing that from you helps,
Captain.
Thanks for coming to see me.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_032.en:
Mission acknowledged.
I'm fine now.
Preparing to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_033.en:
The war's comin', I tell ya.
And then I'll be gone without a
trace, just like Peter.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_034.en:
Shresh...
Don't get so worked up.
You don't want to jinx it, right?

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_036.en:
Rachel's already been discharged.
Nothing serious, apparently.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_037.en:
That's good.
I'll let Gray know too, since he's
still laid up.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_038.en:
However, she's been ordered home.
The brass wants us to escort her to
the airport before the day's out.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_040.en:
We've kept anything about her as
quiet as we can, but we can't rule
out an attempt on her.
You'd best stay sharp at the airport.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_041.en:
Agreed...
We know who we're up against.
The sniper may show up again.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_042.en:
Get Rachel's armored car to the
extraction point in one piece, and
airport security can take it from
there.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_043.en:
