Roger.
We'll sortie as soon as we're ready.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_044.en:
No enemy forces confirmed so far.
Get Rachel's armored car to the
extraction point in one piece, and
airport security can take it from
there.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_001.en:
We've reached the airport.
No enemy attacks so far.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_002.en:
If they show, it'll most likely be
here. The airport has clear lines of
fire.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_003.en:
True, that machine was set up for
sniping.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_004.en:
Gray, you sure you're okay?
You ain't even been discharged yet,
have ya?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_005.en:
Nah, I'm fine now.
I've got the doctor's okay, too.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_006.en:
Enemy signatures...
There's so many aircraft and service
vehicles, it's hard to pick anything
out...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_007.en:
Now that we're here, I think I'll be
fine.
Thank you, everyone.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_008.en:
Save the goodbyes for later.
You'd better get going.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_009.en:
Okay...
I'm going.
Thank you too, Gray.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_011.en:
It's a wanzer!«g:24»
Launcher type confirmed!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_012.en:
Thought so.
All units, defend Rachel's vehicle
at all costs.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_013.en:
Rachel, head for the point!
Hurry!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_015.en:
If that thing targets the car from
range, it won't stand a chance.
Take down the Launcher types first.
All units, commence operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_016.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Rachel's
vehicle is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_018.en:
Target confirmed.
Commencing mission.
The backpack is unusable, but that
is no problem...
I will simply bring down that
vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_020.en:
Gray, let's pay him back for last
time, yeah?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_021.en:
You bet.
This time I'll protect her, no matter
what!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_022.en:
The machine that governs death...
is falling...?
Mission... failed...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_024.en:
Not yet.
We mop up the remaining forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_026.en: If I can just get there...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_028.en:
Rachel, get inside the facility.
We'll stay and mop up the rest.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_030.en: Now we can fight all we want.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_031.en:
Target cannot be acquired...
It appears to have left the combat
area.
The mission has failed, but the
mercenary unit must be given death...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_032.en:
Target destruction confirmed.
Mission accomplished.
Now all is buried in darkness.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_034.en:
Escort target destroyed...
The mission's failed...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_037.en:
Mission complete.
All units, you're cleared to see
Rachel off.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_039.en:
To the airport, then.
Let's go!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_041.en:
I hate to say goodbye, but...
it's almost time.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_042.en:
Yeah. Thank you all, really.
I don't know what to say...
It may be your job, but you saved
my life.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_043.en: Ha ha, you're making too much of it.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_044.en:
Gray sure put his body on the line
more than usual this time!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_045.en:
Hey, hey, that makes it sound like
I never do anything!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_046.en:
Hee hee.
I'll have to work hard too!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_047.en:
Oh, Rachel!
When I go home on leave, show me
some of the trendy places to eat!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_048.en:
Hee hee, I'd love to.
What do you like, Oddeye?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_050.en:
Oh, that's all the rage right now.
I know a place that's sooo good,
I'll take you there.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_052.en:
Oh, Gray, about that person who
looks like me... a girlfriend?
Or maybe a wife back home?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_053.en:
Oh, that...
It's my sister.
She was in an accident, and she
still hasn't woken up.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_054.en:
Oh, the poor thing...
Isn't there something I can do...?
I could recommend a good hospital,
too. Don't hesitate to ask.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_055.en:
Huh, that's kind of you.
I might take you up on that.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_056.en:
Well then, goodbye.
Don't do anything reckless, all of
you.
Captain «E801:00», thank you so much!
Thanks to you, I've got loads of
scoops on top of what I came for.
And Rain, I'm rooting for you!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_057.en:
Honestly...
I told you it's not like that!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_058.en:
I don't know what brought you here.
But you're the only reporter who's
covered what's happening on Huffman.
...Take care of yourself.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_001.en:
The army's been a lot more active
lately, hasn't it?
Huge shipments of supplies are
coming in from the mainland, too.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_002.en:
Nothing unusual for Huffman.
As mercs, it's no concern of ours.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_003.en:
Still, with that many supplies they
could keep thousands, tens of
thousands of troops going.
You could almost call it preparing
for war.
If it comes to war, I'd think it'll
affect us mercs too.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_004.en:
Mercs on Huffman help hold the
border.
But we're not given the strength to
break it.
We're just a shield while that
strength is built up.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_005.en:
So is the army trying to tip the
balance...?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_006.en:
I don't know their real intent, but
anyone can guess.
If there's no place left for us, we
leave Huffman. Simple as that.
There's no shortage of trouble spots.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_007.en:
Leave Huffman...
But before that... our missing
comrades, the black unit working in
the shadows... Don't mercs even have
the right to know the truth...?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_008.en:
Normally it wouldn't be strange for
special forces to be looking into
that.
But if nothing's reached us, when
we've fought them several times...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_009.en:
After all those casualties...
Does that make mercs just pawns to be
thrown away?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_010.en:
That's what the contract fee is for.
It was in the papers you signed when
you volunteered.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_011.en:
Paid to be the army's shield, huh...
I guess that IS the contract...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_012.en:
Official military paperwork is always
written to be convoluted and
roundabout.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_013.en:
Our missing comrades, the black unit
working in the shadows... Don't mercs
even have the right to know the
truth...?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_015.en:
Paid to be the army's shield, huh...
I guess that IS the contract...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_017.en:
Those two over there are talking
with really serious faces.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_018.en:
About merc contracts, right?
The army pays you fight money, you
fight. That's all there is to it.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_020.en:
It is simple.
You either sign the contract or you
don't. And the ones who signed are
here. That's all there is to it.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_022.en:
Champ thought the contract was an
autograph board and signed it, right?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_023.en:
Ha ha ha!
Even a muscle-head doesn't go around
that brainless, y'know?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_024.en:
Huh? But Rain said so!
She said, "Champ was probably drunk
and signed the contract thinking it
was for a fan, right?"

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_025.en:
Oddeye doesn't know me, fine...
But Rain!?
Seriously, who do you people think
I am!?
I'll have you know!
I'm the first champion to take the
mixed martial arts triple crown and
unify the belts!
The great one with a record twelve
title defences!

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_027.en:
That's too long!
And why's it get longer every time!?
Please, just stop at muscle-head...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_029.en:
My glory...
What was it all for...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_030.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_031.en:
The Captain says it's too long, so
I'll think up something shorter.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_032.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_033.en:
The supplies are in.
Now all it takes is a spark, I tell
ya.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_034.en:
Hmm, things really are turning out
like Shresh said...
The hangar's getting new gear
shipped in again, too...
Now even I'm getting nervous.
Hm? That's rare, Gabriel.
Are you laughing?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_035.en:
...Heh heh heh... weird...
...drunk... show-off...
...muscle-head... heh heh heh...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_036.en:
You know the mainland's been sending
huge amounts of supplies to this
island ahead of a large-scale
regular army operation?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_037.en:
I hear they're shipping in enough to
start a war.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_038.en:
Right.
Yesterday a transport unit reported
losses on the route they're using.
They were shot down before they even
spotted the enemy.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_040.en:
Most likely.
...Normally we'd change the route,
but there are so many supplies that
we have no choice but to use this
highway.
So I want «E801:00» Squad to escort
the transport unit.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_041.en:
I see.
Did the wreckage of the downed units
leave any trace of the enemy?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_042.en:
There were no heavy burn marks, so
it doesn't look like missiles.
Most likely long-range sniping by
wanzers, but the enemy force hasn't
been confirmed.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_043.en:
Roger.
Sounds like anti-piercing armor's a
must. We'll sortie when we're ready.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_044.en:
There were no heavy burn marks, so
it doesn't look like missiles.
Most likely long-range sniping by
wanzers, but the enemy force hasn't
been confirmed.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_045.en:
The information we put our lives on
the line to protect went home with
Rachel.

What was happening on Huffman Island.
The black unit working in the
shadows.
The organization half-glimpsed
behind it.
And, as the Captain had said, what
Rachel had really been looking for.
If all this had been made public, the
affair might have been stopped before
it grew any bigger.

But Rachel never broke the story...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_001.en:
This is the area where the transport
unit was attacked.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_002.en:
Roger.
All units, keep watch around you.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_003.en:
Sure is a whole lotta nothing out
here...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_004.en:
Yeah. Terrain-wise, it's a perfect
sniping spot.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_005.en:
That's a lot of transports.
Can we protect them all...?

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_006.en:
That's the mission.
If we stand still, we're good
targets. Get the transports moving.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_009.en:
Enemy confirmed.
We will now escort the transport
unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_010.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Oddeye is
destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_012.en:
Bingo!
Good old Lich.
Spot-on intel.
So this is the merc unit everyone's
talkin' about.
Then I'm gonna hunt 'em down and
enjoy every second!!

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_013.en:
Captain, more enemies...
It's a black wanzer.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_016.en:
Things just got worse, but we hold
the transports no matter what.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_017.en:
...This is special forces Delta.
«E801:00» Squad, do you read?

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_018.en:
Captain, a transmission from the
army's special forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_019.en:
This is «E801:00» Squad.
Delta 1, it's been a while.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_021.en:
Our mission is to escort the
transport unit and support «E801:00»
Squad.
Commencing operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_022.en:
Nobody told me, but if it's Delta 1,
I can trust you.
Glad to have you.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_023.en:
Huh?
Special forces are joining in?
Well, that just means more targets!

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_024.en:
«E801:00» Squad, that machine...
What exactly are you fighting...?

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_026.en:
(...That voice, that way of
talking... It can't be.)
A mysterious organization...
I'll hear about it later.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_028.en:
Dammit...
Stupid special forces...
The hunt's off for now.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_030.en:
Continue mopping up the remaining
forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_033.en:
From here the transport unit should
be able to get clear.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_034.en:
«E801:00» Squad, good work on the
escort.
You're free to return to base.
Delta will handle the cleanup.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_035.en:
Roger. Mission complete.
Thanks for the support. It helped.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_036.en:
You seem to have gotten even
stronger since last time.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_037.en:
Oh, well, it's been one hard time
after another...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_038.en:
Oddeye, honestly...
Making small talk with special
forces...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_040.en:
Yes! My eyes are odd eyes, one blue
and one silver.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_041.en:
I knew it...
That's what you always used to say to
people you'd just met...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_042.en:
...It really is you, David.
I sort of thought so from your voice.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_043.en:
I'm sorry, Kate...
Delta's still on a mission.
There's no time right now.
I'll stop by your base to resupply
later.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_046.en:
Oddeye...
So you knew the special forces
captain.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_003.en:
Looks like something happened
between them in the past...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_004.en:
Oh? So Delta's here.
I should say hello.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_005.en:
Ah, Captain...
It might be best not to talk to
those two right now...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_006.en:
Just a hello.
Shouldn't be a problem.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_007.en:
Ah, Captain...
It might be best not to talk to
those two right now...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_010.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_014.en: ...Two and a half years, isn't it.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_015.en:
...Three years and two months.
Every database record I could access
said killed in action.
And most of your service records had
been erased.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_016.en:
I was in the army that whole time.
I'm sorry, but I can't tell you any
more than that...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_017.en:
...Special forces rules, I suppose?
The records were wiped too neatly,
so I figured it out...
...Do you think that's cool, or
something?
...You're going to vanish again
without a word, aren't you?
...Did you forget your promise to me!?

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_018.en:
Kate... I'm sorry.
It's almost time for the mission.
If you still feel the way you did
back then...
...Hm.
Captain «E801:00», I presume?

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_019.en: Sorry. I just wanted to say hello.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_020.en:
Your squad is a good team.
I should have come to greet you
myself, but I spent the time
greeting an old acquaintance.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_022.en:
No need to worry about it.
Isn't it time for your mission?
See you on the battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_023.en:
Captain «E801:00», I apologize.
It seems I shouldn't have come here.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_025.en:
Kate, when this mission is over, I
mean to keep my promise this time.
...It's time. I'm heading straight
out.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_027.en:
Huh? A mission, right?
Of course I'm going.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_028.en:
Maybe that black wanzer unit's gonna
be the spark...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_029.en:
Word is Shresh's been reading nothing
but conspiracy books lately.
Hope it doesn't get in the way of
his work...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_031.en:
At the brass's request, this is a
joint op with special forces.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_032.en:
Delta, then.
So that's why they were resupplying
here.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_033.en:
Right.
You've fought that black unit
several times now.
That experience got noticed, and the
army came to us directly.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_034.en:
So the army's finally getting off
its backside.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_035.en:
Special forces posing as mercs have
already infiltrated the op area.
For whatever reason, the black unit
goes after skilled mercs.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_036.en:
I see. If this op succeeds, we might
find a lead on the missing mercs too.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_037.en:
But if word gets out that the
regulars are involved, at a time
like this, it could turn into an
international incident.
Hence the merc disguise.
And with special forces skills, the
people hungry for good pilots won't
be able to resist.
Get out there now and take your
orders from special forces.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_039.en:
Special forces posing as mercs have
already infiltrated the op area.
Get out there now and take your
orders from special forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_001.en:
This is the op area.
Rain, anything from Delta?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_003.en:
Another joint op with Delta, huh.
Say what you want, we keep crossin'
paths.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_008.en:
Oddeye, special forces throw away
their pasts, just like mercs.
That's what codenames are for.
Don't look back right now.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_010.en:
Oddeye?
I understand that you're worried.
But we're up against the black unit.
Focus on the mission for now.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_011.en:
...Phew.
Roger!
I'm a professional merc too, you
know. I'm fine now!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_012.en:
If you say so...
Captain!
Enemy signatures confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_013.en: And still no word from Delta.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_014.en: Oddeye, can you use the sonar?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_015.en:
No good.
The noise is terrible...
I can't pick anything up.
Did something happen?
The battlefield's in total chaos...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_016.en:
It can't be helped.
We engage.
All units, intercept positions.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_018.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Oddeye is
destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_020.en:
What's this?
Now it's that merc unit...
Hey, mercs, I know you can hear me!
Those special forces boys playin'
merc? Not much of a fight at all.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_021.en:
What!?
You mean Delta was wiped out before
we even got here...?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_022.en:
Huh?
Didn't you hear me?
Now you lot make my hunt fun, got
it!?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_024.en: Th-this guy's out of his damn mind...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_026.en:
David!?
Captain, a transmission from Delta 1.
The signal's weak.
I finally picked it up!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_027.en:
Sorry... the op was blown and the
team's been wiped out...
Hard as it is to believe... military
secrets were leaked.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_028.en:
Roger.
That's enough.
Leave this to us and withdraw.
Regroup.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_029.en:
I can't do that.
I'll complete the mission with this
machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_030.en:
...
You... always like that...
Playing the hero with your
self-sacrifice...
Think about the people waiting for
you to come home!!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_032.en:
Oddeye, stop.
He's special forces.
...A soldier whose pride is in
carrying out the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_033.en:
...Kate, I threw away my past when I
volunteered for special forces.
Like Captain «E801:00» says, I live
to carry out the mission...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_034.en:
...Then why did you disappear
without a word!?
...Is that all we were!?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_035.en:
...I'm sorry.
I didn't want to drag you into it.
This is Delta 1.
Continuing the mission!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_040.en:
Hah... hah... finally took him down,
but... dammit, my sight system's
busted...
Tch, guess I'll haul this tough guy
back with me...
Looks like he's still barely
breathin'!!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_042.en:
Hm? A woman?
Cute voice you got there.
But I'm outta here, see?
I'll play with you next time!
Ha ha ha ha!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_043.en:
...Mop up the remaining forces, then
we go after him.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_045.en:
Sorry, but... we're spent.
Ain't got the gas left to chase him...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_046.en:
Besides, tracking him now would be
hard.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_047.en:
The wanzer Delta was flying belongs to
a merc unit.
So it should have a transmitter.
We'll go back and resupply. I'll ask
the Commander to be ready to search
right away.
And all of you, erase the comm logs
of Oddeye and Faceless's exchange.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_049.en: Oddeye, I'm sure he'll be fine.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_050.en:
Yeah.
Even among special forces, Delta's
in a class of its own.
As soldiers, they're on a whole other
level.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_051.en:
No way the leader of an outfit like
that goes down that easy.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_052.en:
That's right.
Faceless is no ordinary soldier.
Alright, we return to base at once
and prepare for round two.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_001.en:
Captain, it seems Oddeye has gone
out on recon by herself.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_003.en:
Sorry, Captain...
I tried to stop her, but...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_006.en:
They looked close... like they might
have been lovers once.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_007.en: The captain of Delta, of all people...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_008.en:
This is bad. With military intel
leaking, going on recon alone...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_009.en: We should go after her right away.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_010.en:
Tch. We only just got back, so the
maintenance crew's probably off
duty...
Let's at least get our own gear
sorted.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_011.en:
Right. I'll go talk to the
Commander.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_012.en: We should go after her right away.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_014.en:
Tch. We only just got back, so the
maintenance crew's probably off
duty...
Let's at least get our own gear
sorted.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_015.en:
Oddeye, don't do anything stupid
till we get there...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_016.en: I'll get ready to sortie too.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_018.en:
Huh?
Oddeye sortied, so I figured you
were all going together.
Shresh and the maintenance crew
already went back to their quarters.
Guess I'll call it a night too...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_019.en:
...Oddeye... sortied alone...
...I told her... new weapons came
in... but she didn't even change
her gear...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_020.en:
The brass has issued a request to
rescue the Delta personnel.
Oddeye already knew about it, so I
gave her permission to scout ahead.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_021.en:
So that's why she went...
Falcon, didn't you read my report?
Why did you let her go alone?
Unless we act on the assumption that
intel has leaked, going solo means
death.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_022.en:
I've already forwarded the report to
the brass.
But the brass won't admit there's
been a leak...!

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_023.en:
On a normal mission, a unit of
Delta's caliber wouldn't make that
kind of mistake.
Odds are classified intel is
reaching the enemy.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_024.en:
Yes, you're quite right.
But they also told me to hurry the
rescue...
And she was so set on going, I gave
in and said yes...
I'm sorry.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_025.en:
Every second counts.
Get the maintenance crew out of bed.
...We sortie immediately.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_026.en:
Is special forces intel really
leaking?
If so, this base's intel is at risk
too...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_027.en:
Is special forces intel really
leaking?
If so, this base's intel is at risk
too...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_001.en: You just don't quit, do ya...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_002.en:
...I finally found you!
Do you understand what you've done!?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_003.en:
Huh?
That's my job, ain't it?
Besides, you lot have been takin'
out my buddies on your missions too.
You do this work 'cause you like it,
right?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_004.en:
I like machines, but I don't like
killing people!
What you did... is unforgivable!

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_005.en:
Oh, here we go. Can't win the
argument, so now you're mad?
Funny thing to hear from somebody
who fights for a paycheck.
Whatever. You wanted to see your
boyfriend, right?
Too bad. In the shape he's in, he
ain't ever holdin' you again.
Hey, if you want, I could comfort
you instead, huh?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_007.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Oddeye is
destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_009.en:
Oddeye's machine located.
Oddeye!«g:24» Are you alright!?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_011.en:
Oddeye, don't act alone.
Trust your squad.
Regroup with us now, then we attack.
Understood?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_013.en:
Oddeye, did you find the Delta
personnel?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_015.en:
So they were already killed in
action...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_016.en:
Huh?«g:24» Killed in action?
Nah, not quite.
They kept fightin' back even in
restraints, so I tortured 'em, one
at a time.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_018.en:
Ha ha ha!
Nice and careful, one toe at a time.
Did ya know if you crush a person
from the edges in, they start
lookin' like some other kind of
creature?
Most of 'em died partway through,
but the one who looked like the
leader? Tough son of a gun.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_020.en:
Oddeye, don't let him bait you.
All units, cover Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_022.en:
Damn iiit!
I-I was wrong... I was wrong... help
me!!
The cockpit... it's... f-fire...!!
My hair, my hair's burning!
Aaagh...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_025.en:
Roger.
Oddeye, do you know where the
personnel are?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_027.en:
Oddeye, let's take our honored
comrades home...
All units, leave no trace of Delta.
We take everything back.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_029.en:
Captain... I couldn't find Faceless's
body anywhere I looked.
Even though his things are here...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_030.en:
Oddeye, that's enough.
I'll search. Rest a while.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_031.en:
We'll look too.
Gray, Champ, take the building to the
north, please.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_032.en:
It's no use.
I've checked everywhere...
Captain, I found a message capsule in
his dog tag, addressed to me.
...May I keep it?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_033.en:
I didn't see any such thing.
Do as you like.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_001.en:
Oddeye hasn't come by since we got
back.
That mission must have been hard on
her...

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_003.en:
Oddeye...? Now that you mention it,
she headed for the hangar looking
lost in thought.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_005.en:
Oddeye?
She was in the hangar working on her
wanzer just a minute ago.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_007.en:
You took quite a beating too,
huh...
Okay, that's the armor done.
Frame checks out too.
Oh, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_008.en:
Working on your wanzer?
You're keen.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_009.en:
It takes my mind off things.
If I'm not doing something, I feel
like I'll just keep sinking.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_011.en:
Yes.
We were together back when I was in
the JDF.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_013.en:
A few days after David went missing,
I searched the military database.
Within days, a death record that
didn't add up was entered, and then
his personal data disappeared
altogether.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_015.en:
Yes.
I worked in that kind of section, so
it was easy.
But I'd touched classified material,
so I got out before anyone found out
I'd looked.
After that I used all sorts of
contacts to dig into the most
secretive special forces units...
Security was too tight to get the
personnel files, but I found out a
lot of special forces had been sent
to Huffman Island recently.
So...
I thought maybe I'd find him, and
signed up as a merc.
I've always liked wanzers anyway.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_017.en:
Yes...
I found him.
I found him, and...
Why didn't he tell me even one
word...? I couldn't hold that
feeling back...
I might have hurt him.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_018.en:
He's the captain of an elite unit,
even by special forces standards.
He'd have been ready to give up
everything to carry out his mission.
But he met you again on the
battlefield, and heard from you.
That alone would have made him happy,
as a man.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_019.en:
Special forces was his dream, too.
I used to cheer him on, back then...
But all I could say was that one
word...
And still...
Was he really happy...?
What I wanted to say was that I was
glad he was alive... "Welcome home"...

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_020.en:
Then tell him when you see him again.
He'll understand how you feel.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_022.en:
I can't say for sure, but he may
still be alive.
It's a guess, based on what the
enemy said in your combat log.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_024.en:
Too bad. In the shape he's in, he
ain't ever holdin' you again.
...Most of 'em died partway through,
but the one who looked like the
leader? Tough son of a gun.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_025.en:
That's right.
That pilot was a twisted piece of
work, but he never said Faceless was
dead.
And we never found a body there.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_026.en:
You're right... the words I never
got to say.
If I get to see him again, I'll do
my best to tell him.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_027.en:
Now, time to prepare for the next
mission.
I'm going to HQ.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_028.en:
Roger.
Oh, Captain, this is his letter.
It has enemy intel in it too, so I'll
leave it with you.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_029.en:
...I've got the gist of it.
But Oddeye, this letter is addressed
to you.
You should hold on to it.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_031.en:
...The words I never got to say.
If I get to see him again, I'll do
my best to tell him.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_033.en:
Shresh still seems to have a lot on
his mind.
He hasn't been talking much.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_034.en:
...Oddeye... should I talk to her...
...or leave her be...

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_035.en:
We've had word the armed guerrillas'
base is in the mountains southwest
of Peseta.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_036.en: Straight for their base this time?

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_037.en:
Cut down the forces there, and the
rest are a rabble.
They won't be able to do anything of
note after that.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_038.en: Is this op tied to that unit too?

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_039.en:
No. This time the aim is to sweep
the armed guerrillas from around
Grayrock before the big operation
ahead.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_040.en:
I see.
What are the guerrillas fielding?

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_041.en:
Nothing with standout performance,
probably.
But there's a lot of patched-together
machines.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_043.en:
Which is why, starting with this
mission, I'm attaching a dedicated
supply vehicle.
The driver's codename is Hephaestus.
He's a bit of a character, but he's
an old friend of mine and a man you
can rely on.
Meet up with him in the field and
begin the mission.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_044.en:
Hephaestus... the god of the forge.
As long as he does the job, his
character doesn't matter.
Roger.
We sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_045.en:
Starting with this mission, I'm
attaching a dedicated supply vehicle.
The driver's codename is Hephaestus.
He's a bit of a character, but he's
an old friend of mine and a man you
can rely on.
Meet up with him in the field and
begin the mission.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_046.en:
Faceless's notes
To Oddeye, wanzer pilot, «E801:00» Squad,
OCU independent mercenary corps.
No... to my dear Kate S. Houjou.

For an internal army investigation,
I was recorded as dead and went into
hiding.
When the job was done, I meant to
tell you everything, but by then you
had left the service and vanished.
Your friend Hinata told me over and
over how heartbroken you were.

After that I joined Delta and buried
myself in work.
I thought of looking for you, but how
could I ever apologize...
While I was thinking it over, the
months and years slipped by.
I never imagined you'd be on Huffman,
working as a merc.
But I'm glad I got to see you again
before I die.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_047.en:
If you're reading this, I'm probably
no longer in this world.
Let me leave behind what I learned
on this operation.
Most of it came from my close friend
Roy.
If you ever meet him, tell him I
said thank you.
The black unit is the Vampires,
Sakata Industries' private
mercenary army.
Its purpose is to collect skilled
wanzer pilots.
Mostly, it captures wanzer mercs and
makes it look like they deserted.
Behind the unit, they're suspected of
performing some kind of biological
experiments on the captured mercs,
and using the results to develop
next-generation weapons.
The unit's own mercs don't seem to
have been told any more than that.

But if even our intel leaked, I think
someone high in the army is helping
them.
There's no proof, but this is a more
powerful organization than we
imagined.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_048.en:
Kate, I don't want to lose you to
this madness.
I loved the look on your face when
you went shopping in Akiba.
This is my last selfish wish.
Quit being a merc, and go home.
I'm sorry I couldn't keep my promise.

I love you, Kate.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_001.en:
We've linked up with the supply
vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_002.en:
Good. All units, prepare for combat.
We're flushing out the enemy.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_004.en:
Hmm.
So this is Falcon's hand-picked crack
team, eh?
Smooth work, I'll give ya that.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_005.en:
Hephaestus, stay at the rear of the
squad.
We're counting on you for repairs and
resupply.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_006.en:
Right, leave it to me.
As you can see, this old rig's got no
guns on her.
I'll be countin' on you for cover.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_007.en:
Roger.
Covering people is what I do.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_008.en: That's a really old vehicle, though.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_009.en:
Ha ha ha!
A weapon's only as good as the one
usin' it.
It ain't about looks, little missy.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_011.en: Ready to attack. We can go any time.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_013.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_016.en:
Reinforcements confirmed.
Looks like taking out the command
vehicle brings more.
We use that to wear them down.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_019.en:
But there are still forces left at
their base.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_020.en:
We wipe them all out.
All units, stay sharp.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_022.en:
Looks like this is the last of them.
No more signatures at the base.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_023.en:
Good. Let's finish this.
We wipe them out in one push.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_029.en:
You did good work too, Hephaestus.
I look forward to working with you.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_030.en:
Will do, missy.
Pleased to meet you all.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_001.en:
I'm Rain. Good to have you,
Hephaestus.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_002.en:
Oho, so you're the vice-captain, Rain.
My, you're even prettier in person
than on the monitor.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_004.en:
She looks all quiet, but she's
scary as hell.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_008.en:
The famous fighter, eh?
Used to watch ya on TV all the time.
So ya can drive a wanzer too?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_009.en:
Yeah.
In a wanzer, I'm all hand-to-hand.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_010.en:
I'm Gray.
Nice to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_011.en:
Hmm.
You're the most forgettable fella
in this squad, aren't ya.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_012.en:
Hephaestus, you're a mechanic,
right? Oh, I'm Oddeye.
Because my eyes are odd... huh?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_013.en:
Let's have a look, now... Oho, I see!
And ain't you a cute one too,
little missy.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_016.en:
Anything resembling sexual
harassment of female personnel
will be severely punished.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_018.en:
...My eyesight ain't what it was.
Sorry, sorry.
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.
Charmin' even when you're angry.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_019.en:
...That's it, I'm reporting this to
the Commander. Captain, please say
something to Hephaestus.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_020.en:
Rain, there's no need to report it.
Hephaestus is apparently an old
friend of the Commander's. He must
already know how the man behaves.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_023.en:
Hephaestus, communication is fine,
but too much of it causes problems.
Keep it in moderation.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_024.en:
Alright, alright.
All these pretty faces got an old
man carried away, that's all.
Hm?«g:24» That insignia...
Captain, you were with BATS!?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_025.en:
Yes, I was in it.
That's in the past.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_026.en:
Huh.
You know about BATS, Hephaestus?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_027.en:
A few of my engineer pals got
posted there. Then somethin'
happened, and the whole outfit
was disbanded.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_029.en:
Only rumors, mind, but they say an
experiment went wrong and that's why
they shut it down. Never heard from
any of the folks there again.
...Mind you, this is the first time
I've met a survivor of BATS.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_030.en:
Disbanded?«g:24»
That rumor's wrong.
I was there when the unit was wiped
out. (...Ngh... A headache...?)

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_031.en:
...Hmm. Ya talk like it happened to
somebody else.
Anyhow, pleased to be workin' with ya.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_032.en:
Rain, he said "all these pretty
faces." We got complimented, you
know? Feels kind of nice!

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_033.en:
Yes, yes.
We'll leave it at that, then...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_034.en:
Another larger-than-life character
in the squad, I see...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_036.en:
That old geezer's the Commander's
buddy? Seriously...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_037.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_039.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_040.en:
Huh.
You know about BATS, Hephaestus?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_042.en:
First time I've met a survivor
of BATS.
Well, pleased to be workin' with ya.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_043.en:
Right you are.
Leave the repairs and resupply to me.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_044.en:
Ah, you there, merc, got a minute?
I'm Thomas Norland.
Lieutenant, 1st Army.
Pleased to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_045.en:
Oh, uh, sure...
Wait, Thomas Norland? The Thomas
who stopped the Huffman Crisis?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_046.en:
Ga-ha-ha!«g:24»
What's this, you know me?
Well, well.
I've racked up plenty more since then,
mind you, but that one's so famous
nobody's heard about the rest.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_047.en:
Wow, this is an honor.
Um, could I shake your hand?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_048.en:
Ah, sorry about this.
I'm afraid I'm in the middle of an
operation. I've come in a hurry to
borrow some weapons and ammo.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_049.en:
Oh, I see.
Thanks for your hard work.
It's a regular army operation, so
we can hardly say no.
The Commander's approved it, right?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_050.en:
Of course he has.
Sorry to trouble you, then. I'll grab
what I need from the armoury.
Enough for one fight will do me fine.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_051.en: Oh, then should I give you a hand?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_052.en:
No, no, no need for that.
You lot have your own ops to run.
Don't mind me, go ahead and sortie.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_053.en:
Yes, sir, understood!
I'll be going, then.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_054.en:
Hm?«g:24»
Wasn't that Thomas?
Don't tell me the rascal's set his
sights on the merc base now...
Blast, I'd better tell the Captain...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_055.en:
I've been worryin' about a lot of
stuff lately, but war or no war,
I figure I'll just do what I can
right now.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_056.en:
Shresh talked with that old guy who
just showed up for a while, and all
of a sudden he's perked right up.
Maybe the old man's a good counselor.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_058.en:
We've picked up word of a factory
supplying weapons to enemy forces.
Apparently it mass-produces gear
developed back on the mainland.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_060.en:
Not the facility itself, this time.
The job is destroying the goods
before delivery. Targets are the
containers awaiting shipment and
the transports carrying them.
Once we hit them, the transports
will try to run. Stop them if you can.
Also, we've confirmed a number of
large defense wanzers at the factory.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_062.en:
That's right, a Sakata Industries
production plant. More of a
subcontractor's site, by the look
of it. Captain «E801:00», what's
wrong? You don't look too good.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_063.en:
It's nothing...
Mission acknowledged.
Priority targets: the containers
awaiting shipment and the transports.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_064.en:
The job is destroying the goods
before delivery. Targets are the
containers awaiting shipment and
the transports carrying them.
Once we hit them, the transports
will try to run. Stop them if you can.
Also, we've confirmed a number of
large defense wanzers at the factory.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_001.en:
That's the target arms factory.
Looks like they're loading for
shipment, just as the intel said.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_005.en:
Not one of those headaches?
Are you alright?

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_006.en:
We've had one battle after another.
Maybe it's fatigue.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_008.en:
Captain!
You're in no shape for an op...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_009.en:
Captain, fall back to the rear.
Leave this to us.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_010.en:
Aye.
I'll put in a word with the
Commander too. Best not push it,
sonny. Pull out for now.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_011.en:
S-sorry...
Withdrawing from the line for now.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_012.en:
I'll take command in the Captain's
place. Oddeye, handle recon, please.
All units, destroy the transports
and the containers awaiting shipment.
Begin the attack.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_014.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Rain is
destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_016.en:
That transport's trying to make
a run for it.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_019.en:
Hmm.
But it looks like the transports
come first.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_026.en:
Right, any machine that needs
repairs or resupply, pull up next
to my truck. I'll send ya back out
in tip-top condition.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_029.en:
Oh...
I'm sorry, it just slipped out...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_030.en:
Ha ha ha!
Grandpa suits me fine.
Beats bein' called a dirty old man!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_035.en:
This is bad. I didn't think they
had a machine like that left.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_038.en:
Sorry about that.
The headache's easing off.
Looks like that one's the last.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_039.en:
Looks that way.
Captain, you good to go?

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_040.en:
Yes. We take it down.
Badly damaged machines, move to the
rear and give cover.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_043.en:
Large enemy machine fully silenced.
Oh, Rain, I'm sorry...
Handing recon back to you.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_044.en:
Heh.
Thank you, Oddeye.
Good work.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_046.en:
Okay, Captain!
Straight home and into bed with you!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_047.en:
Aye.
You've got fatigue piled up too,
Captain. Get yourself a good rest
back at base.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_048.en: The Captain's always wound so tight.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_049.en: Leave things to us once in a while.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_002.en:
Sorry for the trouble.
I'm fine now.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_003.en:
That's the first time a headache's
hit you during a mission.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_004.en:
Yes.
Normally I keep the symptoms away
by focusing on the mission...
A captain like that is no captain.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_005.en:
These things happen sometimes.
Don't worry about it.
We'll cover for you.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_010.en:
These things happen sometimes.
Don't worry about it.
We'll cover for you.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_012.en: Captain, shouldn't you be in bed?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_013.en:
Sorry for the trouble.
I'm fine now.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_014.en:
Captain, I reckon you overthink stuff.
Loosen up a little, like me, and
just fight however your body moves.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_015.en: So you fight on reflex, Champ.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_016.en:
Yep.
"Enemy! Punch it!" That's the basics.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_017.en:
...That's the level of a true master.
I haven't reached it yet.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_018.en:
Captain, you really shouldn't take
anything the muscle-head says
seriously, okay?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_019.en:
Right.
It ain't like I'm sayin' anything
complicated, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_020.en:
Exactly. Anything the muscle-head
can do, I can do too.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_028.en:
That right there is what makes you
a muscle-head.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_029.en:
C'mon, when the adrenaline's
pumpin', don't you ever lose track?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_031.en:
...It may be what the sword masters
of ancient Japan called mushin:
the state of selflessness.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_033.en:
Muscle-head behavior...? Really?
He just isn't thinking, that's all.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_034.en:
Clear away stray thoughts, focus on
a single point, and act on reflex
before thought. ...Few can do it.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_035.en:
I'm really that amazing...?
Guess that's the great Champ for ya...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_036.en:
So I'm a "great Champ" too?
I kind of don't like that...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_037.en:
I'm really that amazing...?
Guess that's the great Champ for ya...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_038.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_039.en:
Captain... I can't tell if you
meant that or were just
buttering him up.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_040.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_041.en:
(These headaches... On the
battlefield, they could make me
a liability...)

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_043.en:
Looks like you're back on your
feet, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_044.en:
Sorry about that, Hephaestus.
If those symptoms keep showing up,
I'm not fit to be captain.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_045.en:
You've got a record that outweighs
it, Captain. And your squad's strong.
Trust 'em, and take a breather
now and then.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_046.en: But if I lean on them too much...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_047.en:
Don't fret over it.
Havin' a weak spot just means
you're human too, Captain.
Strong as you are, without one
you'd be nothin' but a combat machine.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_048.en:
A combat machine...
That's what I've always wanted to be.
It's the ideal form of a soldier.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_049.en:
Well, maybe so.
But ya should enjoy life more.
Like me!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_050.en:
I see. The secret of a
battle-hardened veteran.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_051.en:
Aye.
The secret to a long life.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_052.en:
Right, think I'll go practice the
secret to a long life again today.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_053.en:
Right you are.
Leave the repairs and resupply to me.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_054.en:
Heard «E801:00» gets headaches.
Want me to share some of my
herbal medicine?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_055.en:
Gabriel... He only meant to cheer
Oddeye up, and he ended up
confessing to her...
Talk about the worst timing ever......

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_057.en:
I heard about it. Looks like your
headache got in the way of a
mission.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_058.en:
I apologize.
If it happens again, I intend
to step down from the squad.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_059.en:
No. You and your squad have
achieved more than enough to make
up for it. Forget the headache.
Now, the brass has sent a special
request for «E801:00» Squad.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_061.en:
Between your many reports and what
happened to Delta, the brass has
finally got off its backside.
The army has officially recognized
the "Vampires" and declared them
hostile. They mean to look into how
the Vampires tie in with the missing
mercs, and deal with it.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_062.en:
About time...
Is the army moving in directly?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_063.en:
No. With the ceasefire agreement,
regular army involvement is tricky.
So they want «E801:00» Squad to join
the "Anti-Vampire Operation."
From now on your main job will be
taking out the Vampires' elite,
the "Numbers."
Naturally, the pay's generous.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_064.en:
Sounds like a large-scale sweep.
So those special machines are
called the Numbers.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_065.en:
That's right.
And the people planning this op
aren't the army, they're a
government organization.
Naturally, it's highly classified.
Something seems to be going on
higher up... but that's all
they've told us.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_066.en:
A merc doesn't need to know more
than that. ...The Vampires seem to
be mercs too. If it's merc against
merc, it's no different from our
usual work. Alright, I'll take it.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_067.en:
I knew you'd say that.
First up, I want you to hit a
Vampire forward base.
Intel already puts the Numbers there.
There should be an informant near
the base. They'll make contact on
site, so get the details from them.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_069.en:
An enemy forward base will be
well defended, mind.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_070.en:
Still, no different from any other
mission. We sortie once we're ready.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_071.en:
First up, I want you to hit a
Vampire forward base.
Intel already puts the Numbers there.
There should be an informant near
the base. They'll make contact on
site, so get the details from them.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_001.en:
Multiple enemy contacts confirmed.
No sign of the Numbers yet.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_003.en:
If the intel's right, there's likely
a facility hidden underground.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_006.en: Captain, they're about to spot us.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_007.en:
Alright. We take down whatever comes
into view and wait for the informant.
All units, prepare for combat.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_012.en:
...How did they find this place?
No matter. Moths to the flame.
Ifrit Team, burn the intruders
to ash!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_013.en:
Intruders confirmed!
Lord Ifrit!
Someone's attacking the base!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_014.en:
...How did they find this place?
No matter. Moths to the flame.
Ifrit Team, burn the intruders
to ash!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_015.en:
Who the hell are you!? Whoa!?
Enemy attack!!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_016.en:
...How did they find this place?
No matter. Moths to the flame.
Ifrit Team, burn the intruders
to ash!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_017.en:
Intruders confirmed.
They're inside the base perimeter!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_018.en:
...How did they find this place?
No matter. Moths to the flame.
Ifrit Team, burn the intruders
to ash!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_019.en:
Special machine confirmed.
It's the Numbers!
It's packing fire weapons, same as
the defenders!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_020.en:
Confirmed.
Rain, any word from the informant?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_022.en: Maybe the enemy got to them...

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_023.en:
Either way, now that the Numbers
are here, taking them out is the
priority. All units, stay sharp.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_025.en:
Captain!
Another Numbers machine!
It's the katana user we ran
into before!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_026.en:
Him...
No choice. We split the squad
in two.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_027.en:
«E801:00» Squad, do you read?
This is Dark Knight, your informant.
The black wanzer carrying a sword.
I am moving to support you.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_029.en:
Dark Knight.
Good timing.
Cover me.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_030.en:
Unfortunately for you, Ifrit,
I have long wanted to face you.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_035.en:
Tch, a spy...?
Then you're going down with me!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_036.en:
Dark Knight
«E801:00» Squad, explanations later.
First, we wipe out this unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_037.en:
I can't trust you just like that.
All units, if Dark Knight turns his
guns on us, treat it as hostile
and engage. Understood?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_039.en: That is as it should be.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_041.en:
To have held out this long alone...
Well fought, Ifrit.
Your skill was real.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_043.en:
Enemy unit silenced, Numbers
included. No hostile action
from Dark Knight.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_044.en:
Downing the Numbers with such ease.
I expected no less of «E801:00» Squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_045.en:
You're one of the Numbers yourself,
but you talk like it's got nothing
to do with you.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_047.en:
I still have work to do.
I will say only that I am not your
enemy, for now.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_048.en:
So you're spying on the
Vampires...?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_049.en:
Think what you will.
Let me give you one warning.
There should be a survivor of a
former squad in «E801:00» Squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_051.en:
Your squad's former captain is
operating as one of the Numbers.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_052.en:
What...!?
Captain Lancer is one of the
Numbers...

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_053.en:
X-24. He calls himself Dragoon.
Whether the organization behind him
is using him or he was lured by the
money, even I cannot say. But the
Vampires are mercenaries all the
same. He follows orders and carries
out inhumane operations. That much
is certain.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_055.en:
Dark Knight...
Can't you prove you're on our side?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_056.en:
Rotor noise confirmed. Captain,
aircraft approaching!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_057.en:
My apologies. It seems there is no
time here. The next operation is a
simultaneous attack on two sites.
Dragoon will likely appear.
I will continue preparing for it.
Once ready, I will contact you
through your superiors.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_058.en:
If the orders come from HQ,
we'll follow them.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_059.en:
Good.
That you do not trust me easily
is also to my liking.
Staying longer is dangerous.
Withdraw.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_003.en:
Can someone who was a comrade not
long ago really become an enemy?
And someone who was a captain here
at that...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_004.en:
...It's possible, for someone who
sees merc work as strictly business.
For professional mercs, friend and
foe can switch with every battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_005.en:
But...
My old captain cared about his
comrades more than anyone.
I can only think something happened
to him.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_006.en:
......
It's one of the most common kinds
of trouble between mercs.
That's why communication between
mercs is kept to a minimum.
Nobody pries into anyone's past or
reasons for signing up. It's an
unspoken rule.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_007.en:
I... understand that in my head...
But I feel horribly betrayed.
If I meet him on the battlefield,
I'll ask him myself.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_008.en: Keep a cool head when you do.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_010.en:
Captain Lancer...
Was it all just business to you,
I wonder...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_012.en:
I dunno about that Dark Knight guy.
I don't trust him.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_013.en:
He did say he wasn't our enemy.
I wonder who he really is.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_014.en: His hair was really long, wasn't it?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_015.en:
THAT'S what you noticed!?
Normal people would be thinkin'
more like, "Is he shady?"...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_016.en: Well, honestly, I noticed it too.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_017.en:
Shady stuff...
Hmmm.
Captain, did anything catch your eye?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_019.en:
Yes, yes!
Glasses and long black hair!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_020.en:
Hold on a sec...
We ain't talkin' about lookin' shady!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_021.en:
True. When it comes to looking
shady, the muscle-head's got him
beat anyway.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_023.en:
You've totally got a villain face,
and way too many muscles.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_024.en:
A villain face with muscles...
Shut up!
This is just my face, and I work
out, okay!?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_025.en:
Hmmm.
For one of the Vampires, Dark Knight
was a real pretty-boy character.
Oh, that's why he's shady!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_026.en:
I don't think that has anything
to do with it.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_027.en:
Either way, we know very little.
We've fought him several times.
Asking us to trust him out of
nowhere is too much.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_028.en:
He might win us over and then shoot
us in the back. Okay, everybody,
don't stand in front of him.
And keep a target lock on him
at all times.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_029.en:
Um, wouldn't that make it look like
we don't trust him...?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_030.en: Tch, so what are we s'posed to do...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_031.en:
If he makes a suspicious move,
I'll shoot him. The rest of you
just act normal.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_034.en:
Act normal, huh.
Wait, my normal is... all fired up.
So that's okay?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_035.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_036.en:
Glasses and long black hair...
Oh, that's me.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_037.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_038.en:
Surely he won't stab us in the
back right away.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_040.en:
Captain, looks like we've got a
visiting technician.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_042.en:
That's the one.
Does he come round here often?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_043.en:
We've tested new parts for him
a few times.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_044.en:
Well now, that man's a genius.
There ain't an engineer alive who
doesn't know him. His tests were
famous for bein' tough to pass.
If he's in and out of here that
often, he must rate you lot highly.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_045.en:
So that's how it is.
I took him for an oddball.
I didn't know he was famous.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_046.en: Well, maybe I'll go say hello later.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_047.en: Well, maybe I'll go say hello later.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_049.en:
Lancer was with the black unit...?
He did a lot for me, too...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_050.en:
Gabriel took getting turned down so
hard, he's decided to quit...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_051.en:
...I'm... going home...
This job... isn't for me...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_052.en: I hear you met the informant.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_053.en:
I've fought that machine several
times. I can't fully trust him.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_054.en:
He's one of the Numbers.
I'd say if he weren't the kind of man
you'd suspect, the organization
would suspect him instead.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_055.en:
Maybe so.
So, what are his instructions?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_056.en:
He seems to be preparing the op.
Before that, we'd commissioned
special parts for fighting the
Vampires. I want you to test the
prototypes this time.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_058.en:
The visiting technician's waiting
at the Killhouse. If the trial goes
without problems, you're free to
keep using the parts.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_060.en:
That's right.
Apparently the targets are wanzers he
tuned using data on the Numbers.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_062.en:
He says the prototype weapons can
only run for a limited time.
He wants results fast.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_064.en:
He says the prototype weapons can
only run for a limited time.
He wants results fast.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_001.en:
Is everyone ready?
The parts fitted to the mock enemy
machines have a time limit.
Do be careful.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_003.en:
Still...
Lycov, you really put together
a wanzer like that...?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_004.en:
Yeah.
How do I put this...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_005.en:
If you've got firepower like that,
maybe send it our way instead...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_006.en:
Hmm.
I understand what you mean.
This is, ah, my personal property.
I built it as a hobby, you see...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_009.en:
I-I'm not...
I'm not into that kind of thing!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_010.en:
Heh heh heh.
This mock enemy is not just for
show! Brace yourselves!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_011.en: What are you, the final boss...?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_012.en:
Ahem...
The mock battle will now begin.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_014.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_016.en:
You really are strong.
Now, on to the main event!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_020.en: Ignore it. We take it down.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_022.en:
The mock battle seems to have gone
smoothly.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_031.en:
Aww, Lycov...
I kind of feel sorry for him.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_033.en:
Phew. We played it too safe
after all.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_034.en:
Well? What do you think of my
special machine's power!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_035.en: There was hesitation in my piloting.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_036.en:
...Once we heard it was your
personal property, we held back.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_037.en:
Well, wouldn't happen in a real
fight, though.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_039.en:
Lycov...
You did get the mock battle data,
right?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_040.en:
Ah, yes...
I got the data.
The test is over...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_001.en:
Mm, oho, I see...!
Now this... this is top quality!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_003.en:
Aye.
One of the joys of my life.
Here, Captain, care for a look?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_005.en:
Exactly so.
"Oh my, Catherine's udderly
flustered!" as they say.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_006.en:
...You call it reading, but I'd say
this kind of book doesn't have
many words.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_007.en:
Never mind that.
Books like this, ya read with
your heart.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_010.en:
Hey, Hephaestus!
Don't bring books like that into
the barracks!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_012.en:
Rain, I don't think it's anything
to worry that much about.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_013.en:
Huh!? C-Captain...
Honestly, Hephaestus, showing the
Captain a book like that...
Get rid of it, now!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_014.en:
Alright, alright, I hear ya!
"Oh my, Rain's udderly flustered!"
as they say.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_016.en:
C-C-Captain, what are you looking
at...? Don't compare me to a
gravure model!!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_017.en:
Captain «E801:00», that there's the
secret of a battle-hardened
veteran... Wait, Rain, hold it!
Not the fist! Not the fist!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_018.en:
Hephaestus throws me completely
off balance... Honestly...
And I am NOT a cow!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_020.en:
So what's actually different about
bein' an anti-Vampire merc unit?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_021.en:
The army's admitted the Vampires
exist, but officially stepping in
would be bad, so they're having
mercs carry out the operation.
That's my guess.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_022.en:
But all we gotta do is beat the
black unit, right?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_027.en: We've got a cooler title now.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_029.en:
But our squad's name is still
"«E801:00» Squad." While we're at
it, why not rebrand? Like the
Vampire Busters, or the Vampire
Hunters! Captain, got any good
name ideas?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_030.en:
The squad's name?
Is there any point to rebranding?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_031.en:
To celebrate becoming an
anti-Vampire merc unit! A fresh
start! That kind of thing.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_032.en:
Celebrate, fresh start...
We don't need any of that...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_033.en:
Hmmm. They're a vampire squad,
right? Oh, how about "Garlic and
the Silver Bullets"?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_034.en:
I kind of think the first ones
were better.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_035.en:
All of a sudden we sound like
a comedy act...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_036.en:
Champ's the garlic, and the Silver
Bullets are the rest of us.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_038.en:
I know you love your food, Champ,
but garlic isn't quite meat...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_039.en:
...Hmmm.
Thinking up names is hard work.
Let's just stick with
«E801:00» Squad after all.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_040.en:
Having my own codename as the
squad's name did bother me a
little, too. But I've gotten used
to it by now.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_043.en:
All we gotta do is beat the
Vampires. Same as always.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_044.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_045.en:
Hmmm. Once you start thinking about
names, you can't stop, right?
Silver bullets, cross and stake,
holy water... Hmm... Nothing good
is coming to me...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_046.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_047.en:
Renaming aside, the Vampire Busters
or the Hunters does sound pretty
cool.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_049.en:
Boo hoo... Farewell, my sweet
little Catherine...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_050.en:
Little Catherine...
Oops, a mission, eh?
Comin' right away.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_051.en: Lieutenant Thomas Norland, I take it?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_052.en:
(Gulp.)
Oh, so you're Captain «E801:00».
Pleased to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_053.en:
I heard from Hephaestus.
He says you've been diverting
weapons and food somewhere.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_054.en:
(Tch, so Hephaestus is here.)
Ga-ha-ha!
No, no, that's ancient history.
I don't do that sort of thing now.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_055.en:
Is that so?
Then what about the supplies you
took from our base? The Commander
never approved that. I hear you
told Champ and Gray otherwise.
Is it even alright for me to report
that you're here right now?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_056.en:
(No good. Can't fool this one.)
Ah... sorry.
I give up.
It's true, I took them without
permission. Please forgive me.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_057.en:
In Estonia and on Huffman Island,
you're a hero.
Why do this?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_058.en:
Same reason I got that medal from
Estonia. War always leaves civilians
orphaned and wounded. And plenty of
them get no help from anyone.
I share food with folks like that,
and weapons to protect themselves.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_059.en:
Hephaestus told me about the medal.
And about what you're probably
doing now.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_060.en:
Then that saves time.
Won't you let this one slide?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_061.en:
......I did think our food ration
was generous. You can take about a
third of the food store.
No more weapons or ammunition.
We'll need them from here on.
And you'd better not come back to
this base. Any more and it's likely
to be traced back to you.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_062.en:
Ga-ha-ha!
Glad you're a man who understands!
I'll do as you say.
Thanks, I mean it.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_063.en:
Don't mention it.
I'm the one wandering from
battlefield to battlefield. I share
the blame for what those battlefields
leave behind.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_064.en:
......That's one way to live, in
this world. But don't think too hard
about it. All you can do is believe
you'll make up for it someday.
See you.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_065.en:
So those black guys are called the
Vampires, huh... Kinda cool, for
the enemy...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_066.en:
With Gabriel gone, the operator
rotation's brutal. And there's no
way to get a replacement.
That guy, quitting just because
he got dumped...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_068.en: It seems he's joined the Numbers.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_069.en:
I can't believe it, but...
According to Dark Knight, he goes
by Dragoon.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_073.en:
Captain «E801:00», word just came
from the brass. With the Vampires
spreading their forces across
Huffman, we'll hit two fortified
strongholds at the same time.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_075.en:
Right.
Split «E801:00» Squad into two teams
and hit both sites at once.
Team A: Captain «E801:00», Oddeye.
Team B: Rain, Champ, Gray and
Hephaestus.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_076.en:
Roger.
I'll take command of Team B.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_077.en:
Team B takes the airbase.
Its defences aren't to be taken
lightly, but seize the control tower.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_079.en:
Likely.
Intel puts Dragoon at the airbase,
Team B's target.
...Rain, want to swap with
Captain «E801:00»?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_080.en:
No, I'm fine.
There's something I need to confirm
there in person.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_081.en:
I see...
One more thing: so as not to damage
the facility, the airbase garrison
has no launchers. Expect mostly
machine guns. Go in with
anti-piercing armor.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_083.en:
Captain «E801:00», Team A is to
destroy a fortified factory.
Dark Knight is undercover there.
He should have valuable intel, such
as the fortress's weak points.
Follow his lead on site.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_084.en:
Then we start the mission once we
link up with Dark Knight.
Do we know the enemy's armament?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_085.en:
Most likely no machine guns, so they
don't damage the factory.
Expect mainly fire weapons.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_086.en:
Roger. If the intel's good,
anti-heat armor will do the job.
We sortie once we're equipped.
Let's go, Rain.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_088.en:
Split «E801:00» Squad into two teams
and hit both sites at once.
Team A: Captain «E801:00», Oddeye.
Team B: Rain, Champ, Gray and
Hephaestus.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_089.en:
Hey, get the army to rein in
«E801:00» Squad already. They ain't
exactly my pals, but the Numbers
are down by half. It's gettin' in
the way of business.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_090.en:
I'm afraid that's impossible.
The army brass have begun to
question your work.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_091.en:
Hm?
The army's backing out already?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_092.en:
I didn't say that.
Your work is still needed, by our
company and by the army. But they
can no longer cover for you.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_093.en:
Can't cover for us...
We're doin' this for the army in
the end, and now that same army's
comin' after us?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_094.en:
The ceasefire keeps the regulars
out of it. Instead, «E801:00» Squad
has become a unit dedicated to you.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_096.en:
...Now I get it.
If we take out «E801:00» Squad and
the plan works, great. If they take
us out instead, the plan gets dropped
and everyone plays dumb. «E801:00»
wipes out the evidence, the Vampires,
for 'em.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_097.en: Heh. So, what will you do, Lich?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_098.en:
Me...? I fight.
I got paid plenty up front.
And I made Raven a promise.
Besides, A-- I mean, «E801:00»...
This time I'm gonna settle things
with him.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_099.en:
Good.
Carry on with your mission.
And it seems the army has been
getting wind of your movements of
late. Be careful.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_100.en:
Huh...
I've got an idea about that
myself. Got it.
I'll be careful.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_001.en:
Team A... at the target.
Team B, status... report?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_002.en:
Team B here.
Arrived outside the airbase.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_003.en:
Simultaneous assault on both sites.
Time check, ready?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_005.en:
Captain, Dark... Knight still
hasn't arrived.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_007.en:
With the enemy strength here,
Team B can go in first without
any trouble.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_008.en:
Roger.
Team A will wait one minute, then
begin. Team B, start the operation
as planned.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_009.en:
Alright, Team B!
Let's get this party started!

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: Rain is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_014.en:
That giant assault lance...
It really is Captain Lancer...
Champ, Gray, Numbers confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_016.en:
An attack, at this moment...
A merc unit...
Is that you, Rain...?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_017.en:
Hmm.
Just the one special machine.
Shouldn't be a problem.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_018.en:
All units, that machine must be
Dragoon. He specializes in
hit-and-run charges with that
giant assault lance...

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_019.en:
Hell of a weapon...
So closing in is dangerous, huh...
But Rain, we're clear to attack him,
right?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_020.en:
Go ahead.
Someone who went over to the
enemy...

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_021.en:
Rain.
You've grown strong...
If I am to be shot down, I would
have it be by you.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_022.en:
Dra...goon, don't be in such a...
hurry to die. Abandon that facility...
Pull out and link up with...
Demon.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_023.en:
But Rain is...
A survivor of my squad is here.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_024.en:
That adapter, huh.
But she's already...
Forget it.
More to the point, I can't afford to
burn through any more Numbers.
If you don't pull out...
You know what happens, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_027.en:
Don't, Rain.
It could be a trap!

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_028.en:
Our job right now is taking the
control tower, not downing the
Numbers. Are you okay, Rain?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_029.en:
Roger...
Sorry, everyone.
Continuing the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_031.en:
Team B here.
We've taken the airbase.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_034.en:
As planned, let's link up with
Team A.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_001.en:
Team A, at the target.
Team B, status report?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_002.en:
Team B... here.
Arrived outside... the airbase.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_003.en:
Simultaneous assault on both sites.
Time check, ready?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_005.en:
Captain, Dark Knight still
hasn't arrived.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_007.en:
With the enemy strength... here,
Team B can go... in first without
any trouble.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_008.en:
Roger.
Team A will wait one minute, then
begin. Team B, start the operation
as planned.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_009.en:
Alright... Team B!
Let's get this... party started!

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_012.en:
Still no Dark Knight...
It's almost been a minute.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_013.en:
Can't be helped.
Team A, begin the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_015.en:
Victory: Destroy all containers.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_017.en:
Numbers signal detected.
Oh! Captain, it's Dark Knight.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_018.en:
Forgive me.
I am late for our appointment.
I see Team A is Captain «E801:00»
and Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_019.en:
Team B is already carrying out
its operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_020.en:
Understood.
Then a brief rundown of the
fortress assault. Destroy every
container inside the facility.
One minute after the last container
is destroyed, the bombs I planted
underground will go off -- loudly.
Once the containers are down,
withdraw quickly so you are not
caught in the blast.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_022.en: And if the Numbers show up?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_023.en:
That will not be a concern.
The officer in charge of defending
this site is X-03 Dark Knight.
In other words, me.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_024.en:
So you mined the facility
you were assigned to guard...
Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_025.en: Let us be quick about it.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_026.en:
Whelps.
You dare make a fool of me.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_027.en:
Enemy reinforcements.
...Is that one of the Numbers too?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_030.en:
This was not planned.
I was to defend this site alone.
And he is one of the strongest
among the Vampires. Alone, I would
never challenge him...
How did he find out...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_031.en:
Can we still put the containers
first?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_032.en:
You can, but...
Fight Demon head-on and you will
not come away unscathed.
Captain «E801:00», it may be wiser
to fall back and face him when
your whole squad is together...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_033.en:
Whatever enemy shows up,
there will be damage.
But we've always put the mission
first. That's what a merc does.
Oddeye, we keep destroying
the containers.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_034.en:
Roger.
Besides, that machine is the same
as the other Numbers we've fought.
No matter how much they tune it,
it doesn't look like anything that
special.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_035.en:
I see. You are the squad that
has been taking down the Numbers...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_036.en:
Yep! We're kind of used to this
sort of fight by now.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_038.en:
I've been hit? Me!?
Tch... No choice.
Lich, I'm abandoning the fortress.
Dark Knight is the spy after all.
Looks like he's thrown in with them.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_039.en:
Ahh, figured as much.
That makes everything fit.
Can't be helped...
Link up with Dragoon and regroup.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_041.en: Um, that enemy just ran away...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_042.en:
To come away from a fight with
Demon with so little damage...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_043.en:
If what you said is true, Dark
Knight, that wanzer might've had
some maintenance problems.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_044.en:
No...
I suspect he underestimated you...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_047.en:
Understood.
Now I see why the Vampires keep
falling, one after another.
Fighting beside you made it clear.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_048.en:
Good.
All containers destroyed.
Detonation is imminent.
Let us withdraw from the facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_049.en: All units, withdraw at full speed.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_050.en:
All units have reached the
withdrawal point.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_056.en:
Looks like Team B took the
control tower.
Dark Knight, what's the next move?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_057.en:
It seems you now believe
I am on your side.
First, we resupply. Let us move
to our true forward base.
Commander Falcon should be
there as well.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_001.en:
The enemy Dragoon really was
Captain Lancer, my old captain.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_002.en:
I see.
So, Rain. Can you shoot him?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_003.en:
He attacked us too.
There's no choice but to shoot.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_004.en:
Understood.
But if it gets to be too much,
tell me. I'll shoot in your place.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_005.en:
Thank you for your concern.
But I'm a professional mercenary
too. I'll simply shoot anyone
who takes hostile action...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_007.en:
I'm a professional mercenary too.
I'll simply shoot anyone who takes
hostile action...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_009.en:
Captain, this temporary forward
base is really well equipped.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_011.en:
Check it out! There's a hot spring
right next to the showers!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_012.en:
Huh? A hot spring!!
I wanna try it!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_013.en:
If I remember right, this area was
volcanically active back in the
early settlement days.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_014.en:
Bit dusty outside, but there's
a lake too. How come nobody
turned this place into a resort?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_015.en:
This land got dragged into border
disputes early on. No company
would run a resort somewhere
that dangerous.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_018.en:
I love them!
I wonder what the water's good for?
Maybe it's like the hot springs
in Hawaii. I'm going right now!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_019.en:
Hold it, Oddeye.
This is a temporary army base,
y'know? The fence is flimsy, and
it's mixed bathing!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_020.en:
It's fine!
I'll wear the swimsuit I bought
with Rain the other day!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_021.en:
Sounds like fun.
Oddeye...
Captain, you got a swimsuit...
Nah, course you don't...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_023.en:
Tch...
I was gonna borrow one...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_024.en:
