Then a real man goes in buck naked!
...Nah, Rain might shoot me...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_025.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_026.en:
Hmm hmm hmmm~
Phew. The water in these showers
feels different from the old base.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_027.en:
Intruder acquired...
Target confirmed...
Codename: Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_028.en:
Hm? Hephaestus, what are
you mumbling about?
...Wait... are you a spy!?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_029.en:
Shh! Gray, is it?
Ya'll tip off the little missy...
C'mere.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_030.en:
Huh? There's a bath outside?
Hey, wait, that's Oddeye in there!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_031.en:
Hmph, a swimsuit, little missy?
That's cheatin'...
Now, this here's a hot spring.
Loaded with B vitamins.
Good for sunburn and such.
In other words, good for the skin.
The lady soldiers'll be tickled.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_032.en:
Hephaestus, this looks exactly
like we're peeping.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_033.en:
Nope, absolutely not.
This is a mission simulation.
How to gather intel without the
enemy spottin' ya.
Hm, looks like the Captain's
comin'... Gray, she's all yours!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_034.en:
A simulation...
You're the supply guy, aren't you?
And what do you mean, all mine...
Now it looks like I'm the only
one peeping...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_035.en: Gray, what are you doing there?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_036.en:
Captain...
See, Hephaestus was here and...
No, that just sounds like an excuse...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_037.en:
Hm? So this is the hot spring.
Looks like Oddeye's in.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_038.en:
Captain, she'll notice us.
N-not that I'm peeping, but...
what is this feeling? It's almost
like guilt...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_039.en:
Oh?
Captain? Gray?
What are you doing over there?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_040.en:
Nothing. Gray was here,
so we were talking.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_041.en:
Captain, that sounds like an
excuse too...
Dammit, Hephaestus...
You've landed us in a real mess...
Sorry for dragging you into this,
Captain...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_042.en:
Gray, why are you flustered?
This spring is mixed bathing.
I don't see any problem with
looking in from outside.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_043.en:
Huh... So we're not peeping
on the women's bath, then...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_044.en:
Quit mumbling, you two,
and come on in!
It feels great!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_045.en:
Ah, Oddeye, I don't have a
swimsuit either. I'll go in later.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_046.en:
Okay!
But the water's a little hot
for me. I'm getting out now~

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_047.en:
Heard there was mixed bathin',
so here I am!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_049.en:
What!?
...Well, that's no fun at all.
And now two fellas are peepin'
at me... What's an old man to do?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_050.en:
Hm, looks like some other soldiers
are coming in. Hephaestus, don't
bother the other soldiers.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_051.en:
Gwah!
A whole pack of brawny soldiers!!
I'm gettin' out.
Hey! Outta the way, you lot!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_052.en:
Hephaestus, the water seems hot.
Don't overdo it.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_053.en:
The water's on the hot side,
but that was a lovely soak.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_054.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
Oh, I'd better get changed!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_055.en:
Hephaestus got me good...
I'll watch out from now on.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_057.en:
Gwah!
I said outta the way, you lot!
I'm cookin', I'm cookin'...!!
Heeelp meeee!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_058.en:
All those brawny soldiers...
Oops, mission time, eh...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_059.en:
So you're the Anti-Vampire unit.
Pleased to meet you.
I'm Sam, operator.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_060.en:
Dean, maintenance crew.
Glad to have you.
Oh, Mr. Kinoshita came to this base
along with your commander.
And I'd bet good money we've got
parts your base didn't stock.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_061.en:
Good work on the last operation.
Let me introduce Investigator Roy
of CISU. He's at the center of
this operation.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_062.en:
Perhaps "Dark Knight" would mean
more to you.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_063.en:
I'm «E801:00».
CISU...
So you were OCU Central
Intelligence.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_064.en:
That is right.
Commander Falcon, please brief him.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_065.en:
Yes, sir.
Thanks to the simultaneous assault,
we've cut the enemy forces off
from each other completely.
The investigator's intel says
there's a bridge north of here
leading to their stronghold.
Head there at once and take it.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_066.en:
So we're finally going after
their main camp.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_067.en:
Yes.
Taking the bridge is the first step.
I will accompany you on this
operation, but in combat I will
place myself under Captain
«E801:00»'s command.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_068.en:
An investigator under a merc's
command?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_069.en:
Naturally.
He is the more capable of us.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_070.en:
...I see... If that's what you
want, Investigator...
«E801:00» Squad, take the bridge
and push straight on through.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_071.en:
Take this bridge, and the Vampires
are completely cut off, while our
own resupply gets easier.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_074.en:
The two Numbers routed in the last
op may be lying low there.
Stay sharp.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_075.en:
Dragoon, once captain of Rain's
old squad, and the veteran merc
Demon. Even for you, the two of
them together are a danger
beyond measure... You will need
the utmost care.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_076.en:
Mission understood.
Investigator Roy, one question?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_077.en:
Roy will do.
What is it?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_078.en:
How long were you running with
the Vampires? Couldn't you have
stopped what they were doing?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_079.en:
Captain «E801:00», that's not
information a merc needs to know.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_080.en:
No, Falcon, it is fine.
He is already deeply involved
in this affair.

...The truth is, soldiers and mercs
began disappearing near the border
about two years ago. Abduction by
the enemy was suspected, yet the
army never properly investigated.
So we at CISU began looking into it.

I sold my services to the group
abducting those soldiers and
succeeded in infiltrating it.
For a year after that, I lived
as one of the Vampires.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_081.en:
So you took part in kidnapping
mercs, too.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_082.en:
To earn the enemy's trust.
It weighed on me, but there was
no alternative.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_083.en:
It was the mission.
I won't blame you for that.
But would you say a few words
to Oddeye?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_084.en:
...About Faceless.
There is something I wish to
tell her as well.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_085.en:
There's a bridge north of here
leading to their stronghold.
Head there at once and take it.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_001.en: It seems all units have arrived.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_003.en:
Yes.
The Vampires have already scattered
across Huffman. The aim of this
operation is to take the bridge
so they cannot return to their
stronghold.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_004.en:
I hear anti-Vampire units are being
formed outside the main force, too.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_005.en:
Well, "formed" is generous.
They are closer to volunteers...
Emotional types chasing the
Vampires on their own.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_007.en:
Our squad's pretty emotional too,
right?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_009.en:
What?
It ain't just me, is it?
Well, the Captain's always cool
as ice, I guess...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_010.en:
Either way, I'd love to meet them
sometime. The Emotional Brigade.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_013.en:
Well, if this operation succeeds,
perhaps you will meet them.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_015.en:
Enemy machines confirmed.
All units, eliminate the hostiles
around the bridge.
Watch out for the Numbers.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_017.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_019.en:
Dark Knight, as I thought...
All units, Dark Knight's machine
is hostile. Don't be fooled by
its friendly signal. Wipe it out
along with the mercs.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_020.en:
The traitor...
And Rain...
Then I will settle this with
my own hands.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_021.en:
Dragoon, wait.
Don't be so eager to die.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_022.en:
Leave me be, Demon.
I want to settle things with my
own sense of justice.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_023.en:
I've no time to indulge your
self-satisfaction. Right now we
can't afford to waste one machine,
not even yours. Coordinate with me.
First find out whether this is an
enemy you can beat alone.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_024.en:
Dragoon, you're under Demon's
command now. You know your men's
lives are mine to do with as I
please, right? No dying on your
own. Got it?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_025.en:
(Even if I am defeated... the
result would be the same...
Damn you, Lich...)
...Roger.
I will not waste myself.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_026.en:
We throw every unit on this bridge
at them, and once they're worn
down, we strike all at once.
Understood, Dragoon?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_028.en:
So that unit's strength is
the real thing...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_029.en: Is retreat all that is left...?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_030.en:
Lich...
It's bad.
At this rate, the bridge will fall.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_031.en:
Well, that's not good...
Fine. I'll have the tech team
start up that thing.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_033.en:
It'll move, alright.
The material was a top-notch
soldier, after all.
You two Numbers, fall back
to POINT G.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_034.en:
...Roger.
Then we abandon the bridge and
fall back. Sorry, defense team.
Buy us some time.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_036.en:
Retreating again...
Lancer...
Can't you even fight me properly
anymore...?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_037.en:
Don't dwell on it, Rain.
We're finishing off the bridge.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_039.en:
Two special machines got away,
but we'll pursue them right away.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_042.en:
Their withdrawal bothers me.
It is as if they are leading
us on...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_043.en:
Leading us...?
Do they have some kind of powerful
weapon or something?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_044.en:
I have something in mind.
It was called the B2 prototype...
If it is operational, it will be
a serious threat. But I heard that,
unlike a wanzer, only a few pilots
could operate it.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_045.en:
I've heard of that weapon.
Bein' built for some bigwig or
other, so they said. A whole
different concept from your
regular wanzer...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_047.en:
Be a merc long enough and ya
get to know a lot of folks.
But I also heard a fair few
engineers died in the tests,
or whatever they were doin'
with that machine...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_048.en:
I see. Engineers among the
victims as well...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_049.en:
You're saying that prototype may
be waiting where we're headed.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_050.en:
Rather than pressing on like this,
we would do better to return to
the forward base and resupply.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_051.en:
Roger.
Bridge secured.
All units, resupply before we
advance.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_002.en:
As Roy said, it's probably a plan
aimed at us. Still, those two
Numbers are very battle-seasoned.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_003.en:
Captain Lancer understood wanzers
better than anyone in the squad.
I heard he was a merc on other
battlefields before he came to
Huffman.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_005.en: Next time, I intend to settle this.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_007.en: Next time, I intend to settle this.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_009.en:
The other outfit, huh.
Wonder what they're like?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_010.en:
Apparently they're not even proper
mercs. They've got sponsors,
though.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_011.en:
Either way, we've made it this far
partly thanks to their work.
If I get the chance, I'd like to
talk with them.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_012.en: They must be a really good unit.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_013.en:
Bet they're about as tough as us,
or close to it.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_014.en:
Wonder if they've got any cute
girls in that unit, eh?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_015.en:
Your skirt-chasing's got no limits,
old man...

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_016.en:
And thanks to that, I got put
through the wringer last time.
Don't drag us into it again.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_017.en:
The secret to a long life,
I suppose. Still, best avoid
anything that invites
misunderstanding.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_018.en:
I know, I know.
The Captain's the only one
who understands me, eh.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_019.en:
Somehow I don't think that's what
he meant... Eh, whatever.
Guess I'll get ready for the next
fight.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_020.en:
Guess I'll get ready for the next
fight.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_021.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_024.en:
Oh, Captain.
That's Dark Knight, isn't it?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_027.en: Unusual to see you down here.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_034.en:
He was my friend.
And Delta was working with us.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_036.en:
"My close friend Roy"...
So that was you...

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_037.en:
I wish I could have helped you
sooner... But I was investigating
the Vampires from the inside and
could not move freely. That is why,
from time to time, I passed you
information through the army.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_038.en:
I was also the one who gave Delta
its orders.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_040.en:
He told me about you often.
Whenever you came up, he looked
so very happy.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_041.en:
David...
Roy, do you think David's
still alive?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_042.en:
There was no body at the scene.
Which means he may already have
been sent to the facility.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_044.en:
Some kind of experiments are being
conducted there. Mercs captured by
the Vampires are taken away by its
people. Only a few are allowed
inside; I could not learn what goes
on there. If he is at the facility,
David may still be alive.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_045.en:
...If there's a chance, then
that's good.
Well, I'll go get ready for battle
in the hangar!

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_046.en:
All right. I'll be there shortly.
Roy, there's something I want to
pass on. It's from David...

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_048.en:
The Vampires, Sakata Industries'
private mercenary army.
Its purpose is to collect skilled
wanzer pilots.
Mostly, it captures wanzer mercs and
makes it look like they deserted.
Behind the unit, they're suspected of
performing some kind of biological
experiments on the captured mercs,
and using the results to develop
next-generation weapons.
The unit's own mercs don't seem to
have been told any more than that.

But if even our intel leaked, I think
someone high in the army is helping
them.
There's no proof, but this is a more
powerful organization than we
imagined.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_049.en:
...I see, David.
So they have ties to the army's
top brass as well...
Our orders to Delta went through
the army. Their every move was
known... But if they knew about my
infiltration too... why did they
let me run free?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_050.en:
They seem to have something
in mind.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_051.en:
So it seems.
Let us keep digging.
Now, Captain «E801:00», I will go
ahead to headquarters.
Later.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_052.en:
All right.
I'll be right there.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_053.en:
Well, I'll go get ready for battle
in the hangar!

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_054.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_055.en:
The Captain's the only one
who understands me, eh.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_056.en:
Right you are.
Leave the repairs and resupply to me.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_057.en:
Now, Captain «E801:00», I will go
ahead to headquarters.
Later.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_058.en:
As you know, CISU is the
intelligence agency under the
OCU Prime Minister's office.
We're its action unit, sent in
when it faces armed enemies.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_059.en:
CISU does a lot of internal probes
into ministries and the military,
so, honestly? We're not exactly
popular. Safe bet, that one.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_060.en:
Commander Falcon, we are in the
middle of the advance, but I am
changing the plan.
It seems they readied their trump
card sooner than I expected...
Please hurry the resupply.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_062.en:
Captain «E801:00», if this enemy
is what I expect, it is the
strongest and worst yet. Far beyond
any of the Numbers so far...

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_064.en:
The two Numbers that retreated
will surely join it, too.
This time, focus above all on
driving the prototype off.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_065.en:
Drive it off?
Not shoot it down?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_066.en:
Investigator Roy...
What exactly are we about to
fight...?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_067.en:
That is no wanzer...
A devil born of human hands,
you might say... The B1 prototype
went out of control and reduced
its research facility to ash
in seconds. B2 is the improved
model. It will be stronger still.

I hear the prototype's operating
time is still short. Destroy it if
you can, but do not push it.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_068.en:
Roger.
I'll drive it off, as requested.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_070.en:
The op: drive off the prototype
while watching for the two Numbers.
Get that resupply done, fast.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_001.en:
Enemy machines acquired.
X-03's signal detected as well.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_002.en:
This thing will really move,
won't it?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_003.en:
In theory...
But five turns is the limit.
Beyond that, it will go out of
control, just like the B1
prototype.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_004.en:
Still, that's enough to crush
a whole wanzer division...
Right, they're the target!
Wipe them out!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_006.en: What's wrong? It's not starting up.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_007.en:
W-wait!
I'm not the enemy!
It's that wanzer unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_009.en:
Finally up and running...
But clearly not to be relied on...
Dragoon, looks like it's up to us
after all. We coordinate.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_011.en:
Enemy machines confirmed, lying in
ambush. Investigator, is that white
machine the target?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_012.en:
Yes...
But those awkward movements...
It seems it is still incomplete.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_013.en: So we drive off that white machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_014.en:
That was the plan, but if the
prototype is incomplete, downing
the Numbers should come first.
I will hold the white machine.
«E801:00» Squad, bring down
the two Numbers.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_015.en:
Roger.
Roy, don't be in a hurry to die.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_016.en:
Do not worry.
I still have a great deal
left to do.
Moving in!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_017.en:
Victory: Destroy the Numbers.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Rain is
destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_019.en:
Rain... This is how it
should be...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_021.en:
So this is the end...
«E801:00» Squad... such strength.
But...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_023.en:
Damn, he's going for Rain.
Rain, get clear!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_024.en:
I'll take as many of you
with me as I can...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_025.en: No! I can't make it in time!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_027.en:
No way...
Dragoon's machine...
It's shielding Rain!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_028.en:
Damn you, Dragoon...
You would stand in my way...
So this is my end as well...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_029.en:
Rain... It's been a while...
Ghk...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_031.en:
My squadmates... were taken
hostage... Ghk... hhk...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_032.en:
I see... Just the sort of thing
Lich would do. Dragoon, did you
truly think Lich would keep the
hostages alive?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_033.en:
Dark Knight, is it...
Earlier... the researchers told me
they had all been executed...
It's late to say it, but it seems
I was wrong...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_035.en:
...Rain... I'm leaving you
alone again...
No... you have comrades in your
squad now...
Take care... of your comrades...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_036.en:
Captain Lancer, get out. We'll
get you treated right away...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_037.en:
No... the cockpit block is crushed.
I can't move.
The machine will cook off soon...
There's no getting out...
Move away from me.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_038.en:
Rain, get back.
Numbers machines carry a liquid
that explodes by chemical reaction,
so they leave no evidence behind...
I am afraid the reaction has
already begun...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_039.en:
...You hadn't changed after all.
I'm glad I could see that...
Goodbye... Lancer.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_040.en:
Rain...
Both Numbers machines destroyed.
Only the white machine is left!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_041.en:
I-I'm... sor...ry...
Can't I... save... them...?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_042.en:
Not good, fragments of its
consciousness are surfacing...
At this rate it'll go berserk!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_044.en:
R-roger...
Withdrawing.
Cut the power!
Reinforce the neural link filters!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_046.en:
We have done what we came for,
for now. We know where it is
retreating to. Captain «E801:00»,
let us resupply, regroup and
strike there. But those movements...
Who is it? Who is the victim...?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_048.en:
Not good. We can't take
much more of this...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_050.en:
Tch...
We have taken heavy wear as well.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_054.en: Well, if it ain't you two!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_055.en:
Ahaha!
If it isn't Pervy Gramps!
Still kicking, I see!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_057.en:
Know 'em? These two are
my disciples!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_058.en:
Disciples...
What kind of relationship is that...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_059.en:
Disciples!? What are you on about?
We were the ones looking after
you, Gramps!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_061.en:
Whatever.
Leave the rest to us.
You old-timers are headed
somewhere, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_062.en:
Aye, everyone's outta ammo.
We were wantin' to head back
and resupply.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_063.en:
Are you sure, Hephaestus?
They appear to be attack
helicopters and old tanks...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_064.en:
Hmm...
Well, leave it to 'em.
Old means there's that much more
history behind it.
These two know how to fight with
that history.
You two, don't overdo it now.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_065.en:
We'll be fine!
Everyone else'll be here soon
anyway.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_066.en:
Oh? I see. So you lot are...
Hm.
Give everyone my best.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_067.en:
Let's have a drink once things
settle down! Deal, old man?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_068.en:
I'll stay alive till then,
don't you worry.
Captain, ya can leave this to them.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_069.en:
Roger.
We'll resupply, then go after
the prototype.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_001.en: No, no, you've got it wrong!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_002.en:
What's all this commotion, in the
middle of an emergency?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_003.en:
Captain, Hephaestus did something
that borders on harassment...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_004.en:
The old man suddenly unhooked
Rain's wanzer harness from behind,
and he nearly touched my bottom...
He really is Pervy Gramps.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_006.en:
No, you've both got it wrong!
The lock on Rain's harness was
bent, so I was just checkin' it.
See? A harness like that's
dangerous. Swap it for a new one,
quick as ya can.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_007.en: And trying to touch my bottom?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_008.en:
That's a misunderstandin' too!!
Your holster's cowhide, little missy,
rare these days, eh? Don't look
after it and it'll go moldy and
rot in no time.
I was only tryin' to check on it!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_009.en:
Oh, I see...
Now that you mention it, I ran out
of maintenance oil.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_010.en:
See?
Even I wouldn't go harassin'
folks in an emergency like this!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_012.en:
Right, I'll get rid of this
harness for ya.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_013.en:
Wait, why is Hephaestus wearing
my harness?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_014.en:
Well now, not bad at all.
Ya've got a fine figure, Rain.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_015.en:
Hephaestus...
It IS harassment!
Give that harness back this instant!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_016.en:
So this is the secret of a seasoned
veteran... Not something just
anyone could imitate.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_017.en:
What!?
Captain...
Please don't be impressed by that...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_018.en:
It's right before the decisive
battle, and when I'm alone I end up
thinking about all sorts of things...
Oh! Was Hephaestus being
considerate of that...!?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_019.en:
A sortie. I'll get ready right away.
Oh, and the harness is a new one...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_020.en:
Do I have any maintenance oil
left...?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_021.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_023.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_024.en:
Hephaestus...
The smith god of mythology.
An old soldier who takes that name
for his codename.
A force to be feared...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_026.en:
(Hephaestus, as ever...
Loosening up the squad before
the decisive battle, I suppose...)

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_027.en:
(Now, resupply should be done soon.
I'll head to headquarters to go
over the plan.)

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_029.en:
Ha ha ha!
A bit of liveliness like this
before the big fight does ya good!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_030.en:
Right you are.
Leave the repairs and resupply to me.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_031.en:
That old guy Hephaestus is supposed
to be a famous merc, but... we keep
getting complaints about him from
the women on base.
Could you do something about it?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_032.en:
That old man does whatever he
likes... Wonder if I'd get away
with that much once I'm his age.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_033.en:
Investigator, resupply will be
complete in 30 minutes.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_034.en:
Good work.
Captain «E801:00», let us go over
the operation one last time.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_036.en:
Where the X-00B2 prototype fled...
It is most likely here.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_038.en:
The Numbers assigned here was
X-07 Wizard. You have already
destroyed that machine.
It is now a castle without a lord.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_039.en:
Are the fortress's defences just
gun turrets?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_040.en:
Yes.
They should pose little threat.
As soon as resupply is finished,
we head for the fortress.
We must strike while the B2
prototype cannot operate.
Left alone, it will certainly
become a threat.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_042.en:
Investigator, resupply will be
complete in 20 minutes.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_001.en: Is the sling chopper here yet?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_003.en:
X-00 still has not regained
consciousness?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_004.en:
Nope.
It got thrown into real combat out
of nowhere, after all. Honestly, if
Lich hadn't rushed it out, this
never would've happened.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_005.en:
Stop grumbling.
The enemy is the unit that downed
Wizard and the other Numbers.
It was likely unavoidable.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_006.en:
So they have thrown all our plans
into disarray.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_007.en:
Word is that unit is connected to
X-00... to its donor body, as well.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_009.en:
Mixed in with them... an X-series
signal.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_011.en:
So Dark Knight really did turn
on us, huh. I kinda liked him, too.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_012.en:
A pity, Witch.
But you may at least savor his
face twisted in agony at the end.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_015.en: Roy, aren't there a lot of turrets?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_016.en:
Strange.
I had no idea they had reinforced
it this much...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_018.en:
They were called the Mage Corps...
Like Wizard, their machines repair
their own parts automatically.
A troublesome unit...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_021.en:
All units, the Mage Corps use
sophisticated tactics.
Be careful.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_022.en:
Roger.
We pin down the Mage Corps and
put the white machine first.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_024.en:
Victory: Destroy the Mage Corps
or X-00.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Rain is
destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_026.en:
Sling chopper's arrived.
Two minutes exactly.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_027.en:
Good. Have it recover X-00
and withdraw at once.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_028.en:
I won't let you mess with
the pickup!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_029.en:
Recovery complete.
Sending the sling chopper off.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_031.en: Wear them down as much as you can.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_033.en:
Captain, the sling chopper carrying
the prototype has withdrawn!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_034.en:
Too late...
Roy, you're good at working alone,
aren't you?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_036.en:
We'll hold off the Mage Corps.
Roy, go after the target.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_037.en:
But...
This formation of theirs... they
are certainly planning something.
I do not like it, but we should
withdraw for now.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_038.en:
Roy, please go.
If you don't hurry, it'll be too
late to undo, right?
We'll be fine.
We're used to this kind of thing.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_039.en:
Roy, I'm counting on you to
track it down.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_042.en:
Tch.
A coward to the very last!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_049.en:
No way!!
This many were right under
our feet!?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_052.en:
Phew.
Remote-piloting all that
wears a guy out.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_053.en:
Dark Knight got away, but this
unit should make a fine gift
to bring home.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_054.en:
Now then, mercenaries.
Would you kindly surrender?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_057.en:
Right.
Let's give it everything we've got.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_059.en:
Of course. I'm with you
all the way.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_061.en:
Attention, all units.
Equip anti-jammer gear.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_065.en:
!!!
Sensor malfunction!!!
What... is this headache?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_070.en:
...Just a faint dizziness.
But this feeling...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_072.en:
Abandon your machine and get out,
Sergeant!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_073.en:
Captain, it's a trap!
Help me!!
Gwaaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_075.en:
That's right.
You're too cold-blooded.
Pilots ain't machines, y'know.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_076.en:
Hoh, four machines...
And even the supply vehicle is
caught. A fine yield from this unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_077.en:
Huh?
There's a dud in the captain's
machine?
Guess we'll have to get rid of it,
like always.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_078.en:
Wait, Witch! He should already
be under the spell as well!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_080.en:
Whoops.
Missed the cockpit.
Won't miss next time!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_081.en:
We take them prisoner.
Do not damage them!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_083.en:
Rain!
...Am I going to repeat it
all over again...?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_084.en:
Ugh, come on!
Quit getting in my way!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_087.en:
Not good... Captain, take Rain and
pull out! Rain's machine took a
direct hit... Leave it like that and
it'll blow...! At least you two...
Gah!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_089.en:
No buts!
Captain!
Come rescue us later, like you
always do!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_090.en:
Yeah, we believe in ya...
Nwaaaaargh!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_093.en:
...Rain, are you conscious?
We're going.
...I'll come back for them.
I swear it.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_002.en:
She still hasn't regained consciousness...
There's no external injury, but her
brainwaves are showing abnormal
readings.
...Yes, a waveform much like yours.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_005.en:
Understood. I'll see to it right away!
Captain «E801:00», excuse me.
Please let her rest.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_009.en:
Hicks, Logan, Sato -- all hit!
Dammit... What the hell is going on...!!

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_012.en:
No? Sure it is.
This was your plan, wasn't it?
You're the one who drew the short straw.
Your time's over.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_017.en:
Huh? Yes.
You were having a nightmare, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_018.en:
Sorry.
I must have been dreaming...
Are you all right, Rain?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_019.en:
...I still have a bit of a headache.
You must have been exhausted too,
Captain.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_020.en:
Rain, I'm sorry.
The other four were captured...
Whether they're alive, I don't know.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_021.en:
I see...
Then we have to rescue...
Oh. Mercenary Contract, Article 32...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_022.en:
...If a mercenary is captured, the army
will not intervene in any way. Instead,
a bond is paid to the registered address.
...Article 58: acting outside your mission
voids the contract, counts as desertion,
and may carry a bounty.
Rain, we're in the middle of a major
operation, but I intend to break
my contract.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_023.en:
I'm coming too.
Even if they put a bounty on me...
as long as I'm with you, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_024.en:
...In your condition?
Concentrate on getting better.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_026.en:
Stay in bed.
...I'm going to talk to the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_030.en:
(Rain's headaches...
They might be the same as mine...
If so, I want her to rest
for now...)

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_032.en:
Heard your squadmates got captured.«g:24»
You must be worried sick...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_033.en:
So even your squad, unbeaten till now,
finally took a loss...
Wouldn't have bet on that one.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_035.en:
She's regained consciousness, thanks
to the base's quick response.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_036.en:
I see...
That's twice now, for Rain.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_038.en:
Mm.
It's a dead ringer for the time her
old squad went missing...
Back then, too, the only two machines
that made it back were Buggy's and
Rain's, both damaged.
Same as now.
Maybe her old squad was hit by the
same enemy, with the same attack.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_039.en:
My apologies.
It seems I made the wrong call during
the operation. The investigator warned
me how dangerous the enemy was,
and I still couldn't handle it.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_040.en:
And yet, in all that chaos, you still
managed to get Rain out.
Not like a merc of your caliber to
beat himself up over a mistake.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_041.en:
Once before, my mistake got my
whole unit wiped out.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_042.en: Hard to picture, looking at you now.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_043.en:
Back then I trusted no one but myself.
I was like a machine.
That was the cause...
So in this squad, I decided to change
that: to trust others... no, my comrades,
and act on it.
And still I've driven a unit to ruin...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_044.en:
So that's what's been off about the way
you deal with people.
Well? What about this squad?
Think you can trust them?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_046.en:
According to Investigator Roy, there
were no enemies left at the site where
your people were captured.
Looks like they were taken to a
detention camp northwest of there.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_047.en:
...! A detention camp...
So they're alive?
...Commander Falcon.
I'm sorry, with a major operation under
way, but I mean to break my contract
and act outside my mission.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_048.en:
Hold on, Captain «E801:00».
I've got a mission for you.
The captured mercs... our comrades.
Champ, Oddeye, Gray and Hephaestus.
I want the four of them rescued.
I'm asking you this as commander of
this base... no, as a friend.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_050.en:
Got a problem with me calling you
a friend?
...Sorry. Right now, this is about
all I can do.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_051.en:
...No, it's more than enough.
But you're a soldier, Commander.
This won't come free for you...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_052.en:
Don't worry about it.
All it means is filing a few reports.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_053.en: How many boxes of paperwork is that?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_054.en:
Ha ha ha!
That's a good one, Captain «E801:00».
Oh -- word from the investigator, just
in time.
...Hm.
...Says he'll join the rescue too.
Sounds like he's dug something up.
Best you sortie on the double.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_056.en:
Ah, Captain «E801:00», nearly forgot.
The enemy took your comrades'
machines,
so the maintenance crew insisted on
building exact copies.
All they need now is their pilots.
...I'm counting on you.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_058.en:
The investigator says he'll join the
rescue too. Sounds like he's dug
something up.
Best you sortie on the double.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_061.en:
Rain...
This is «E801:00». Commander Falcon,
have the medical staff stand by.
Rain's machine took a direct hit...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_003.en:
Yeah.
Rain's recovering.
Any movement at the camp?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_004.en:
Not yet.
According to the sentries, the transport
vehicle should be arriving soon.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_006.en:
Because your squad drew the Mage
Corps
away, I learned where X-00B2 is, and
what they are researching.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_008.en:
You seem to blame yourself for your
squad's defeat. What hit you is called
a Bio-jammer. It affects brainwaves.
...Though they appear to use it
as a screening tool.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_009.en:
...Almost everyone complained of
headaches, but it had no effect on me.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_010.en:
Which means you are most likely
a non-adapter.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_012.en:
Those the Bio-jammer affects are
adapters... the people they want.
In some individuals, the brainwaves
must contain something incompatible
with their system.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_013.en:
So it didn't affect me because
I'm incompatible... is that it?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_014.en:
And the facility ahead is where the
adapters are gathered, to become
bio-parts for next-generation weapons.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_015.en:
Bio-parts?
Why not call them pilots?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_016.en:
Whether "pilot" is even the word...
They take pilots with fatal injuries
and subject them to a special form of
brainwashing that amplifies only their
bestial fighting instinct, physical
ability and reflexes.
When the pilot wakes, the personality
is gone, and it is thrown onto the
battlefield as a living weapon.
Physical pain is not actually part of
the process. It seems Nightmare simply
ran wild to satisfy his own tastes...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_018.en:
Brainwashing apparently makes them
harder to control.
The Vampires are nothing more than
a collection of veteran mercs.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_020.en:
According to my findings, Rain's old
squad was also hit by a Bio-jammer.
Only the two judged to be adapters
were lucky enough to make it back.
The captain and the rest fought the
Vampires, and lost.
With his men held hostage, the captain
apparently signed a contract to
join the Vampires.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_021.en:
And that was Dragoon.
Lancer...
...And the two survivors were Rain
and Buggy. So the Vampires kept
coming after them as adapters.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_022.en:
Correct.
But since «E801:00» Squad was formed,
the Vampires have lost again and again.
Worn down by the fighting, they took
your squad out of their plans and
turned to Arena rankers and the like.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_023.en:
I see...
But now my people have been taken...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_024.en:
They are excellent pilots.
Left alone, it is only a matter of
time before they are made into
bio-parts...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_025.en:
Does the army know about this
inhuman plan...?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_026.en:
That is what I am chasing.
To obtain clear evidence against the
companies involved, and the military,
and to expose this affair completely.
That is my mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_028.en:
Yes.
Which is exactly why I will help you
rescue your people.
To expose the army's ties to the
Vampires, I need «E801:00» Squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_029.en:
Understood.
I'm counting on you as well.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_031.en:
That is the target, no doubt.
Four wanzers as escort...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_034.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies except
the vehicle.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed or
the enemy vehicle escapes.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_036.en:
Damn... If I could just get outta
these restraints...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_037.en:
Hold on.
Maybe I can do something with
this safety pin...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_038.en:
That's gonna open it?
Hey, whoa, don't stab my wrist!

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_040.en:
We knocked out the guard in here,
and we STILL can't get out.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_041.en:
Yeah. That was something, Champ.
Honestly, how many guys have you put
in the hospital with just your feet?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_042.en:
Nah, nah, my finisher's the fist,
y'know? Can't use it right now, though.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_043.en:
Tell me about it.
We have to do something about this...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_044.en:
Oh?
Gray, look! It's the Captain and
the investigator!

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_046.en:
Once that transport reaches that point,
we can no longer rescue them.
We must bring down the escorts without
damaging the vehicle...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_050.en:
Sorry, we were right there and...
Oddeye and Hephaestus were moved
somewhere else as soon as we got here.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_051.en:
Then they are not at the facility
ahead... I cannot tell where they
were taken. Go back to base for now
and prepare for combat.
I will infiltrate the research
facility and gather information.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_052.en:
...Roger.
We're heading back.
Your wanzers are ready too.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_054.en:
No... The transport
has broken through...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_057.en:
Champ, my ears...
But I guess this is the end...
Captain, the rest is up to you...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_001.en:
We owe you our lives, Captain.
I don't know what to say.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_002.en:
No, save your thanks for the Commander.
He went against regulations to send
me to rescue you all.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_004.en: I just hope nothing comes of it...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_005.en:
Got it.
Gray, we'll thank him ourselves later.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_006.en:
Yeah.
...By the way, Captain, any word on
where Oddeye and Hephaestus are?

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_007.en:
Not yet.
The investigator is out gathering
intel, but he hasn't checked in.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_008.en:
The longer this takes, the worse...
We oughta get moving ourselves,
and quick.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_009.en:
...No, that'd be acting outside our
mission too.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_010.en:
Dammit...
And Rain's still out cold...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_011.en: Best to let her rest for now.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_012.en:
That headache back then...
Mine and Champ's cleared up right away.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_013.en:
Come to think of it, Oddeye's and
Hephaestus's headaches hung on longer.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_014.en:
It seems this was the second time
Rain was hit by that attack.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_015.en:
When her old squad got wiped out, huh...
A Bio-jammer...
What the hell are those guys researching?

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_016.en:
I'm going to HQ.
There may be news soon.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_017.en:
A Bio-jammer...
What the hell are those guys researching?

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_018.en: Alright, let's get over there, fast.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_019.en:
If this drags on, it's going to
get ugly...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_021.en:
(She seems to be asleep.
I'll leave her be for now.)

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_026.en:
You actually brought your people back.
Honestly, everyone on base figured
it couldn't be done.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_027.en:
I knew you'd pull it off!
I mean, if I'd lost that bet, I'd be
buying Sam dinner.
The guy eats like a horse. Close call.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_028.en:
Yes, he's right here.
Roger. Putting you through.
Captain «E801:00», it's the investigator.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_029.en:
Captain «E801:00», I have found Oddeye
and Hephaestus.
They are being moved to another
facility by way of the port.
You had best sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_030.en:
The port.
Roger.
We're on our way.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_031.en:
Still, their organization is in chaos...
The information is all contradictory.
Something serious seems to have
happened. Captain «E801:00», the Mage
Corps is waiting at the port.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_033.en:
I am heading there too.
We will meet on site...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_035.en:
Once they're on a ship, we may not be
able to get them back...
Captain «E801:00», good luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_004.en:
So if we take these guys down, we
get 'em back...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_005.en:
I doubt it'll be that simple.
...No sign of Roy's machine, either.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_009.en: We owe these guys a payback.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_010.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_012.en:
Huh?
What are THEY doing here?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_013.en:
Damn...
They caught us completely off guard.
All units, buy as much time as you can.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_016.en:
But it's okay if we just kill 'em,
right~!?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_019.en:
A new model...?
Dammit, there's a ton of 'em...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_020.en:
Tch...
The remote link...
Undead squad's not responding...!

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_021.en:
...Still incomplete, then... But they
will buy us time.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_022.en:
The neural link filter isn't working
either.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_023.en:
What is this, factory rejects!?
Don't shoot at ME!
Ugh, these things are so annoying!
Necromancer, aren't you using the
jammer?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_024.en:
Not now.
It takes time to charge.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_025.en:
What the hell!?
What's goin' on??

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_026.en:
It looks like the new models have
a system fault.
While they're confused, we take out
the Mage Corps first.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_027.en:
...This is Roy...
...«E801:00» Squad, do you read?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_028.en:
This is «E801:00».
Roy, why haven't you joined us?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_029.en:
...My apologies. Trouble has kept me
away. But listen well, «E801:00»...
The Vampires have effectively collapsed.
It seems the client has cut them loose.
The Mage Corps at the port most likely
means to load the prototype and run.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_030.en: I don't see the two of them.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_031.en:
...I have traced them.
...A medical facility near Grayrock.
Lich, the mastermind, is there too.
Can you turn back right away?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_032.en:
Unfortunately, the Mage Corps doesn't
look inclined to let us.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_033.en:
Forgive me. With the organization
collapsing, the intel was garbled.
I intend to pin him down when I see
an opening, but whether I can wait
until you arrive...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_034.en:
Roger. We'll wipe out the Mage Corps
and head back.
Don't throw your life away.
Roy.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_035.en:
If Lich activates X-00B2, I will move.
Oddeye and the others, at least, I will
save, no matter what...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_036.en:
Wait, Roy.
You should tread carefully.
...Lost contact?
All units, keep hitting the Mage Corps.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_039.en:
...Can I not even... serve as
a shield...?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_042.en:
...So this is the end of the Mage
Corps...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_045.en: So they never even used that jammer.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_046.en:
Being on the run, I guess they didn't
have anything prepared.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_047.en:
In a straight-up slugfest, even the
Mage Corps ain't so tough.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_048.en:
Captain, what now?
Do we turn back?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_049.en:
Against the white machine and the
mastermind, we can't move carelessly.
We'll stop at base and wait for intel.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_050.en:
Roger. But it doesn't look like we
have much time.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_051.en:
Right. If no intel comes, we head
for Grayrock regardless.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_001.en:
Captain, I'm good to go.
Just say the word!

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_003.en:
Looks like Rain went on ahead.
We'd better hurry too.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_005.en:
(As soon as we've resupplied, we
have to move...)

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_007.en:
Captain «E801:00», word just came in
from the investigator.
Oddeye and Hephaestus are confirmed
alive at a medical facility near
Grayrock. Also confirmed there is the
Vampires' mastermind, a man who calls
himself Lich.
The investigator is lying low around
the facility, and seems to mean to
get them out when he sees an opening.
But against the mastermind, that's
far too dangerous...

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_009.en:
...Since it couldn't wait, I sent
Rain on ahead.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_010.en: I see. Is Rain all right now?

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_011.en:
Mm.
The doctor signed off on it.
But... the intel says the Vampire
machine you drove off before was
spotted at the same building.
Safe to say it's one of their bases.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_013.en:
Swing by the hangar.
The new weapons I put in for have
arrived.
...A commander's a sorry sort of
thing... This is all the help I can
give you.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_001.en:
Looks like they're short-handed
right now.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_002.en: I think we can get out!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_004.en:
Ah, Grandpa, wait!
With the stuff I scrounged earlier...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_005.en:
Oho, homemade explosives...
Clever little thing, aren't ya.
Little missy, it's a waste keepin' you
as a wanzer jockey.
Nimble hands, cute as a button...
how 'bout bein' my assistant?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_006.en:
Ahaha, I'll pass!
Okay, we're good to go.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_007.en:
Oh?
My material, way out here?
You're supposed to stay put like
good little specimens.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_011.en: Pin them down. Don't kill them.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_013.en:
And don't damage the brains, got it?
That's valuable material.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_015.en:
(Damn...
I cannot wait for «E801:00» and
the others any longer.)
(Even if it costs me my life,
those two...)

Lich!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_016.en:
Been a while, hasn't it?
Dark Knight.
Or should I say, Investigator Roy
of the OCU Central Intelligence
action unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_018.en:
Sure, and I played it right back
at you. Let you swim around free, and
got a whole lot of army intel out of it.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_020.en:
Thanks to all your hard work,
Investigator, the Vampires are done.
The client pulled its protection,
and look at us now.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_022.en:
Ah, but the client says it's shifting
to another project.
Me, I plan to sell myself to that
project, with the X-00 and that
material over there as a gift.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_023.en:
And this client of yours...
whose money is it?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_024.en:
Ah, I could tell ya, but first I want
some combat data.
How about it?
Why don't you fight an old comrade?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_026.en:
Go, Faceless.
Take down the traitor.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_029.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_032.en:
Pathetic, man.
Your machine's smoking.
You know Numbers machines are rigged
with explosive liquid, right?
Anybody who won't make good material
is no loss dead.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_034.en:
Analog soldiers with nothing but
piloting skill -- nobody's gonna need
'em from here on out.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_036.en:
Here's the client, as a parting gift
for the afterlife.
You've traced it as far as Sakata,
right? And you've heard about the army
brass? Thing is, brass goes all the
way up. Bet you didn't know it reaches
the very top.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_038.en:
And get this: it's not just
the OCU, either.
Both armies agree, they've got no use
for analog soldiers.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_040.en:
Huh?
Smoke stopped, did it?
Well then, Faceless.
Finish him off.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_041.en:
...Heh.
This entire conversation has already
been transmitted to «E801:00».

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_042.en:
Sharp as ever, aren't ya.
Doesn't matter. Fire.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_044.en: ...«E801:00», the rest is up to you!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_046.en:
Blast!
...Little missy, get out of the truck!
...I'll draw his eye!
Run for it!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_047.en:
Eek! Grandpa, what are you--
Grandpa!?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_048.en:
...She's packed with explosives, too!!
Oddeye, haven't had a squad this fun
in years!
Tell the Captain...!!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_050.en:
Dammit... my material...
The old man?
Tch. Faceless, grab the girl.
What's wrong? Move!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_052.en:
My eyes are odd eyes, see.
Look...
...
You know, when I was little,
I got picked on a lot.
Because of my eyes, see?
I wasn't like everyone else...
So when I meet someone new,
I show them my eyes first...
And if we can be friends anyway,
I'll treasure them forever and ever.
I guess it just turned into a habit.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_053.en:
That's an order.
Grab the girl!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_055.en:
What?
You useless scrap heap... move!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_056.en:
Ah, you laughed again...
Is the way I talk... that funny?
Hmm, I wonder why.
...
When I was little, I always played
by myself. Watching anime, tinkering
with machines... Learning languages
from all over the world...
Oh, maybe that's how all my grammar
got mixed up?
David?
Geez, stop laughing so much!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_059.en:
Dammit!
His mind's snapped...
Fine.
I'll go myself...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_060.en:
Grandpa...
Roy...
David...
What is this...
It isn't right...
Why does it have to be like this!?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_062.en:
Rain...
Everyone... they're all...
they're all dead!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_063.en:
Oddeye... I'm so sorry...
That must have been awful...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_064.en:
Burning truck and the investigator's
machine confirmed...
The white machine's gone silent too.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_068.en:
I'm sorry, Oddeye...
I brought your wanzer.
Can you board?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_070.en:
I heard your exchange with Roy.
We're going to crush them.
All units, move!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_071.en:
So «E801:00» showed up after all...
Hey, scrap heap, can you move?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_073.en:
Useless...
Bits of memory are surfacing...
What a miscalculation...
Never figured there'd be a woman
in the picture.
Hey!
Defense unit, scramble every machine.
Tech team, send out the test units too!
At this point, we throw everything
we've got at 'em!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_074.en:
Figures test units couldn't make
sense of a situation like this...
Well, looks like all that's left is
the scrap heap and me.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_075.en: Lich. We've met before, haven't we?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_076.en:
Heh, so you noticed.
Captain Bullet «E801:00».

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_078.en:
Ah, still got those headaches?
Still dreaming about that lost battle?
Ha ha ha!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_080.en:
Long time no see.
I brainwashed you good and thorough,
and it still wore off, huh.
After all the trouble I went to,
planting that defeat in you.
And then you go back to the
battlefield and make it all the way
here? Didn't see that coming...
...
Pretty artistic, wasn't it?
Those fake memories.
During the Bio-jammer prototype tests,
you blacked out.
...You were the strongest soldier we
had, and you were in my way.
So I brainwashed you while I was at it.
You oughta thank me.
That brainwashing's the reason
you're a non-adapter!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_081.en:
You did this to me...
So BATS being wiped out was
a false memory...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_082.en:
Feel better now?
I'm the one who brought BATS down.
Remember all those nasty experiments
we ran? Internal Affairs wouldn't stop
sniffing around, the army couldn't
handle it anymore, so I sold the lot
to Sakata.
You fought it to the very end, though.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_083.en:
So that's... where the Vampires
came from...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_084.en:
The bats grew up into vampires.
Pretty stylish, huh?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_085.en:
I won't say you're the root of all
of it. But... what you've done is
something my feelings can't accept...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_086.en:
Huh, now there's a surprise.
You angry?
You, the one with no ups and downs,
who knew nothing about the world?
Just a combat machine!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_089.en:
Captain!!
Explosives detected all around us...
They're on a timer!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_090.en:
Tch, you noticed...
Can't leave any evidence behind.
This whole area's about to be blown
sky-high.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_091.en:
I'll stay and finish this.
...All units, withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_092.en:
No!
Captain, you're coming with us!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_093.en:
...Rain, please. Let me settle this
with him.
He's my problem too!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_095.en:
...Captain «E801:00».
...Understood.
Champ, Gray, recover Roy's machine
and fall back!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_097.en:
Oddeye, give me a hand.
You and I will get Faceless's machine
out of here.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_099.en:
I'm sorry.
Rain.
...I'll win. You have my word.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_101.en:
Heh.
A one-on-one, is it?
Earnest to the bitter end!
That's exactly why you were in my way!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_103.en:
...So this is where it ends...
...Bullet «E801:00»? What are you
doing!?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_104.en:
I can't have the evidence go up
in the blast.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_106.en:
We'll be taking all of this evidence
home to the OCU.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_110.en:
Then we'll fight back with
everything we've got.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_112.en:
You're the ones... who made us
this way.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_113.en:
Through so much grief and anger...
I learned that feelings make people
strong. From fighting you.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_114.en:
...Ha ha ha ha!
I see...!
...So I went and toughened you up.
...I made the strongest soldier,
without even meaning to!
Ha ha ha!
Now that's a masterpiece!
I went and made that combat machine
Bullet even stronger!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_115.en:
Looks like your machine's self-destruct
has stopped.
...Greg, why didn't you kill me?
If I was in your way, you could have
just got rid of me.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_116.en:
You were an eyesore... but as a
soldier, you were my ideal... so...
...Now get clear. You'll be caught in
the blast!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_118.en:
You're not my ideal anymore...
But I finally get it.
In the end, analog's stronger.
...Guess the next project's a bust too.
...You hear me, Raven?
I'm going on ahead...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_120.en:
...Captain!
The investigator!!
Champ, the respirator and the
coagulant!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_121.en:
This?
It was in the transport...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_122.en:
Perfect!
...He's bleeding, but he'll be okay.
The investigator's just unconscious.
...That should hold him.
...
...And Faceless...
Dammit, these cables...
how is this thing wired...
...No good... I can't make heads
or tails of it.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_123.en:
...I've already called for a rescue
team.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_125.en:
Oddeye.
There must be something you wanted
to tell him.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_127.en:
No way... I've got a heartbeat!
David's alive too!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_129.en:
Looks like the rescue team is here.
We'll leave the rest to them.
Oddeye, stay with him.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_131.en:
Anti-Vampire Operation, «E801:00»
Squad: mission complete...
Roy's and Faceless's machines
recovered. Returning to base!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_133.en:
...I'm sorry...
Looks like I couldn't keep my promise.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_001.en:
This is a placeholder message
for the barracks.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_002.en:
Don't make me say it again.
This is a placeholder message
for the barracks.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_003.en: So this is after visiting HQ...

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_004.en:
Captain «E801:00». I hear Lieutenant
Colonel Roy has regained consciousness.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_005.en:
I see.
...Any chance he'll return to duty?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_006.en:
Twelve fractures. Wounds that
took
dozens of stitches. Burns from the
explosive liquid over 30% of his body.
Even for a lieutenant colonel, it'll
be months before he's back in the
field...

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_007.en:
...It's a miracle he survived.
...And David's condition?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_008.en:
...He's conscious, apparently.
But...
his mind has collapsed, and he's still
wandering lost in his memories.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_009.en:
Just as he was back then... huh.
...I hear Oddeye is coming back.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_010.en:
He's hooked up to a special
life-support
system. Visits, nursing, everything's
been cut off. Even at his side, there
was nothing she could have done for him.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_013.en:
For a while, pass the routine jobs
to
the other squads.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_014.en:
That's my intention. But this one's
from a regular customer, you know.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_016.en:
Right. It's a request from
Lieutenant
Colonel Roy's unit. The Anti-Vampire
Operation is over, but the Vampire
remnants are said to be stirring.
They want «E801:00» Squad to wipe out
the remnants and get to the truth of
the matter. Planning to turn this one
down too?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_018.en:
As you know, the army's being
extremely
cautious about dealing with the
Vampires. In fact, it's no exaggeration
to say it doesn't want to move at all.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_019.en:
...If the intel that the top of the
army is behind it all is true, no
wonder.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_020.en:
Mm. Except for the lieutenant
colonel's
unit. ...But if we wait for him to get
back in the field, a second and third
Vampires will have formed by then.
So the job's come down to «E801:00»
Squad, as mercs.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_021.en:
Is the mission to take an enemy
base?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_022.en:
No, nothing that big. First, they
want
you to look into the Vampire remnants
that have turned into armed guerrillas
all over, and gather intel.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_023.en:
Roger. We'll start preparing.
Send the terrain data for the
destination to our wanzers.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_024.en:
Will do. And, Captain «E801:00».
Oddeye is apparently already out there.
Pick her up, would you?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_026.en:
First, they want you to look into
the
Vampire remnants that have turned into
armed guerrillas all over, and gather
intel. And, Captain «E801:00». Oddeye
is apparently already out there.
Pick her up, would you?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_002.en:
...I was here over a year.
Things pile up, I suppose.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_003.en:
Place sure has gotten empty,
though...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_006.en:
Exactly so.
"Oh my, Catherine's udderly
flustered!" as they say.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_007.en:
Hephaestus, honestly!
Don't bring that kind of book
into the barracks!

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_009.en:
...I just couldn't bring myself
to throw it out.
Oh, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_011.en:
Heard the old man didn't have
any family...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_012.en:
Yeah.
Seems he was a merc his whole life.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_013.en:
...He always took everything in
stride, didn't he?
I bet that's how he drifted from
one battlefield to the next.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_014.en:
...When I was feeling down, he
cheered me up too. In his own way.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_016.en:
Hello?
Is that you, Rain?
...Huh? The signal's...
Hellooo?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_017.en:
Oddeye?
I can hear you!
Are you alright?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_018.en:
Rain, can you... hear me?
I just... got to Huffman!

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_019.en:
Wait, Oddeye, we're not
mercenaries anymore.
Even if you come here...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_020.en:
...I can't... hear you very well?
...Ah!
A girl...
This is bad!
There's this girl!!
Shady people are... I'm going in!

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_021.en:
What? «g:24»Oddeye?
What's happening?
Oddeye, listen, even if you come...
...She hung up...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_023.en:
It seems so.
But something's happened...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_024.en:
Dammit, we finally take down
the Vampires, and...
They shut the merc base and kick
us out with it...
And now Commander Falcon's gone
too...
What the hell's going on...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_025.en:
The Commander vanishing...
The merc base being dismantled...
Is this what Lich meant by
"getting erased"...?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_026.en:
I've started packing to go home,
but something about this doesn't
sit right.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_027.en:
I hear Roy's at headquarters.
I'll go see if he knows anything.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_028.en:
Understood.
I'll stay here a while longer,
until you get back.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_029.en:
I'll stay here a while longer,
until you get back.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_030.en:
Huh? A mission?
...An action unit... Understood.
I'm with you, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_031.en:
Dammit, we finally take down
the Vampires, and...
They shut the merc base and kick
us out with it...
And now Commander Falcon's gone
too...
What the hell's going on...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_032.en:
Hey, now that's what I like to hear!
I'm with you, Captain!
Like that was ever a question!
Little Catherine, wish me luck!!

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_033.en:
The Commander vanishing...
The merc base being dismantled...
Is this what Lich meant by
"getting erased"...?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_034.en:
CISU's action unit...
Of course, that's a way in!
Nice one, Investigator.
I'll get ready right away.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_035.en:
(Dismantling the merc corps...
So this is how the army does it...)

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_036.en:
(I'll keep what I know about
Commander Falcon to myself
for now.)
(...The mission comes first.)

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_037.en:
I hear they fired you from the
merc corps?
You took down the Vampires.
If anything, the regulars ought
to be recruiting you.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_038.en:
You folks are the heroes of
Huffman Island.
Now if we could just find out who
was behind the Vampires...
Me, I've got money on the EC.
Why the EC?
They'd love to see the OCU and USN
fight and wipe each other out.
It's only lunch money, mind you.
Want in?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_039.en:
The merc base dismantled out of
nowhere. Commander Falcon resigns.
And then vanishes...
The one mercy is that nothing has
happened to any of you yet.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_040.en:
Still no word on where Commander
Falcon is?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_041.en:
...His whereabouts remain unknown.
What's more, it seems he's been
struck from the army's rolls.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_042.en:
I can't see him leaving the
service on his own...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_043.en:
...I'm sorry.
This is my fault.
I never expected them to move this
fast, dismantling the merc corps
included.
The Commander may well have...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_044.en:
Whoever's pulling the army's
strings is erasing every unit
involved in that incident...
...But then, aren't you in danger
too, Investigator?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_045.en:
I act on government orders.
They likely cannot touch me
directly, so this is meant as
a message to me.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_046.en:
And getting rid of one merc base
is an easy enough warning shot...
Is that it?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_047.en:
...And your mercenary contracts
have been voided as well.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_048.en:
...About that. Couldn't we sign on
as mercs at another base?
I don't want to be crushed just
because it suits whoever's
behind this.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_049.en:
...I was about to propose that
myself, but your right to work as
mercenaries has been revoked
entirely.
So I ask instead: would you work
for me, or rather, as a private
force of the Internal Affairs unit?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_050.en:
...If that's possible, I've got no
reason to refuse.
But is there still something going
on here on Huffman?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_051.en:
Yes. There is a mountain of work.
Since the Anti-Vampire Op, the
organization's remnants have been
stirring.
I can no longer fight on the front
line, so I want «E801:00» Squad to
use those remnants as leads and
uncover the truth.
And of course I will pay as before.
No, better than mercenary rates.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_053.en:
...Thank you.
I will register you at once.
As you know, the army is being
extremely cautious about dealing
with the Vampires.
It would be no exaggeration to
say it does not want to act at all.
...But unless we find proof of who
stood behind the Vampires, a
second and a third Vampires will
surely be formed.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_055.en:
First, investigate the Vampire
remnants that have turned into
armed guerrillas across the island,
and gather intelligence.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_056.en:
Roger.
We'll start getting ready.
Send the terrain data for the
site to our wanzers.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_057.en:
Understood.
One more thing, «E801:00».
Oddeye has returned to Huffman
Island.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_058.en: Yeah. She called Rain just now.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_061.en:
After the incident, he was taken
to a medical facility under my
jurisdiction.
She asked to stay by his side,
and I allowed it, but...
He was on special life support.
Visits, nursing, all of it was
cut off.
She says she could do nothing for
him, even sitting right there...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_063.en:
She wishes to rejoin «E801:00»
Squad.
She has just arrived near the
target site.
Meet up with her there.
Also, a wanzer repair backpack has
been delivered to the hangar.
It won't replace Hephaestus, but
it can stand in for his supply
truck.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_065.en:
First, investigate the Vampire
remnants that have turned into
armed guerrillas across the island,
and gather intelligence.
Also, Oddeye has arrived near the
site. Meet up with her there.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_066.en:
This incident, which had cost
so many precious lives, seemed
to have been resolved through the
mercenaries' efforts.
And yet...

...A few days after the battle
with Lich.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_001.en: Still no sign of remnant forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_003.en:
Huh?
That armored vehicle... looks like
someone's chasing it.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_006.en:
Those are wanzers behind it.
Any wanzer out here that isn't army
is almost certainly a remnant.
We cover the armored vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_007.en:
Heh. Sharp as ever, Captain.
Mission understood!
Covering the armored vehicle!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_009.en:
Y-Yeah!
Oddeye, they're still on us!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_010.en:
No problem, I'm used to this kind
of thing! Hold on tight!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Oddeye
is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_017.en:
I'll try guiding them on a direct
channel.
...Armored vehicle, we'll cover you.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_018.en:
Ah, that voice!
Rain, is that you!?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_021.en:
Yep!
They're my precious teammates!
Now that everyone's here,
we're totally safe.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_022.en:
Oddeye, explanations later.
Head for the escape point.
We'll intercept your pursuers.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_024.en:
Oddeye's... awfully wound up...
Still, that's a relief.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_026.en:
All units, don't let them lay
a finger on Oddeye's vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_027.en:
Goooal! Made it!
Captain, over to you!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_028.en:
Roger.
All units, wipe out the hostile
wanzers.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_032.en:
Oddeye, thanks for coming back.
Welcome.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_033.en:
Captain, why so formal?
Of course I came back!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_035.en:
This is Aisha.
Some weirdos were about to grab
her on the edge of town, so I
rescued her!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_036.en:
Yes. I was in real danger, and
Oddeye saved me.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_037.en:
That's Oddeye for you.
Probably felt like picking up
a stray cat...

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_039.en:
That's how it started, but when
I heard her story, wow!
...Aisha was a researcher at
a Vampire research facility!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_040.en:
...I see. There's more to this.
...I'd like to hear the details.
Would you come by our base?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_042.en:
Oddeye, you knew that and came
out this way...
Don't tell me the Investigator
gave you a secret assignment?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_043.en:
Huh? No way.
That's spy-movie stuff...
Rain, you watch too many movies!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_044.en:
Ugh...
Hearing that from her, of all
people...

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_045.en:
So it really was pure
coincidence...

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_046.en:
Then we may have a source of
intel.
We'll head back and hear her out.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_047.en:
It's a messy place, but please
bear with it, okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_048.en:
Yeah, it's fine.
I'm used to it!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_050.en:
I'm sorry...
I couldn't hold the line...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_002.en:
But I got to say a proper goodbye.
Thanks to all of you.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_004.en:
No, I'm not.
...I cried a lot, all on my own.
But I made him a promise.
I don't want any more victims like
the ones in that incident...
That's what keeps me fighting now.
Oh, Captain!
Have you seen Aisha?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_005.en:
No. I thought she'd be in the
barracks. Looks like she isn't.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_006.en:
Hmm...
Where'd she run off to?
I stayed up all night making the
white cat version, too...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_008.en:
Yes! Aisha really wanted this black
cat pendant, so I made a white cat
version, with her in mind!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_009.en:
I've been wondering for a while...
You made that accessory yourself?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_010.en:
It works as PC memory, it plays
music, it's packed with all kinds
of features!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_012.en:
Hehehe, and the white one, Shishi,
has a secret weapon built in!!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_013.en:
A secret weapon...
There's nothing you can't do,
is there, Oddeye?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_014.en:
Captain, if you find Aisha,
let me knooow!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_016.en:
Maybe I should ask her to make me
something too...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_017.en:
An escort mission for Aisha.
Understood.
We have a little time before we
leave, though...
I'll go make us some tea.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_018.en:
Captain, if you find Aisha,
let me knooow!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_019.en: Ah, Aisha, you were at HQ!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_020.en:
Yeah, Oddeye.
I heard you were looking for me?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_023.en:
This is Shishi.
I made it with you in mind, Aisha!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_024.en:
Shishi?
The black cat's cute, but this one's
cute too. Thanks, Oddeye!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_025.en:
I'm so glad you like it!
Oh, Captain, we've still got time,
right?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_026.en:
Yeah.
Feel free to relax until then.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_027.en: Oh, I know! Aisha, let's go eat!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_028.en:
Oh, come to think of it,
I'm starving...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_029.en:
Then it's a full-course ration
meal! Let's go, Aisha!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_030.en:
Huh?
Oh, sorry, Captain.
I'll be off, then...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_031.en:
Yeah.
I'll call you when it's time.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_032.en:
Oddeye looks like she's bounced
back, but it must've hit her hard...
Well, if she's back on her feet,
this squad'll liven up again too.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_033.en:
Got time before the mission...
Alright, think I'll hit the hot
springs.
Hey, Grayyy? «g:24»Hot springs, let's go!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_034.en:
Action unit or not, it's not that
different from before.
Still, where could Commander Falcon
have gone after leaving the army...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_035.en:
An escort mission. Understood.
There's still time, but I think
I'll get ready early.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_036.en:
Hey, Grayyy?
Hot springs, let's go!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_037.en:
......
Hot springs again...
Whenever I go with Champ, he spends
the whole time showing off his
muscles...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_038.en:
Huh? «g:24»
You can't bring civilians onto
the base. Especially not kids...
Hey, Oddeye, are you listening?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_039.en:
By the way, Mr. Kinoshita's back.
Says he wants to help you folks
however he can.
You've got a fan there.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_040.en:
Hey. I'm Jon.
CISU intelligence unit.
I gather intel on Huffman Island.
Huh? «g:24»The outfit?
I wear it on purpose.
Best way to blend in with the
locals is to dress like them.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_041.en:
I see.
So her pursuers were a combat unit
from the organization's remnants.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_042.en:
But that's the first time I'd ever
seen the organization's combat
units...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_043.en:
Aisha, there you are.
Oddeye was looking for you.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_045.en:
Forgive me, «E801:00».
I took her account first.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_046.en:
Hard at work as always.
So, any progress?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_047.en:
Dr. Aisha.
She is Zaftran, and a prodigy in
neuroscience.
It seems the Vampires' research
body forced her to work on that
experimental unit.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_049.en:
My work was mainly on the control
system.
After the accident when B1 was
installed, I was evacuated, so I
never saw the finished unit...
And after the organization was
broken up, most of the research
staff were moved somewhere...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_051.en:
...I saw an opening during the
transfer and ran.
But ever since they brought me to
Huffman, I'd been shut in a lab...
I had no idea where to run, and
they were after me in no time...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_052.en:
Nowhere to go.
And that's when Oddeye saved you.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_053.en:
Yes.
But it wasn't pure chance.
I spotted Oddeye and ran to her.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_055.en:
Yes. Files with her photo had been
passed around... She was to be a
subject in the next experiment...
I was clutching at straws.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_056.en:
Forgive me, but let us leave that
for later.
I've spoken with headquarters, and
we have decided to take her into
protective custody.
Her parents are waiting for her
back home, it seems.
I want her delivered safely to the
airport.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_058.en:
May I go say goodbye to everyone,
then?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_059.en:
Permission granted.
You have three hours before
departure.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_060.en:
Mission understood.
I'm used to escort work.
All of «E801:00» Squad will
see her off.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_062.en:
I've spoken with headquarters, and
we have decided to take her into
protective custody.
Her parents are waiting for her
back home, it seems.
