I want her delivered safely to the
airport.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_003.en:
Guess we can't run into a fight
everywhere we go.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_004.en:
You know, Aisha, you're pretty
amazing.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_006.en:
You're famous in neuroscience,
aren't you?

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_007.en:
It's nothing special.
I think you, surviving out on the
battlefield, are far more amazing
than me.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_008.en:
Aisha Romaryoff.
Born 2071.
Held four doctorates by the age
of 14...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_009.en:
Whaaat! 2071 means...
You're only two years older than me!?
That's kind of a shock...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_011.en:
But I'm self-conscious about
looking so young for 18...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_012.en:
...To be honest, I thought you
were about 14.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_013.en:
I get that a lot...
Even though I take calcium and
everything...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_014.en:
What's wrong with that?
When you're cute, all is forgiven!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_017.en:
Looks like we can see her off
without any trouble.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_018.en:
Alert level yellow.
All units, you may see Aisha off.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_019.en:
Everyone,
thank you for everything.
Oddeye, I'll email you once I'm
settled. Oh, and the Shishi pendant,
I'll take good care of it!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_024.en:
Aisha, get inside the airport
building, now.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_026.en:
Looks like her pursuers.
All units, wipe out the hostiles.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_028.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Aisha
is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_030.en:
Target acquired.
Positive ID, confirmed.
Take her, armored vehicle and all.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_035.en:
Ah... Captain!
The comm line's gone dead...
Aisha, come in...!
Answer me!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_036.en:
Aisha's armored vehicle is lost.
No visual.
No sign it was destroyed either...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_038.en:
Ah, Captain, Shishi's...
The transmitter's moving.
At this speed... it's a chopper!
When did they grab her...?

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_040.en:
It's no good...
Five seconds to the edge of
reception range.
...3...2...
Signal lost...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_041.en:
No choice... We take the enemy
wreckage back and have the base
identify the unit and its aims.
It looks like those weren't
Vampire remnants...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_001.en:
Still, failing an escort mission...
Every mission up to now went off
without a hitch...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_002.en:
They caught us completely off
guard while we were busy fighting.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_003.en:
I hope Aisha's okay...
Oh, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_004.en:
Rain has a point.
But we took our eyes off the person
we were protecting. That's on us.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_005.en:
The unexpected resistance tied us
up, too.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_006.en:
Getting cocky after we beat the
Vampires, huh...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_007.en:
Maybe...
We might've let our guard down.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_008.en:
Still, Oddeye's secret weapon was
a stroke of luck.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_009.en:
Shishi...
You see, Aisha said she didn't know
her way around Huffman, so besides
the memory, I built in a tracker in
case she got lost...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_010.en:
I see.
If it's meant for finding someone
lost, the signal can't be that
strong.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_011.en:
That's right.
Huffman's full of military sites,
so reception here is awful.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_012.en:
True...
Phones from back home are
practically useless here...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_013.en:
I never thought it'd come in handy
so soon...
I should've shown her how to
use it...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_014.en:
They took Aisha alive, so they
must need her skills as a
researcher.
They won't kill her right away.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_015.en:
Oh, that's true!
If we can just get a lead,
we can get her back!

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_016.en:
For now, all we can do is trace
their movements with the
Investigator's intel and use that
signal to find her.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_017.en:
Whose unit are we up against
this time, I wonder...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_018.en:
Sortie order understood.
I'll get ready at once.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_019.en:
Next time we run into those guys,
I want my rematch...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_021.en:
I never thought it'd come in handy
so soon...
I should've shown her how to
use it...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_022.en:
Aisha might be there!
I'll go get ready to sortie!

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_023.en:
That unit...
For Vampire remnants, they seem
far too well organized.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_024.en:
An intelligence building...
Sounds suspicious.
Understood. Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_025.en:
I heard the girl who was on base
the other day got kidnapped?
What would anyone want with a kid
who looks junior-high age?
Wait, she's actually 18? «g:24»
An authority on neuroscience? «g:24»
Seriously?

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_026.en:
I heard just now, Mr. Kinoshita's
son ran away from home a long time
ago. No one knows where he is.
Rough, huh?

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_027.en:
You folks are probably the
strongest mercs in the OCU army,
but there's a regular unit with a
standout record too.
Captain's name was Lloyd Clive,
if I remember right.
With the ceasefire in place, though,
I doubt they'll be deployed.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_028.en:
Can the parts we brought back
identify the unit?

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_029.en:
The recovered parts come from a
model in widespread use.
...Identifying the unit will
take time.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_030.en:
Even so, they're wanzers.
Not something you buy off the shelf.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_031.en:
In any case, it seems very likely
that Dr. Aisha has been taken by
the organization, like the other
researchers.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_032.en:
Right, she did say her colleagues
had been moved.
Any intel on that?

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_033.en:
We have word that a number of
people in white coats have been
taken into an intelligence building
near Grayrock.
I cannot say for certain that it
is the organization, but...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_034.en:
...That intel's all we've got.
...They're probably after the
research. If so, the researchers
should be alive.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_035.en:
But left alone, there will surely
be more victims.
I want the researchers secured as
soon as possible.
Captain «E801:00», if the researchers
are on site, storm the building
and rescue them.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_036.en:
Roger.
Expect the same unit that hit us
at the airport.
We'll prepare to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_037.en:
The researchers may be held in an
intelligence building near
Grayrock.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_001.en:
Could a plan for controlling the
adult brain be built into your
current research?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_002.en:
Controlling the adult brain?
What do you mean?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_003.en:
I'm asking if it's possible.
Can it be done?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_005.en:
Would it be more realistic with
her help, perhaps?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_007.en:
No introductions needed, I see.
She was lead researcher on another
plan. It seems she succeeded in
controlling an adult brain there.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_008.en:
Control is possible.
But...
Under the other plan, the
experimental unit went berserk.
It was a disaster.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_009.en:
...You mean you actually got it
to run on its own!?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_010.en:
...No.
That's something we must never do...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_011.en:
I understand your misgivings.
But it would advance medicine, too.
Won't you continue the plan with
this organization's vast funds?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_012.en:
If the research aims to revive the
brain-dead, I'll take it on.
But...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_013.en:
Exactly. Weapons development is
not the main purpose of this
research. It is for humanity.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_014.en:
Certainly, if Dr. Aisha's research
and mine could be reconciled...
We might see results quickly,
but...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_015.en:
An excellent answer, Dr. Brown.
Then let us return you to the
facility. Dr. Aisha, you'll come
along as well.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_017.en:
You're very sensible, I see.
Right, escort the two of them.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_019.en:
Several guard wanzers confirmed.
Same models as the intel.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_020.en:
Ah, I've got a ping from Shishi!
No doubt about it.
Aisha's in that building!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_022.en:
No ordinary outfit, that's
for sure.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_023.en:
...Reviving the project, then?
Either way, this is beyond what
any one company could pull off.
All units, assume Vampire-class
strength and wipe them out.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_025.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_027.en:
Hostile force has appeared.
Engaging several of the garrison's
wanzers.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_028.en:
Understood.
I'll arrange reinforcements.
They'll be there in five minutes.
Hold until then.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_029.en:
Roger.
The garrison will hold at all costs
until reinforcements arrive.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_031.en:
Look at 'em all...
No way we're going straight in!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_032.en:
To hit us with a force this
large...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_035.en:
Five minutes of operating time
left, max.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_039.en:
......
(Captain... Oddeye...
They all came for me...)

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_040.en:
Naturally, Dr. Aisha.
You already have fine test
material lined up, is that it?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_042.en:
Well, no matter.
We'll leave this to the elite unit
and enjoy our flight.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_044.en:
We're leaving the combat zone.
Ground units, it's in your hands.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_047.en:
...But with this many enemies,
pursuit won't be easy.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_048.en:
Worst case, we rely on Oddeye's
tracker. Wipe out the hostiles,
fast.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_051.en:
They just carried her off right
under our noses...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_052.en:
Huh?
I'm picking up the tracker's
signal from where the chopper
withdrew...
Captain!
Aisha must've noticed Shishi!
Looks like she boosted the
tracker's output!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_053.en:
Roger.
But that enemy force was more than
we bargained for, and we're badly
worn down.
We'll keep tracking the signal and
return to base to regroup.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_001.en:
Captain, we're ready to track
Aisha's transmitter.
Just say the word.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_003.en:
Those guys...
They're on a whole other scale.
Might even be bigger than the
Vampires...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_004.en:
Time to sortie?
I'm good to go!

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_005.en:
Oh, Captain, I boosted the
receiver's sensitivity.
That should widen the range a bit!

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_006.en:
Oh, time to sortie?
Ready whenever you are!

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_007.en:
Captain, that enemy...
That was regular-army scale,
wasn't it?

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_008.en:
Both armies have put enough force
on Huffman to start a war at any
moment. It's not impossible.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_009.en:
Machines with no unit insignia,
no faction markings...
I figured special forces of some
kind, but with that level of
training, I don't think so.
And those numbers...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_010.en:
A unit issued new models and sent
straight into combat...
If not special forces, maybe the
Marines, or the navy.
Either way, it'll never be
officially announced.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_011.en:
Discipline, drills, orders...
If it's a regular unit that's loyal
to the mission, in a way they could
be more trouble than mercs...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_012.en:
But whatever the enemy is, we only
have one job.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_013.en:
Right. Follow Aisha's trail and
stop them rebuilding that
inhuman research program...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_014.en:
Discipline, drills, orders...
If it's a regular unit that's loyal
to the mission, in a way they could
be more trouble than mercs...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_016.en:
(The size of that force...
Just as I thought...)

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_018.en:
New units keep turning up one
after another.
You don't think it's really the USN
attacking us in disguise, do you?

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_019.en:
Investigator Roy's itching to go
out with you folks, you know.
He volunteered for the action unit
because he wanted fieldwork.
The new stock in the hangar? He
ordered it...
I hear he does test firing in the
Killhouse now and then.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_020.en:
Captain «E801:00»...
Don't take this the wrong way, but
I've been looking into your squad
members' pasts.
Looked like the enemy might be
targeting them.
Keep this from the others, would ya?

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_021.en:
Oddeye's transmitter appears to be
heading south from where they
got away.
Our search team is monitoring it.
«E801:00» Squad, track it and
secure Dr. Aisha.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_022.en:
Mission understood.
Anything new on the organization?

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_023.en:
This case is guarded more tightly
than I expected.
Other departments appear to be
blocking information on purpose.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_025.en:
Continue the tracking mission.
As you saw in the last battle,
the enemy strikes from nowhere.
Proceed with every caution.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_027.en:
Oddeye's transmitter appears to be
heading south from where they
got away.
Our search team is monitoring it.
«E801:00» Squad, track it and
secure Dr. Aisha.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_001.en:
Captain, Shishi's signal is gone...
Hmm, something's weird...
Maybe she boosted the output so
much the battery died...?
I'm sorry, Captain...

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_002.en:
Pin down where we last had the
signal.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_005.en:
...Then we should be able to see it
from here.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_006.en:
All units, advance to the last
signal coordinates, combat-ready.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_010.en:
These are the last signal
coordinates...

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_013.en:
No sign of a chopper, no vehicle
tracks either.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_017.en:
...All units, weapon safeties off.
Combat stations.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_019.en:
Already combat-ready, in this
situation?
All units, be advised.
This is no ordinary unit.
Treat them as superior and
eliminate them.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_022.en:
They must have planned for the
transmitter.
...That's the kind of unit they are.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_024.en:
Aisha's a researcher, so I know
they won't hurt her, but... I don't
know, it feels like she'll break if
someone doesn't protect her...
I'm worried.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_025.en:
Yeah.
She's the total opposite of you.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_026.en:
Whaaat!!
Is that the kind of character
I am!?

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_027.en:
Hey, hey, that's a compliment!
You've gotten real tough.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_029.en:
Well, I am a professional
mercenary, after all...

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_030.en:
...As long as she's still on
Huffman, we can find her.
We head back and pick apart how
that decoy worked.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_031.en:
Oh, leave that kind of thing
to me!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_002.en: Rain, you look short on sleep.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_003.en:
Oh! Does it show?
...I was helping Oddeye, and before
I knew it, it was morning...
I think I dozed off partway through,
but Oddeye kept at it and finished
the analysis.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_004.en:
I see.
Good work.
Get some rest.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_005.en:
Thank you.
I'm all right, but since I have
the chance, I'll go grab a shower.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_006.en:
I've just never been the type
who can pull an all-nighter...
Well, I'm off to the shower.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_007.en:
An infiltration op?
Backup, understood.
I'll get ready right away.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_008.en:
Huh?
The Captain and I are doing
the infiltration?
What to wear, though...
We can't exactly go like this, can we?
What about you, Captain?
A suit?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_009.en:
I don't own anything like a suit...
Ordinary clothes that don't stand out
should do, I think.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_010.en:
R-Right, of course...
Understood. I'll go change.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_012.en:
Oddeye, don't tell me you didn't
sleep at all?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_013.en:
Hehehe.
It's for Aisha.
This is nothing!
Rain helped me out, too.
Thanks to her, we cracked it!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_014.en: An all-nighter for both of you, huh...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_015.en:
The theory was simple.
Between the point where the signal
we were receiving started to fluctuate
and the point where the transmitter
went dead -- that's where it might
have been swapped.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_017.en:
That transmitter used a frequency
the military hardly ever uses.
But I think Aisha noticed, and changed
the output so it'd be easier
for us to pick up.
I never showed her how to use it,
but she must've figured it out
right away.
That's what I didn't count on...
No wonder the battery drained so fast.
No matter how much we boosted
the receiver, I figured it wouldn't
put much load on the transmitter,
so I ran a simulation from there.
And when I did that,

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_018.en:
Sorry, Oddeye.
I got no idea what you're sayin'.
None. Zero. Nada.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_019.en:
I get it!
In short, Aisha boosted the
transmitter's output to help us,
the enemy noticed, and they turned it
against us.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_020.en:
That's almost certainly it.
Oh, Captain, here are
the simulation results.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_021.en:
Impressive.
I'll take this to Roy right away.
Oddeye, get some rest.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_022.en:
Okaaay.
Let me know when we're
sortieing~.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_024.en:
Oddeye and Aisha...
Are those two some kinda geniuses?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_025.en:
You only just noticed...?
Though, come on, you're pretty
amazing yourself, Champ...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_026.en:
Nah, I dunno...
Feels like they're miles ahead of me.
Gonna go do some roadwork.
First time in a while...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_027.en:
Sure.
I'm not coming along, though...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_028.en:
Don't sweat it.
I'll run by myself today...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_030.en: I'm off to do some roadwork!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_031.en:
Huh?
An infiltration op?
Tearin' it up behind enemy lines?
Sounds like fun!
...Wait, I'm on standby in the rear?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_032.en:
Coffee after an all-nighter
is the BEST...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_033.en:
Whoa!
The Captain and me? Then we need
disguises!
Hmm, what kind of costume would
work best...
What are you wearing, Captain?
I should probably match you,
right?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_034.en:
I hadn't given it much thought.
Ordinary clothes that don't stand out
should do, I think.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_035.en:
Oh, right, of course.
I almost went full cosplay there...
I'll go change right away!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_036.en:
An infiltration op?
Roger! Leave the backup to me!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_037.en: Champ, what are you sulking about?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_038.en:
An infiltration op?
Understood.
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_039.en:
(An enemy that swaps out
a transmitter, huh...)

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_040.en:
(Ordinary clothes...
All I have are the ones I bought
when I went out with Rain
and Oddeye last time...)

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_041.en:
Supplies keep pouring into every
OCU base, one after another.
Between you and me, the USN side's
beefing up the same way.
Honestly, it's a powder keg.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_042.en:
I know it's in poor taste, but
there's a pool going on whether you
get Aisha back.
Naturally, my money's on you
bringing her home.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_043.en:
Captain «E801:00», I took the liberty
of digging up your records from
before BATS.
Found out you were in the orphanage
in Smolensk, but before and after
that, it's a total blank...
Ah, no, you don't have to answer
if you don't want to...
Then you came over to the OCU
and went straight into special
forces after the entrance exam...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_046.en:
Oddeye analyzed how the decoy
switch was done.
This is the data, apparently.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_047.en:
...I see.
So they may have been heading north.
One of my people reports that some
organization appears to be forcibly
gathering skilled medical staff
from the mainland to Huffman.
And it is happening in the area
directly north of the last site.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_048.en:
It's possible.
But if we're dealing with a medical,
non-combat organization, it'll be hard
for a merc outfit like us to make
contact.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_049.en:
Accordingly, we forgo a wanzer
operation this time.
I want you to make contact with
the facility's staff and get
information.
An infiltration operation, in effect.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_051.en:
On-site intel gathering will be you
and one other.
A female partner should draw less
suspicion.
Take either Oddeye or Rain and try
to approach the medical staff.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_053.en:
I see.
She is certainly suited to the task.
This is not a wanzer operation, but as
a precaution, it would be best to keep
the other three on standby in wanzers.

a fight may be unavoidable.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_063.en:
You should be quite capable in
combat on foot as well.
But if wanzers are involved, I would
like those three standing by.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_001.en: So that building is the facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_002.en: My first mission in plain clothes!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_003.en:
Looking at you two like this,
neither of you seems like a merc.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_004.en:
Ah, so that's why it's the Captain
and Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_006.en:
Oh, honestly, Captain! You too, Oddeye!
Leave your holsters behind!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_007.en:
Hahaha. She's right, you'd be made
in a second if you were armed.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_010.en:
Sneakin' into enemy turf bare-handed...
I wanna try that!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_013.en:
I don't expect a fight, but just
in case, keep our wanzers ready
to start up at a moment's notice.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_017.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_023.en:
(Easy for you to say...
This IS natural...)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_025.en:
This isn't really a place for
sightseeing, you know.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_026.en:
Is it a hospital or something?
It's such a nice, clean building.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_027.en:
Hospital, well...
More like a medical research facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_029.en:
I'm not anyone suspicious, but there's
something I'd like to ask.
Have there been any disappearances
recently, or more people coming
and going than usual...
or anything?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_032.en:
Hmm?
Haven't heard anything about anyone
going missing, but...
who are you two, anyway?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_035.en:
Pretty suspicious.
Why don't you come inside with me
for a bit?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_036.en:
Oh, ah, um!
He's not used to the language here!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_039.en:
(...Russian. Or languages from
around the Middle East.)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_043.en:
Huh? What language is that...?
Ah, so that's why he sounds so stiff.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_044.en:
Yes, that's right, that's it!
The thing is, we think a friend
of ours might be working here,
so we've been going around all kinds
of medical facilities looking.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_045.en: We haven't been able to reach them.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_046.en:
Ah, in that case, maybe it's
B-Block, 10 km further on?
The cleaner was saying B-Block took
on a few dozen new staff lately.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_047.en:
...Three unidentified wanzers intruding.
...Guard A, report to your post.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_048.en:
Enemies, out here?
You'd better come inside too, miss.
There might be shooting.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_049.en:
That won't be necessary.
We'll be on our way.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_051.en:
Oh, we'll be fine, honest.
Bye-bye, Mr. Guard A~!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_052.en:
Hey, wait! Hello!?
...What's with those two?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_054.en:
Captain, this place is bad news.
They've got a crazy number
of sensors set up.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_056.en:
Roger.
We've got useful intel on our end.
Rejoining you now.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_060.en: All right. We fight our way out.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_064.en:
Honestly, Captain, my heart nearly
jumped out of my mouth back there...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_065.en:
We could hear the audio over here,
too, you know...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_066.en: Rain, you're laughing way too hard.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_067.en: And we got spotted on top of it!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_068.en:
Well...
But if there's a next time, Captain,
you're minding the wanzers...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_069.en:
Sorry... Please let me...
Mission complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_001.en: So that building is the facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_002.en:
Captain, with that shirt, it looks more
natural with the top buttons undone.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_003.en:
I see. It's easier on the neck,
too.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_004.en:
Oh, honestly, Captain...
Please don't hide a holster or a knife
on you...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_005.en:
Hmm~.
Looking at you two like this,
you're just like newlyweds!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_006.en:
Now that you mention it, I guess
they could pass for that.
But something's a little stiff...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_007.en:
For a couple, they're actin' like
strangers.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_008.en:
It does look unnatural.
We need to stage it a bit more...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_010.en:
Oh, try linking arms!
That'll look more natural!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_011.en:
W-Wait, there's no need
to go that far...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_012.en:
Rain, this is an infiltration mission.
Failure is not an option!
Rain, please link arms
with the Captain!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_015.en:
Mm-hm, very natural!
Nobody will suspect a thing now!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_016.en:
I don't expect a fight, but just
in case, keep our wanzers ready
to start up at a moment's notice.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_020.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_022.en: Guard A doesn't seem to be here.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_024.en:
Rain, can't you walk a little
more naturally?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_025.en:
Oh, sorry.
Captain... you walk awfully fast.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_026.en:
...I see. You were having trouble
keeping up.
In enemy territory, I can't help it.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_027.en:
It's all right.
I'll try to match your pace.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_028.en:
There's a guard post over there.
There may be something useful.
Let's slip inside.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_030.en:
...Nothing of note here.
Rain, anything on your side?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_031.en:
...A map of the facility, maybe?
...B-Block extension work?
What a big building...
And it's already finished.
Capt-- Mmph.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_034.en:
Seriously, who adds over thirty staff
all of a sudden?
Think about us poor saps on patrol.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_036.en:
...Three unidentified wanzers intruding.
...Guard A, report to your post.
...I repeat...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_037.en:
Why would enemies come all the way
out here?
...Everybody's out to make trouble,
I swear.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_039.en:
...Sorry, Rain.
I covered your mouth on reflex.
Could you breathe?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_040.en:
Oh, no, I'm fine.
Just a little startled...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_041.en:
Guard A seems to have gone off
somewhere.
...Rain?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_042.en:
...Huh? Yes.
Oh, were Champ and the others
spotted?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_043.en:
Looks that way.
Heading to the rendezvous point.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_045.en:
Captain, there are dozens of sensors
set up around this facility!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_046.en:
Sorry, everybody.
I went and tripped one...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_047.en:
Roger.
We've got useful intel on our end.
Rejoining you now.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_051.en: All right. We fight our way out.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_054.en:
...Being in a wanzer really does
feel more right.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_055.en:
Hm?
Rain, your face is red.
Got a fever or something?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_057.en:
Oh my, Rain, are you catching a cold?
When we get back, you should drink
some warm eggnog and go to bed.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_058.en:
Ugh, what the heck kinda drink
is that...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_059.en:
Huh, you don't know it?
It works wonders on a cold.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_061.en:
I see. Don't push yourself.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_001.en:
I've reported the intel from the
infiltration mission to Investigator
Roy.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_003.en:
My heart was pounding the whole
time back there...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_004.en:
Sounds like Oddeye's quick thinking
kept them from getting suspicious...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_005.en:
Sorry about that...
It seems I have no talent for acting...
If there's a next time, I'd like you
and Oddeye to handle it, Rain...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_006.en:
Two ladies on their own? Sounds
risky. I'll throw on a disguise and
tag along.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_007.en:
Uh, Champ, even in disguise, your
build would give you away.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_008.en:
True... You don't see many ordinary
people with that many muscles.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_009.en:
Dammit, guess I trained a little
too hard...
So Gray and Oddeye are the right
picks, then...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_010.en:
But maybe it was exactly because it
was the Captain and Oddeye that they
got the intel.
I'm not sure I could've pulled it
off that well...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_011.en:
I suppose that's one way of looking
at it...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_012.en:
Hmm~, then, Captain, if there's a
next time, let's go together again!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_013.en:
I-I see...
Then I'd better practice my acting...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_016.en:
So Aisha's location has been
confirmed.
Understood. Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_017.en:
Guess I trained a little too hard
for infiltration missions...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_018.en:
Oh? Teaming up with that other
detachment from back then?
Wonder what they're like.
I'll get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_019.en:
Captain, if you're going to practice
acting, I'll help!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_020.en:
You found out where Aisha is!
I'll get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_021.en:
I'm not much of an actor myself,
honestly.
Captain, if there's a next time,
good luck...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_022.en:
Phew... A wanzer battle.
Understood.
This is a lot easier, isn't it?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_023.en:
The other day, when I was coming
down with something, Oddeye made me
this thing called a milk egg toddy...
That stuff was dangerous...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_024.en:
Go get Aisha back, okay?
I've got 2000 H$ riding on it.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_025.en:
I looked into everyone else's past,
too. Nothing in particular that would
make them targets...
But there are signs you were all
brought together on purpose.
You, Oddeye and Champ especially were
all headed for other merc bases, and
it got changed at the last minute.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_026.en:
I've reported the intel from the
infiltration mission to Investigator
Roy.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_027.en:
Good work.
Are you feeling all right?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_028.en:
Oh, um, I'm fine.
I was just tense about a lot
of things back there...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_029.en:
The audio cut out on us. Did
something happen in the guard post?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_030.en:
Yes.
Guard A came near while we were
searching, so we kept quiet.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_031.en:
...Ah, yes.
If we'd been found then, who knows
what would have happened...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_032.en:
You were arm in arm like a real
couple, and then you went sneaking
around the guard post!
In that situation, you'd probably
have been safer just chatting
with Guard A.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_034.en:
Well, with the Captain and Rain,
maybe that was bound to happen.
They'd both get so focused on the
mission, acting would go right out
the window...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_035.en:
True. Putting on an act never even
occurred to me...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_036.en:
But it worked out great in the end,
right?
Next chance you get, maybe you two
should practice your acting.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_037.en:
Acting practice... I love it!
Good luck, you two!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_040.en:
Captain, shall we practice acting
sometime...?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_041.en:
So Aisha's location has been
confirmed.
Understood. Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_042.en: I'm no good at acting either...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_043.en:
Oh? Teaming up with that other
detachment from back then?
Wonder what they're like.
I'll get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_044.en:
Captain, if you're going to practice
acting, I'll help!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_045.en:
You found out where Aisha is!
I'll get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_046.en:
I'm not much of an actor myself,
honestly.
Captain, if there's a next time,
good luck...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_047.en:
Phew... A wanzer battle.
Understood.
This is a lot easier, isn't it?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_048.en:
The other day, when I was coming
down with something, Oddeye made me
this thing called a milk egg toddy...
That stuff was dangerous...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_049.en:
Go get Aisha back, okay?
This time a fancy hotel buffet's
on the line.
Huh?«g:24» Okay, okay.
If I win, I'll make sure to bring
some back for you guys.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_050.en:
I looked into everyone else's past,
too. Nothing in particular that would
make them targets...
But there are signs you were all
brought together on purpose.
You, Oddeye and Champ especially were
all headed for other merc bases, and
it got changed at the last minute.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_051.en:
Thanks to you, we were able to
pinpoint Dr. Aisha's location.
I had my people confirm it just now.
There is no mistake.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_052.en:
But a facility like that is bound
to have that unit stationed there,
too.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_053.en:
Hostile forces have been confirmed
on the same scale as at Grayrock,
or larger.
As a countermeasure, I have placed
people I trust as much as you
in hiding nearby.
They will launch the assault; while
they do, «E801:00» Squad is to make
Dr. Aisha's safety the priority.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_054.en:
Understood.
I'd rather not shoot down the assault
team by mistake.
Give me the details.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_055.en:
If I tell you it is the unit that
once took down a Vampire base, will
you trust their skills?
I'll have their IFF signals sent
to your wanzers.
There should be no friendly fire.
Get Dr. Aisha back, whatever
it takes.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_056.en:
The unit that took down the base...
The other detachment from the
Anti-Vampire Operation.
...I see.
Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_057.en:
Hostile forces have been confirmed
on the same scale as at Grayrock,
or larger.
As a countermeasure, I have placed
people I trust as much as you
in hiding nearby.
They will launch the assault; while
they do, «E801:00» Squad is to make
Dr. Aisha's safety the priority.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_001.en:
Captain, incoming transmission from
the assault team.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_002.en:
This is Chariot 1.
Captain «E801:00», it's been a while.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_005.en:
Good to see you're well, Oddeye.
I'm sorry, there's a lot to catch up
on, but let me brief you first.
We'll hit the facility's guard force
and draw out the main body.
«E801:00» Squad, prioritize securing
the target.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_006.en:
Understood.
Chariot 1, the enemy unit is made up
of new models.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_007.en:
Yes.
I've seen «E801:00» Squad's combat
data.
Their machines perform at Numbers
level, but their pilots seem
to be a step below.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_008.en:
I see.
If you understand that, no problem.
«E801:00» Squad, ready.
We'll time our move to Chariot Squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_009.en:
Roger. Starting the count.
...5, 4... 3, 2, 1...
Operation start.
Napalm, open fire!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_010.en:
Victory: Rescue Aisha.
Defeat: «E801:00» or the wanzer
carrying Aisha is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_012.en:
B-Block defense unit here.
We're under attack by unidentified
hostiles!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_013.en:
Copy.
Diverting all facility defense forces.
Attention, Guard A.
Guide the researchers to the shelter.
I repeat...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_014.en:
Transferred to B-Block, and right
away we get attacked...
Unbelievable...
Just my luck...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_015.en:
All facility forces are out.
All Chariot units, intercept.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_016.en:
Sure enough, there's a ton of 'em.
Tornado, need a hand?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_017.en:
Champ?
We'll manage on our own.
How are things on your end?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_018.en:
Still lookin'...
Sorry, gonna take a little longer.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_019.en:
Roger.
Chariot Squad, we buy them time.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_020.en:
Attention, Guard A.
Guide the researchers to the shelter.
I repeat...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_022.en:
Looks like a hostile wanzer unit is
attacking this place.
I'll escort you, Doctor.
Honestly, trouble on my first day
after the transfer...
Ah, hey, Doctor!
Where are you going!?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_023.en:
Wanzers...
Those silhouettes...
(Everyone... you came for me...)

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_024.en:
Doctor!
You can't go outside!
The shelter's this way!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_025.en:
My colleagues are still in
the facility.
I can't leave them behind.
I'll find them and evacuate together.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_026.en:
Huh?
The word I got was that you were
the only one left, Doctor.
Let's hurry to the shelter.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_027.en:
Did you confirm that yourself?
In all this chaos, can you say for
certain that information is correct?
Can you guarantee their lives?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_028.en:
Ah, well, orders are orders...
But if lives are at stake...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_029.en:
In your position, orders may be
absolute.
But not all information is
necessarily correct.
Sometimes, saving lives on your own
judgement on the ground is the
right thing to do.
...Give me five minutes.
I'll check the facility, and if there
are survivors, I'll lead them out.
Meanwhile, report the situation
to command.
If I don't come back, call for help.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_030.en:
Huh? Ah, yes ma'am!
...Ah, but it's dangerous on your own!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_031.en:
I'll be fine.
Bye-bye, Mr. Guard~.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_032.en:
Right, be careful!
Yeah, that's right.
The Doctor's got a point!
The guys upstairs never know what's
really going on down here anyway.
Wow, I feel like I just did
a good deed!
Now, time to report, report!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_034.en:
Roger.
Can you get a location?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_035.en:
Yes!
Sending the transmitter's position
to all wanzers.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_036.en:
Roger.
All units, head for that point.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_040.en:
Roger.
Rain, head for the extraction point.
All units, cover Rain.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_044.en:
Roger.
Champ, head for the extraction point.
All units, cover Champ.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_048.en:
Roger.
Oddeye, head for the extraction point.
All units, cover Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_050.en:
Gray, is that you?
Thank goodness!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_052.en:
Roger.
Gray, head for the extraction point.
All units, cover Gray.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_055.en:
Aisha secured.
Making for the extraction point now.
All units, cover me.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_057.en:
«E801:00» Squad, as expected.
Chariot Squad, draw the enemy off.
Buy them time to get clear!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_059.en:
Roger. Chariot Squad, thanks for
the assist.
All units, withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_060.en:
Roger, withdrawing.
Captain «E801:00», I'll drop by
the base sometime.
We can talk then.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_063.en:
Aisha, we'll keep you under
protection at the base for a while.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_064.en: Yes. Thank you for having me.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_066.en:
Dammit...
Aisha... Rain...
I couldn't protect them...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_067.en:
Tch, I let my guard down!?
But... at least Aisha...!!
Nwaaaargh!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_071.en:
Ngh, I'm hit...
Aisha, get out, hurry!!
Waaaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_073.en:
I'm hit...
Heavy damage.
Aisha, get out of here.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_074.en:
N-No... Captain!!
Aisha!!
This can't be...
Noooooo!!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_002.en:
Impressive that she got out of the
facility in that situation.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_003.en:
Will this set back Organization B's
research, do you think?

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_004.en:
Aisha is a key figure to
Organization B.
Until they find someone to replace
her, their research will stall.
I'd like to corner them while we can.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_005.en:
Time to corner Organization B...
I wonder how much of a margin
we've bought...

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_006.en:
Time to corner Organization B...
I wonder how much of a margin
we've bought...

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_007.en:
Sounds like we've found a lead.
Understood.
I'll go prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_008.en:
Still, that friendly unit sure
was reliable.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_009.en:
Yeah, Chariot Squad, they said.
And Tornado.
That kid's toughened up a lot.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_010.en:
Sounds like you and Oddeye
knew him, Champ.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_011.en:
Yeah, we all signed on as mercs
at the same time, kinda.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_012.en:
Apparently they're the ones who took
down the Vampire base.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_013.en:
I see.
So they were the other detachment.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_014.en:
Chariot Squad is well known, even
among the regulars.
Their captain came to scout in
person, and that's when Tornado's
posting was decided.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_015.en:
Way things went, could've been me
that ended up in Chariot.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_016.en:
No. Chariot was looking for an
Assault back then.
I believe you and Oddeye were already
out of the running.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_017.en:
I see.
Still, after fighting side by side,
I'd like to meet the rest of
Chariot Squad.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_018.en:
Yeah.
I'd love to knock back a drink
with those guys.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_019.en:
Chariot is apparently one of the
units under Roy now.
We'll get the chance sooner or later.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_020.en:
Someday I wanna knock back a drink
with those guys.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_021.en: Let's go smash Organization B, too!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_022.en:
I'd like to meet the rest of
Chariot Squad.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_023.en:
We've finally got a lead.
I'll get ready to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_024.en:
The investigator gave me permission
to come into the barracks.
Captain, thank you for rescuing me.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_025.en:
You did well to get out of
the facility.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_026.en:
It was thanks to all of you bringing
chaos to the facility.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_027.en:
Chaos...
I don't quite get it, but
I'm glad...

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_028.en:
And thanks to little Shishi,
from Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_029.en:
Oh, Aisha, you figured out the
transmitter! Nice going!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_030.en:
I had time to tinker with it
while I was captive.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_031.en: Ohh, so that's how it was!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_032.en:
But when I turned up the output,
they caught on...
They took the transmitter inside.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_033.en:
So I thought.
But it still gave us a lead
to find you.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_035.en:
I'll be imposing on you here for
a while.
I look forward to working with
you all.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_036.en:
Yes. Until this is over, you're safer
here.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_039.en:
A mission? Roger!
Preparing to sortie!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_040.en:
I'll be imposing on you here for
a while.
I look forward to working with
you all.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_041.en:
Understood.
I'll hold down the fort here.
Be careful out there, everyone!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_042.en:
Oh, hey,
Aisha's back, isn't she?
Good for you guys.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_043.en:
Yes!
Aisha's back!«g:24»
Gotta book that buffet right away!
And I'd better get some containers
ready for your share, too.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_044.en:
Why you were brought together...
Maybe it was to take down the
Vampires in the first place.
In other words, you may have been
assembled on purpose to erase
their evidence.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_045.en:
Captain «E801:00».
Good work.
Thanks to you, Dr. Aisha is safe,
and we have an outline of the
research at that facility.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_046.en:
The op only succeeded because
Chariot Squad was there.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_047.en:
Chariot Squad was originally led
by one of my direct subordinates.
But in the Anti-Vampire Operation
they lost their base and their
captain, so Tornado took over.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_050.en:
We ran an exercise together once,
with Champ and Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_051.en:
I see.
So the merc base that scouted him
was the one you were at...
I had them tracking the Numbers
who escaped.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_053.en:
Missing, to be precise.
But after their base fell, not one
piece of physical evidence remained.
If they are alive, they will without
doubt be more troublesome than
even Lich.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_054.en:
More than Lich...
So that's why the investigation
on Huffman continues.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_055.en:
Precisely.
Criticism of Internal Affairs has
been growing lately.
In place of me, I intend to have
Tornado's team serve as guards
on the mainland.
I want «E801:00» Squad to continue
the investigation on Huffman.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_057.en:
According to what Chariot Squad
learned, the Vampires' research arm
was working on something called
the PS (Puppet Soldier) Plan.
Its aim, apparently, was "to
manipulate soldiers like puppets."

And the new organization that
abducted Aisha appears to be doing
new research based on the PS Plan.
For now, we've decided to call this
organization "Organization B."

The Organization B facility where
we recovered Aisha was a recent
addition. This time, I want you to
investigate their old medical
facility.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_058.en:
Would there be anything left at the
old medical facility?
Erasing evidence is their specialty.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_059.en:
True.
But as long as clues may remain,
we cannot afford not to look.
However, if the enemy appears, there
is no one but your unit who can
put up a real fight.
That is the long and short of it.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_060.en:
I see.
Understood.
We'll gear up and move out.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_062.en:
I want you to investigate
Organization B's old medical
facility.
The enemy may appear.
Don't neglect your preparations.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_001.en:
Is this the old medical facility?
No Organization B forces detected
so far.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_002.en:
Awful bare place.
...Hm? These scars...
Was there fightin' here too?

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_003.en:
Those are some heavy battle scars.
...Still, a place like this...
Perfect for doing shady experiments
where no one can see.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_004.en:
Should we get out of the wanzers
and take a look?

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_005.en:
No, it's dangerous.
Stay in your machines.
All units, record footage.
Collect anything that could serve
as physical evidence.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_006.en:
Roger.
Let's head to that point; we should
be able to see inside from there.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_007.en: All units, move to the point.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_010.en:
Nothin' suspicious here.
Looks like they already moved out.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_011.en:
Still no enemy contacts.
Recording continues.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_012.en:
I don't know... it's just
a creepy place...
Glad we didn't get out of the wanzers.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_013.en:
Yeah?
Doesn't look dangerous to me.
Though somethin' ELSE might show up...

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_014.en:
Like zombies or ghosts?
Anyone with a sixth sense would
probably see them.
I don't think I want to watch
this footage later...

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_015.en:
Sixth sense or not, I do feel
a chill somehow.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_016.en:
We're not even inside, but I can
almost smell it... a stench mixed
with disinfectant...

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_017.en:
This building...
It's built more like a factory than
a medical facility.
All these little culture cases...
As if something was on display.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_018.en:
Ah, this is... RDX!?
...Captain, it's a trap!
There are remote-detonated bombs
planted here!

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_019.en:
If they're remote-detonated, the
enemy may be hiding nearby.
All units, combat ready.
Pull out of the facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_020.en:
Cleaners here.
...Five intruder wanzers still active.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_022.en:
Roger.
Withdrawal team, once you take hits
as planned, head for the rendezvous
point.
Main body, focus on pinning them
down.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_024.en:
Doesn't look like many.
We'll intercept as we are.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_026.en:
Heading for the rendezvous point,
as planned.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_027.en:
Cleaners here...
...The enemy is far stronger than
expected.
Main body wiped out...
The rest have been sent to the
rendezvous point as planned.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_031.en:
Several units appear to have
withdrawn.
Is that... their leader's machine?
Huh...?
Captain, a heat source underground...
This is...
Just like that time...
It's the same trap as in the fight
with Lich!

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_032.en:
What kind of people are they...
All units, clear the area.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_001.en:
Captain. I've sent every unit's
footage to the investigator's
analysis team.
They should be in touch soon.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_003.en:
Still, blowing up the whole
facility...
Reminds me of the fight with Lich...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_004.en: Damn, those guys give me the creeps...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_005.en:
Judging by their methods, the
remnants were set up to wipe out
anyone who came to investigate
the facility.
...I also want to know where the
units that fled have gone.
I'll ask the investigator if he
has any intel.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_007.en:
Where could the units that fled
have gone...?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_010.en:
Roger that.
I'll get my wanzer ready!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_011.en:
To think the Vampires' shadow
is still hanging over us...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_013.en:
The place you all went last time
was the old research facility,
wasn't it?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_015.en:
No, I was usually at another
facility. I was called to the old
one only once, during the B1
activation test, to deal with a
control system problem.
But the test unit went berserk, so
I was evacuated to another facility
right away.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_017.en:
No.
Vampire was the B2 test unit.
The B1 had its code changed...
I think they called it Ghost.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_018.en:
...What was the control system
research you were doing, Aisha?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_019.en:
Brief revival of brain-dead patients
through an external neural
connection.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_021.en:
It's less a revival than calling
someone back from the brink for a
single moment.
The brainwave control is so strong
that it's a heavy burden on the
patient. So I believe a moment is
the limit.
In some countries it's against the
law, but I thought the testimony of
the dead could help solve all kinds
of cases, so I kept at it...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_022.en:
Did you know your research was
being used to develop weapons?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_023.en:
No. Of course, if I'd known, I'd
never have taken part...
No... I suppose I couldn't have
refused anyway...
...At first they told me it was for
medical purposes, and brought me
to this island.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_024.en:
But that prototype ran for a lot
longer than a moment...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_025.en:
Yes...
I never imagined they'd combine my
research and use it to move a wanzer...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_026.en:
Does the pilot have to be someone
brought back from brain death?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_027.en:
Mm, it should be, yes.
If a healthy person is put under that
brainwave control... it causes
violent headaches like Captain
«E801:00»'s, memory loss, and in the
worst cases, a mental collapse.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_028.en:
I see...
Then I owe you a lot, Aisha.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_029.en:
Huh?
Oddeye, what do you mean?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_030.en:
X-00B2 Vampire was David...
He was someone very dear to me.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_032.en:
It seems the Vampires had been
searching for pilots compatible
with that machine.
And when David was wounded fighting
them, they deliberately drove him
into brain death...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_033.en:
...When we rescued him from the
Vampires, David's mind had collapsed.
But in the end, he got his memories
back, and now he's resting
peacefully back home.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_034.en:
No...
That can't...
I'm so sorry, Oddeye.
Because of my research...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_035.en:
No, it's not your fault, Aisha.
By rights, once he was gone, I'd
never have heard another word from
him, or seen him ever again.
But I got to hear him say goodbye,
when he was supposed to be brain
dead!
Thank you. It's all thanks to you,
Aisha!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_036.en:
...But...
If that machine had never existed...
if the project had never gone
ahead...
none of you would have been dragged
into this fight...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_037.en:
Even after the Vampires collapsed,
Organization B rose in their place.
If it hadn't been you, someone else
would have done it.
You don't have to carry it alone.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_038.en:
That's right.
Don't let it get to you, Aisha.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_039.en:
I'm truly sorry...
......
...It started when I was little,
when my grandfather died.
He passed without leaving a word.
There was a fight over the will,
and the family fell apart.
...In time, the research succeeded.
But people can't become gods.
No... people mustn't become gods.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_040.en:
...I understand the regret.
But so it never happens again, we
do everything we can, right now,
with our own strength.
I think that's the responsibility
of those who know the truth.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_041.en:
You're right...
My abilities...
I wonder if they could be of some
use...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_042.en:
As long as you're here, Organization
B's research is stuck, right?
Then just being here is already a
huge help!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_043.en:
But... all of you are out there
risking your lives, and I'm the only
one who gets to stay home...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_044.en:
Well, we're mercenaries.
Fighting is what we can do right now.
Besides, when somebody's waiting to
say "welcome back," it makes you
swear you'll come home no matter
what!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_046.en:
Aisha, once Organization B is shut
down, you can go home.
You can think about the rest then.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_048.en:
Aisha took it to heart, didn't
she...
Maybe I should've kept it to myself
after all...
But I wanted to thank her...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_049.en:
A sortie?
I'll go get ready!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_050.en: Something I can do to help...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_051.en:
You're heading out, then.
Please be careful, everyone.
...I'll ask the investigator if I can
help analyze the footage.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_052.en:
I was chatting with Aisha...
and when I brought up neuroscience,
she switched straight into lecture
mode...
Didn't let me go for about three
hours. Brutal.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_053.en:
Heard they decided to call the new
enemy "Organization B."
Pretty lazy, next to "the Vampires."

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_054.en:
Unconfirmed info, but...
looks like some medical outfit just
crossed the border from OCU
territory into USN territory.
Proper embassy permits and all...
but at a time like this? Fishy...
Guess I'll pass it on to Roy.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_055.en:
I am reviewing the footage from your
wanzers, but nothing that qualifies as
evidence was recorded.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_056.en:
Booby traps and an underground
detonation system.
Judging by their methods, the
Vampire remnants are the likely
culprits, but...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_057.en:
...As expected, that alone is not
enough to trace who is behind them.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_058.en:
Several enemy machines withdrew.
Any idea where they went?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_059.en:
There are reports of unidentified
machines gathering at ruins in the
desert.
However, any link to Organization B
is unconfirmed.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_060.en:
The desert...
Another thing they share with the
Vampires.
If need be, we'll investigate.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_061.en:
...Indeed.
I am counting on you.
I will keep going through the
footage here.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_062.en:
There are reports of unidentified
machines gathering at ruins in the
desert.
However, any link to Organization B
is unconfirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_001.en:
We've reached the point where the
unidentified machines were sighted.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_003.en:
Could it be their base...?
No, doesn't really look like one...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_004.en:
Maybe some armed group was just
runnin' drills out here?

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_005.en:
A place like this means they've
got something planned.
All units, proceed with caution.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_006.en:
A trap...
Yeah, that does make more sense.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_008.en:
All right. All units, intercept
positions.
We wait for them to make a move.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemies.
Defeat: «E801:00» is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_011.en:
Rain, check whether those are the
machines that fled.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_012.en:
Roger.
Matching silhouettes...
Same model as the wanzers that fled
the old research facility, confirmed.
Other machines are mixed in.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_013.en:
The ones that fled, and others...
Oddeye, any explosives in the area?

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_014.en:
No, I've been scanning since we got
here. Nothing.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_015.en: So this is just where they ran to...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_016.en:
Then we disable their forces and get
the information out of them.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_018.en:
What are these people...
So this is the strength of the unit
that beat the Numbers...
Dammit, this wrecks the whole plan.
Forget it. Send out the
strongpoint-assault machine!

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_019.en:
Huh? What is that...
A large machine?
No, it's a wanzer!
Captain!

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_020.en:
I see. So there was an ambush after
all.
They meant to wear us down, then
finish us with a special large
machine.
All units, work together. Take it
down.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_023.en:
Monsters...
...All remaining units, bring them
down, whatever it takes!
If it comes to that, take them
with you...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_025.en:
Roger.
To any survivors:
Lay down your arms and surrender.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_027.en:
I repeat.
Lay down your arms and surrender.
Further fighting is pointless.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_028.en:
Captain!
The enemy leader's machine... I'm
reading explosive liquid!
...It's going to self-destruct!!

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_029.en:
Hell...
What do they think a life is
worth...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_030.en:
...So this is how they do things.
Withdraw.
All units, don't get caught in the
blast.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_001.en:
Still, those bastards...
What the hell do they think a human
life is?

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_002.en:
Blowing themselves up to destroy
evidence, experimenting on people...
Are they mercenaries too, I wonder...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_003.en: That's way too extreme just for money.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_004.en:
Remember what happened with Lancer.
They may be forcing people to sign
through blackmail.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_005.en:
Or they're ruled by something even
more frightening...
The Vampires...
In that sense, they haven't
collapsed at all.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_006.en:
So unless we track down the root
and get rid of it, this will just
keep happening.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_007.en:
Damn...
This is driving me nuts...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_008.en:
...The enemy is bigger than we
imagined.
Solving what we can see, one thing
at a time, may look like the long way
round, but I think it's the shortest.
No rushing. All we can do is pull
off each mission, one by one.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_010.en:
Are we really getting any closer to
the truth, I wonder...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_012.en:
One at a time, huh...
Hmm.
That's how I became Champ, too.
Back to basics, then!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_013.en:
Roger that!
Let's nail that evidence, whatever
it takes!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_014.en:
Unless we track down the root and
get rid of it, this will just keep
happening.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_015.en:
Sortie, understood.
I'll get ready right away.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_016.en:
Aisha's still shut away doing
analysis, same as ever.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_017.en:
I see.
She'd rather do her own kind of work
than just sit around here.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_018.en: I wish I could help her somehow...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_019.en:
She seems to get along especially
well with you, Oddeye.
I understand wanting to do something
for her as a friend, but you have
your job on the front line.
That should be enough.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_020.en:
I guess...
Aisha and I are just on the same
wavelength, somehow.
She's the kind of friend I want to
treasure.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_021.en:
Then Aisha may be thinking the same
thing.
The more you worry about her, the
more she may end up worrying about
you.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_022.en:
Oh, I get it...
You're right.
I'll do my best on the front line!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_023.en:
Aisha's working hard, so I'll do my
best on the front line too!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_024.en:
A sortie!
I'll go get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_025.en:
I hear the enemy blows themselves up
when they're cornered?
I remember an old anime like that.
Maybe the enemy's after something
too?

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_026.en:
Passed Aisha in the hallway the other
day. Hair a total mess, face all
pale.
She's cute normally, but seeing her
like that, she looked like a proper
scientist.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_027.en:
That intel from before? Bingo.
Looks like the enemy's run off into
USN territory.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_028.en:
We have located a facility housing
Organization B's research division.
It is a medical facility in Larcus.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_029.en:
Larcus...
That's USN territory.
Enemy territory...
How did they move it all there?

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_030.en:
They simply crossed the border, it
seems. There were records.
Our agent on the ground reports the
facility is in operation.
...We have secured an infiltration
route from the coast.
I want you to go and investigate.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_031.en:
If we're found, there'll be hell
to pay.
That's a USN controlled zone.
It's not the same as slipping a
little over the border.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_032.en:
There is no time to wait for the
embassy's permission.
All I can say is, don't get caught.
Also, a sizeable wanzer force appears
to be guarding the area.
Be careful.
New weapons and parts have just
been delivered to the hangar.
Upgrade as much as you can before
you go.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_033.en:
So it's a job only we can do...
Understood.
Looks like we have no choice.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_034.en:
And...
I hate to raise this at a time
like this...
...
...
...
Commander Falcon's death has been
confirmed.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_036.en:
Officially, it is being called
suicide by gunshot.
There were traces of drugs as well.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_037.en:
...He wasn't the kind of man who'd
do that.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_038.en:
Of course not.
It looks like whoever is pulling the
strings is sending us a warning...
But...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_039.en:
But we can't let it break us...
We sortie at once.
...This could shake the squad before
a mission.
I'll keep Falcon's death to myself
until the mission is over.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_040.en:
Unfortunately, we do not know the
details of their forces.
On the surface it is a working
medical facility, but if it is in
operation, we can safely assume a
considerable force is hidden there.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_001.en:
Arrived at the Larcus plant zone.
That facility appears to be the
target.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_003.en:
We recon the facility while keeping
watch on the surroundings.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_004.en:
Feels like another place that's
gonna smell of disinfectant.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_005.en:
You really hate disinfectant that
much?
Are you a germ, Gray?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_006.en:
So after muscle-head, now it's
germ...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_007.en:
That's mean, Oddeye...
That smell reminds you of hospitals,
right...?
I don't have many good memories of
those...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_008.en:
I don't mind that smell so much,
myself...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_009.en:
Don't worry, Gray.
Not as long as you stay in your
wanzer.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_010.en:
Ha ha ha!
Muscle-head and germ-head, huh?
We gotta stick together, Gray!
Oh, look at that.
The garrison here?
It's a wanzer unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_011.en:
They're deployed right out in the
open...
...Wait, that's the USN regular army!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_012.en:
Would USN machines guard a place
that isn't even military?
Maybe it's camouflage.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_013.en:
But if they're real...
Fighting the regular army would be
bad.
Captain, what do we do?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_014.en:
We still need to investigate that
facility.
Rain, mark the recon points for
all units.
Keep contact with the garrison to a
minimum. Get the evidence and pull
out.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_016.en:
Victory: Investigate the enemy
facility.
Defeat: «E801:00» or Oddeye is
destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_019.en:
Damn, who the hell are they...
All units, intercept!
Keep them away from the plant!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_021.en: Get to the recon point, fast.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_024.en:
Noise on the image...
No good. I can't record.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_025.en:
A canceler, maybe...?
Rain, I'll break the protection
remotely from here.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_030.en:
Noise on the image?
No good...
What a time to break down!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_031.en:
A canceler, maybe...?
Champ, let's switch.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_033.en:
Roger.
This kinda thing's Oddeye's job...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_036.en:
Noise on the image...?
A canceler?
Removing...
Whoa, what's this?
Layers and layers of protection...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_038.en:
Captain, breaking the protection is
going to take a little while.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_039.en:
Roger.
All units, protect Oddeye at all
costs.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_042.en:
Noise on the image...?
Interference...
Oddeye, how do you break this kind
of protection?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_043.en:
I'd have to take a look...
Gray, let's switch.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_045.en:
Roger.
It's up to you, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_047.en:
Roger.
All units, cover the Captain.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_048.en:
Noise on the image...
Looks like interference.
Oddeye, how do I break this kind of
protection?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_049.en:
I'd have to take a look...
Captain, let's switch.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_051.en:
...So much jammer noise...
Mmm, third layer removed... there.
Image clear...
...Huh? Glass cases?
Covering the whole wall...
What is this... What's going on!?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_052.en:
What's up, Oddeye?
Get yourself a scoop?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_053.en:
Wh-what IS this!!
Things that look like brains...
Lots of them, in glass cases...
It's horrible!!
...Sending the footage...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_055.en:
Holy hell...
There's sick, and then there's
this...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_056.en:
...We've kept the garrison busy long
enough.
Oddeye, that's enough.
Good work.
All units, head for the withdrawal
point.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_059.en: Did they see inside the plant?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_060.en:
No, sir. We have jammers layered
all around it.
No ordinary technician could get
through them.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_061.en:
Hmph.
Turned tail and ran, then.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_063.en:
No need.
The project director arrives in an
hour.
I don't want any trouble.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_065.en:
Reached the withdrawal point.
No sign of pursuit.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_066.en:
Roger.
Looks like they don't want to chase
us too far either.
Recon mission complete.
We'll leave the rest to Roy.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_004.en:
RACHEL PERKINS: SUICIDE!?

A few weeks ago, young journalist
Rachel Perkins was arrested on
suspicion of drug possession just
after returning from a reporting
trip. She was released days later
for lack of evidence, but the
scandal is said to have distanced
her, a campaigner on anti-war and
healthcare issues, from the mass
media.
What drove her to take her own
life...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_005.en:
Rachel? THAT Rachel?
The Rachel we know wouldn't touch
drugs...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_009.en:
I'm sorry. I was told before the
last mission, but I judged it would
affect the operation, so I held it
back until now...
...A few days ago, Falcon's body was
found.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_012.en:
Like Rachel, he went missing for
several days, and they're calling it
suicide...
Apparently there were traces of drugs
in his body too.
...
...Rachel, Falcon... We know better
than anyone that neither of them
would ever do such a thing.
But the two of them had something
in common...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_013.en:
In common...
Oh! You don't mean...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_014.en:
They were both involved with the
Vampires...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_015.en:
Yes.
And their bodies were found close
to each other.
There's no doubt they were seized by
someone back home and murdered to
look like suicide.
Rachel got hold of information on
the Vampires back then.
Maybe even the story she originally
came for got in the way of whoever
is behind them.
And Falcon, if only indirectly, was
an ordinary officer helping the
Internal Affairs investigation.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_016.en:
Is this what Lich meant by
"getting erased"...?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_017.en:
...Something this blatant... could it
be a warning to the investigator,
and to us?
If so...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_018.en:
This is how they work.
It can never be forgiven.
But as mercenaries, there's nothing
we can do to touch them...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_019.en:
...Dammit. Mastermind or whatever
the hell they are, sneakin' around
in the shadows doin' their dirty
work...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_020.en:
The Organization B case should be
wrapping up soon.
Maybe it's time we thought about
what we do next.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_022.en:
...Understood.
...For now, let's finish things with
Organization B.
Preparing to sortie!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_025.en:
A few days ago, Falcon's body was
found.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_028.en:
Falcon left the army, went missing
for several days, and they're calling
it suicide...
Apparently there were traces of drugs
in his body.
...
Several staff from the merc base
have dropped out of sight as well...
...We know better than anyone that
none of them would do such a thing.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_029.en:
Even the merc base staff...
You don't mean...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_030.en:
Soldiers who knew about the
Vampires...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_031.en:
Yes.
There's no doubt they were seized by
someone back home and murdered to
look like suicide.
Falcon, if only indirectly, was an
ordinary officer helping the Internal
Affairs investigation.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_032.en:
Is this what Lich meant by
"getting erased"...?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_033.en:
...Something this blatant... could it
be a warning to the investigator,
and to us?
If so...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_034.en:
This is how they work.
It can never be forgiven.
But as mercenaries, there's nothing
we can do to touch them...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_035.en:
...Dammit. Mastermind or whatever
the hell they are, sneakin' around
in the shadows doin' their dirty
work...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_036.en:
The Organization B case should be
wrapping up soon.
Maybe it's time we thought about
what we do next.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_038.en:
...Understood.
...For now, let's finish things with
Organization B.
Preparing to sortie!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_039.en:
"As mercenaries"...
Then what are we supposed to do...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_040.en:
So they've finally found Organization
B's development base.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_041.en:
After Organization B's finished...
What can guys like us even do...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_042.en:
Thinkin' won't get us anywhere.
We just do what we can right now!
Alright, final round!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_045.en:
It's Aisha.
Ever since we talked about David,
she's been brooding over it...
I've tried talking to her a few times,
but she's not her usual cheery self...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_046.en:
...If she learned her research
hurt you and so many others, even
indirectly... knowing Aisha, she
must feel responsible.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_047.en:
But it's not like any of it is her
fault...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_048.en:
Whatever the circumstances, Aisha
probably can't just file it away
and move on.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_049.en:
That's just it...
Aisha's still a kid, and she's a
civilian...
I... don't know what to do...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_050.en:
Maybe you should just treat her the
way you feel like, same as always.
...No, sorry.
...That's hardly advice.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_051.en:
No, thank you!
I think that's good advice!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_052.en:
Watching you all, I sometimes envy
you...
...When it comes to communication,
you're all far better at it than I am.
If anything, I'm the one being
taught.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_053.en:
Oh, come on...
When you listen to me, Captain, I get
these really honest, straight words
back. It always helps!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_055.en:
It does!
We can leave the mind games to the
enemy.
That's what comrades are for, right?
Oh, I get it...
It's the same with Aisha, isn't it.
See, you were right after all,
Captain!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_056.en:
Hearing that helps me, too.
Communication...
Oddeye, let's talk again sometime.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_059.en:
A sortie!
Huh? Aisha's coming too...!?
Got it.
I'll protect Aisha.
Okay, let's go settle this!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_060.en:
Long time no see, everyone.
You're not registered as mercs any
more, so you were hard to track down.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_061.en:
Ellen!
What brings you out here?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_062.en:
Well, as it happens,
I've brought you something nice.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_063.en:
This is...
Where did you get it?
It looks like it's been modified.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_064.en:
It's a prototype from the 1st Army's
Tactical Research Institute.
I have a friend there who slipped it
into my supplies, said to use it if
I liked. But I thought it'd do more
good with you, since you're the ones
fighting right now.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_065.en:
Th-thank you!
Hm?
Ellen, all that luggage...
Are you leaving the island?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_066.en:
No, I've got some leave, so I'm just
going home to my family.
They live in a town on this island,
called Lark Valley.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_067.en:
I see.
I thought I might never see you
again.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_068.en:
Ah, but... maybe I really will leave
the island.
...Probably... no.
This island is going to war again,
I'm sure of it.
The regulars have already started
preparing.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_069.en:
No... A war...?
Is that true?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_070.en:
...I'm going home to tell my parents
and friends to get off the island,
and soon.
If my parents ask me to come with
them... I may go too.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_072.en:
I know you're helping CISU, but...
If you sense danger, get off the
island. Right away.
Understood?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_073.en:
Yes...
Thank you for the warning.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_074.en:
If you sense danger, get off the
island. Right away.
Understood?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_075.en:
Is it true you went into USN
territory...?
Roy sure hands out some risky orders.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_076.en:
The investigator told us to go over
your wanzers extra carefully this
time. You guys up against something
nasty?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_077.en:
...No way... If this intel's true...
This is bad. I gotta tell Roy, right
now...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_078.en:
Captain «E801:00».
We have finished analyzing the
intelligence you gathered.
Thanks to you, we finally know where
Organization B's weapons development
base is.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_079.en:
I see.
Then let's finish the job.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_080.en:
Excuse me for interrupting.
I've reviewed the footage «E801:00»
Squad brought back.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_081.en: Dr. Aisha, please brief the Captain.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_082.en:
It looks as if the core system has
entered mass production...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_083.en:
Core system...?
What are they researching at that
facility?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_084.en:
The objects in the footage are an
artificial brain and spinal cord
system.
The organization is experimenting
with running it as a core system:
in other words, a replacement for
the pilot.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_086.en:
...They're bio-parts for next-
generation wanzers.
I was researching the control system,
so I had no way of knowing the
details...
But if those are being produced, then
there's no doubt a plan is under way
to fit them to the X-00 type that
was prototyped under the PS Plan.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_087.en:
What?
